negative_pole.definition_en: Individual Primacy (-1.0): The individual is the fundamental unit of reality and moral value.
negative_pole.definition_hi: व्यक्तिगत प्रधानता (-1.0): व्यक्ति ही वास्तविकता और नैतिक मूल्य की मूल इकाई है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Collective Primacy (+1.0): The community, group, or culture is primary; self is socially embedded.
positive_pole.definition_hi: सामूहिक प्रधानता (+1.0): समुदाय या संस्कृति प्राथमिक है; व्यक्ति सामाजिक ताने-बाने से जुड़ा है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: What is the primary locus of identity and moral belonging: the autonomous individual or the collective whole?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D01 (Identity Ontology) vs. D04 (Ethical Obligation): D01 asks who is fundamental, while D04 asks how obligations arise.

negative_pole.definition_en: Personal Autonomy (-1.0): Decisions legitimately originate from individual conscience and sovereignty.
negative_pole.definition_hi: व्यक्तिगत स्वायत्तता (-1.0): निर्णय व्यक्तिगत विवेक और संप्रभुता से उत्पन्न होने चाहिए।

positive_pole.definition_en: Institutional Authority (+1.0): Guidance and governance legitimately derive from established institutions and law.
positive_pole.definition_hi: संस्थागत अधिकार (+1.0): मार्गदर्शन और शासन स्थापित संस्थाओं और कानून से प्राप्त होता है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Who should legitimately direct an individual's choices and beliefs: personal conscience or institutional hierarchy?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: The Tri-Axial Freedom Defense: D02 addresses institutional/hierarchical legitimacy, distinct from civil liberty (D07) and free agency (D25).

negative_pole.definition_en: Radical Plasticity (-1.0): Human nature is fluid, socially constructed, and malleable.
negative_pole.definition_hi: परिवर्तनशीलता (-1.0): मानव स्वभाव सामाजिक रूप से निर्मित और असीम रूप से परिवर्तनशील है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Fixed Essential Nature (+1.0): Humans possess an immutable biological, metaphysical, or spiritual nature.
positive_pole.definition_hi: स्थिर स्वभाव (+1.0): मानव का एक अंतर्निहित, अपरिवर्तनीय जैविक या आध्यात्मिक स्वभाव होता है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Can human nature be fundamentally remolded through culture and education, or is it bound by innate biological/spiritual constraints?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D03 isolates ontological malleability of human nature from civilizational progressivism (D21) and historical meliorism (D23).

negative_pole.definition_en: Rational Self-Interest (-1.0): Action is legitimately rooted in personal flourishing and chosen goals.
negative_pole.definition_hi: तर्कसंगत स्वार्थ (-1.0): कर्म व्यक्तिगत उत्कर्ष और स्व-निर्धारित लक्ष्यों में निहित है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Mutual Moral Obligation (+1.0): Human action is grounded in intrinsic solidarity, altruism, and debt to others.
positive_pole.definition_hi: पारस्परिक कर्तव्य (+1.0): कर्म अंतर्निहित एकजुटता, परोपकार और समाज के प्रति ऋण पर आधारित है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Are human associations justified primarily by mutual utility and personal interest, or by unchosen moral debt and solidarity?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D04 addresses ethical motivation and interpersonal bond, distinct from social ontological status (D01).

negative_pole.definition_en: Immanent Flourishing (-1.0): Purpose and well-being are attained entirely within earthly bodily lifespan.
negative_pole.definition_hi: सांसारिक उत्कर्ष (-1.0): जीवन का उद्देश्य इसी प्राकृतिक जीवन और सांसारिक सीमाओं में प्राप्त होता है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Transcendental Realization (+1.0): Ultimate human destiny transcends bodily life, requiring spiritual liberation.
positive_pole.definition_hi: पारलौकिक उत्थान (+1.0): अंतिम गंतव्य भौतिक जीवन से परे है, जिसके लिए आध्यात्मिक मुक्ति आवश्यक है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is human fulfillment confined to natural, historical existence, or does it culminate in transcendent, metaphysical realization?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D05 concerns the locus of human flourishing (this-worldly vs other-worldly), whereas D22 addresses cosmic meaning vs constructed purpose.

negative_pole.definition_en: Strict Egalitarianism (-1.0): Equal moral and civic standing demands minimizing status and power distinctions.
negative_pole.definition_hi: कठोर समानतावाद (-1.0): बुनियादी नैतिक और राजनीतिक समानता शक्ति और संपत्ति के भेदों को न्यूनतम करने की मांग करती है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Natural / Functional Hierarchy (+1.0): Differentiated roles, hierarchy, and merit are essential for civil order.
positive_pole.definition_hi: कार्यात्मक पदानुक्रम (+1.0): नागरिक व्यवस्था और उत्कृष्टता के लिए भूमिकाओं का भेद और पदानुक्रम अनिवार्य है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Should society actively level disparities of power, wealth, and status, or preserve functional hierarchical roles?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D06 evaluates structural status equality, distinct from universal legal application (D10) and impartial justice (D17).

negative_pole.definition_en: Unconditional Liberty (-1.0): Freedom of speech, action, and conscience must not be overridden by state coercion.
negative_pole.definition_hi: पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता (-1.0): अभिव्यक्ति और कर्म की स्वतंत्रता को सामाजिक दबाव में नहीं छीना जा सकता।

positive_pole.definition_en: Civic Order & Security (+1.0): Social stability, public safety, and peace justify rigorous limits on liberty.
positive_pole.definition_hi: सामाजिक व्यवस्था व सुरक्षा (+1.0): स्थिरता और लोक-सुरक्षा के लिए व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता पर अंकुश उचित है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: When individual liberty conflicts with collective security and civic order, which must yield?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: The Tri-Axial Freedom Defense: D07 addresses the physical/coercive scope of state and social regulation.

negative_pole.definition_en: Preservation of Tradition (-1.0): Inherited customs, cultural wisdom, and evolutionary institutions are superior.
negative_pole.definition_hi: परंपरा संरक्षण (-1.0): ऐतिहासिक रूप से विकसित रीति-रिवाज और संस्थाएं बौद्धिक योजनाओं से श्रेष्ठ हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Transformative Reform (+1.0): Past customs encode injustice; society must be redesigned through rational innovation.
positive_pole.definition_hi: क्रांतिकारी सुधार (+1.0): पुरानी परंपराएं अन्याय को पोषित करती हैं; समाज का पुनर्गठन आवश्यक है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Should civil society revere and preserve historical customs, or overturn inherited traditions to establish rational justice?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D08 measures institutional continuity vs reform, distinct from broader civilizational technological development (D21).

negative_pole.definition_en: Centralized Governance (-1.0): Strong sovereign leadership and unified legal centers are vital for stability.
negative_pole.definition_hi: केंद्रीकृत शासन (-1.0): स्थिरता और न्याय के लिए मजबूत संप्रभु नेतृत्व और एकीकृत संस्थाएं आवश्यक हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Distributed Subsidiarity (+1.0): Decisions and authority must reside at the most localized autonomous tier possible.
positive_pole.definition_hi: विकेंद्रीकरण (-1.0): निर्णय और अधिकार यथासंभव स्थानीय और स्वायत्त स्तर पर रहने चाहिए।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Where should administrative and political power reside: in centralized sovereign bodies or decentralized local communities?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D09 addresses geographical and administrative tiering of authority, distinct from interpersonal autonomy (D02).

negative_pole.definition_en: Universal Standards (-1.0): Human rights, constitutional justice, and scientific laws apply identically everywhere.
negative_pole.definition_hi: सार्वभौमिक मानक (-1.0): न्याय, मानवाधिकार और नियम सभी संस्कृतियों और सीमाओं के पार समान रूप से लागू होते हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Contextual Particularity (+1.0): Norms, law, and justice must reflect unique historical lineages and local cultures.
positive_pole.definition_hi: स्थानीय विशिष्टता (+1.0): नियम और मूल्य विशिष्ट ऐतिहासिक परंपराओं और स्थानीय संदर्भों पर निर्भर होने चाहिए।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Are fundamental legal and social norms universal across all humanity, or legitimately contingent on cultural particularity?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D10 isolates procedural and political universalism from metaphysical moral objectivism (D18).

negative_pole.definition_en: Empirical Naturalism (-1.0): Reality consists entirely of physical, sensible phenomena accessible to scientific inquiry.
negative_pole.definition_hi: अनुभवजन्य प्रकृतिवाद (-1.0): वास्तविकता पूरी तरह से भौतिक और इंद्रियगोचर घटनाओं से मिलकर बनी है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Transcendent Metaphysics (+1.0): Ultimate reality includes divine orders, non-physical realms, or sacred ontologies.
positive_pole.definition_hi: पारलौकिक तत्वमीमांसा (+1.0): वास्तविक अस्तित्व में दिव्य व्यवस्थाएं और गैर-भौतिक आयाम शामिल हैं।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is all reality exhausted by the natural, sensible, physical universe, or does it include transcendent metaphysical dimensions?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D11 measures empirical naturalism vs transcendent reality, distinct from the mind-matter debate (D13).

negative_pole.definition_en: Discursive Rationalism (-1.0): Truth is established strictly through logic, conceptual analysis, and empirical proof.
negative_pole.definition_hi: तार्किक विवेकवाद (-1.0): सत्य की प्राप्ति केवल कठोर तर्क, वैचारिक विश्लेषण और प्रमाण से होती है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Intuitive Gnosis (+1.0): Highest truth is attained through contemplative insight, mystical awareness, or direct intuition.
positive_pole.definition_hi: प्रत्यक्ष अंतर्ज्ञान (+1.0): सर्वोच्च सत्य की अनुभूति ध्यान, रहस्यवादी चेतना या प्रत्यक्ष आंतरिक बोध से होती है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is genuine knowledge accessed through discursive logic and empirical test, or through direct experiential intuition and contemplation?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D12 measures epistemic methodology (rationalism vs intuition), distinct from attitudes toward certainty and fallibility (D14).

negative_pole.definition_en: Physicalist Materialism (-1.0): Matter and physical forces are primary; consciousness is an emergent epiphenomenon.
negative_pole.definition_hi: भौतिकवाद (-1.0): पदार्थ और भौतिक बल ही प्राथमिक हैं; चेतना मस्तिष्क का एक उप-उत्पाद है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Idealism / Mind Primacy (+1.0): Consciousness, mind, or spiritual principle is foundational; reality is an expression of mind.
positive_pole.definition_hi: विचारवाद / चेतना प्रधानता (+1.0): चेतना या मन ही मूलभूत सत्य है; भौतिक ब्रह्मांड इसी का प्रकटीकरण है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: What is primary in the architecture of reality: unconscious matter and fields, or foundational consciousness and mind?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D13 isolates the ontological substance debate (materialism vs idealism) from empirical vs transcendent detection (D11).

negative_pole.definition_en: Critical Fallibilism (-1.0): All human knowledge claims are provisional, revisable, and subject to skepticism.
negative_pole.definition_hi: आलोचनात्मक विनम्रता (-1.0): मानव ज्ञान के सभी दावे अनंतिम, सुधार योग्य और संशय के अधीन हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Foundational Certainty (+1.0): Core truths are absolute, indubitable, revealed, or immutable, forming an unshakeable bedrock.
positive_pole.definition_hi: सैद्धांतिक निश्चयता (+1.0): मूल सत्य निरपेक्ष, असंदिग्ध, प्रकट या अपरिवर्तनीय हैं।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Can human knowledge attain absolute, indubitable certainty, or must all claims remain provisional and fallible?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D14 isolates epistemic attitude toward error from the method used to acquire knowledge (D12).

negative_pole.definition_en: Analytical Reductionism (-1.0): Complex wholes are fully understood by reducing them to fundamental parts and mechanisms.
negative_pole.definition_hi: विश्लेषणात्मक न्यूनतावाद (-1.0): जटिल प्रणालियों को उनके मूल घटकों और क्रियाविधियों में तोड़कर समझा जा सकता है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Emergent Holism (+1.0): The whole is greater than the sum of parts; complex systems possess irreducible emergent properties.
positive_pole.definition_hi: समग्रतावाद (+1.0): संपूर्ण अपने घटकों के योग से अधिक है; जटिल प्रणालियों में नए गुण उभरते हैं।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Are complex systems best explained by reducing them to elemental parts, or by analyzing irreducible systemic wholes?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D15 is the critical boundary separator between naturalism with emergent ecology (C11) and mechanistic reductionism (C15).

negative_pole.definition_en: Teleological Consequences (-1.0): Moral worth is determined strictly by tangible real-world outcomes and utility produced.
negative_pole.definition_hi: परिणामवाद (-1.0): किसी कर्म का नैतिक मूल्य केवल उसके परिणामों, उपयोगिता और कष्ट निवारण से तय होता है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Deontological Duty (+1.0): Acts are intrinsically right or wrong based on duty, universal rules, or categorical moral law.
positive_pole.definition_hi: कर्तव्यवाद (+1.0): कर्म अपने आप में सही या गलत होते हैं; नैतिक नियमों का पालन परिणामों से ऊपर है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is the morality of an action judged entirely by its real-world consequences, or by inherent adherence to moral duty?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D16 concerns the criterion of right action, distinct from relational empathy (D17) or moral authorship (D19).

dimensions.name_hi: सहानुभूति व रिश्ते बनाम निष्पक्ष न्याय

negative_pole.definition_en: Contextual Care Ethics (-1.0): Morality is centered on personal relationships, empathy, compassion, and concrete care.
negative_pole.definition_hi: सहानुभूतिपरक नैतिकता (-1.0): नैतिकता व्यक्तिगत संबंधों, करुणा और विशिष्ट परिस्थितियों में देखभाल पर केंद्रित है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Impartial Rational Justice (+1.0): Morality requires impersonal fairness, equal rules, and objective rights applied without bias.
positive_pole.definition_hi: निष्पक्ष तर्कसंगत न्याय (+1.0): नैतिकता निष्पक्षता, समान अधिकारों और बिना पक्षपात के सार्वभौमिक नियमों की मांग करती है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Should moral decisions prioritize personal compassion and specific relationships, or detached, impartial justice?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D17 measures empathy/care vs impartial fairness, distinct from structural status equality (D06).

negative_pole.definition_en: Objective Moral Truth (-1.0): Moral facts exist independently of human opinion, culture, or historical epoch.
negative_pole.definition_hi: वस्तुनिष्ठ नैतिक सत्य (-1.0): नैतिक सत्य मानवीय राय, संस्कृति या इतिहास से स्वतंत्र रूप से अस्तित्व में हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Constructed / Relativist Morality (+1.0): Values are human conventions, cultural artifacts, or subjective evolutionary tools.
positive_pole.definition_hi: सापेक्षतावादी नैतिकता (+1.0): मूल्य मानवीय समझौते, सांस्कृतिक परंपराएं या व्यक्तिपरक उत्पाद हैं।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Do moral values exist as objective, cross-cultural truths, or are they cultural conventions constructed by human societies?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D18 addresses metaphysical meta-ethics, distinct from legal/political standardization (D10).

dimensions.name_hi: बाह्य दैवीय नियम बनाम आत्म-निर्मित नैतिकता

negative_pole.definition_en: Heteronomous Law (-1.0): Moral law is received from an external source—divine command, cosmic order, or ancestral edict.
negative_pole.definition_hi: बाह्य नियम (-1.0): नैतिक नियम किसी बाहरी स्रोत—ईश्वरीय आज्ञा, प्राकृतिक नियम या पूर्वजों—से प्राप्त होते हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Autonomous Self-Authorship (+1.0): The moral agent actively creates, authors, or freely validates their own values.
positive_pole.definition_hi: आत्म-निर्मित नैतिकता (+1.0): व्यक्ति अपने जीवन-मूल्यों और नैतिक निर्णयों का स्वयं अंतिम निर्माता है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Are moral commands legitimately received from an external sacred/cosmic authority, or self-authored by the autonomous agent?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: The Tri-Axial Freedom Defense: D19 isolates moral authorship from institutional obedience (D02) and free will (D25).

negative_pole.definition_en: Human Exclusivity (-1.0): Humans possess unique, privileged moral standing; nature serves human flourishing.
negative_pole.definition_hi: मानव-केंद्रित मूल्य (-1.0): मनुष्य अद्वितीय नैतिक महत्व रखता है; प्रकृति मानव उत्कर्ष का साधन है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Biocentric / Ecocentric Value (+1.0): Ecosystems and non-human beings possess intrinsic moral value equal to humans.
positive_pole.definition_hi: जैव-केंद्रित मूल्य (+1.0): संपूर्ण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र और सभी जीवों का अंतर्निहित मूल्य है, जो मनुष्य के बराबर है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Does nature exist primarily as a resource for human flourishing, or does it possess intrinsic moral considerability?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D20 addresses moral considerability, distinct from the civilizational relationship to ecology (D24).

negative_pole.definition_en: Unbound Progress (-1.0): Technology, scientific conquest, and economic growth are the primary engines of emancipation.
negative_pole.definition_hi: तकनीकी प्रगतिवाद (-1.0): विज्ञान, तकनीक और आर्थिक विकास ही मानव मुक्ति और समृद्धि के मुख्य साधन हैं।

positive_pole.definition_en: Ecological Restraint / Primitivism (+1.0): Technological expansion disrupts natural ecology; wisdom demands simple restraint.
positive_pole.definition_hi: प्रकृति संरक्षण / सादगी (+1.0): अंधाधुंध तकनीकी विकास जीवन और प्रकृति को नष्ट करता है; सादगी और संयम आवश्यक है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is human civilization advanced primarily through accelerated technological expansion, or through ecological restraint and simplicity?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D21 measures civilizational technological trajectory, distinct from institutional continuity with the past (D08).

negative_pole.definition_en: Existential Creation (-1.0): The cosmos is indifferent; meaning must be courageously invented by human consciousness.
negative_pole.definition_hi: रचित सार्थकता (-1.0): ब्रह्मांड में कोई पूर्वनिर्धारित उद्देश्य नहीं है; मनुष्य को अपना अर्थ स्वयं रचना होगा।

positive_pole.definition_en: Cosmic Teleology (+1.0): The universe has an inherent purpose or divine trajectory that humans are called to discover.
positive_pole.definition_hi: पूर्वनिर्धारित उद्देश्य (+1.0): ब्रह्मांड का एक अंतर्निहित दिव्य उद्देश्य है जिसे खोजना और जिसके अनुरूप जीना चाहिए।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is existential meaning an invention of conscious human minds, or a pre-existing cosmic teleology to be discovered?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D22 measures existential purpose and cosmic teleology, distinct from the locus of bodily vs spiritual fulfillment (D05).

negative_pole.definition_en: Utopian Meliorism (-1.0): Human society is fundamentally improvable; humanity can eliminate war, poverty, and suffering.
negative_pole.definition_hi: ऐतिहासिक आशावाद (-1.0): मानव समाज में निरंतर सुधार संभव है; गरीबी, युद्ध और अज्ञान को मिटाया जा सकता है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Tragic Realism / Cyclical Decline (+1.0): Conflict, suffering, and civilizational decline are inescapable features of human existence.
positive_pole.definition_hi: दुखद यथार्थवाद (+1.0): संघर्ष और सभ्यतागत पतन मानव अस्तित्व के स्थायी पहलू हैं; पूर्ण यूटोपिया असंभव है।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Is human civilizational history a trajectory of continuous moral improvement, or constrained by cyclical tragic decline?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D23 isolates historical macro-trajectory from innate human plasticity (D03) and existential agency (D25).

dimensions.name_hi: प्रकृति पर विजय बनाम सामंजस्यपूर्ण तालमेल

negative_pole.definition_en: Promethean Mastery (-1.0): Humanity should actively terraform, domesticate, engineer, and conquer the physical world.
negative_pole.definition_hi: प्रकृति पर विजय (-1.0): मानवता को अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए प्रकृति पर नियंत्रण, इंजीनियरिंग और रूपांतरण करना चाहिए।

positive_pole.definition_en: Harmonious Integration (+1.0): Humanity should flow, harmonize with, and yield to organic natural cycles.
positive_pole.definition_hi: सामंजस्यपूर्ण तालमेल (+1.0): मनुष्य को प्रकृति के साथ तालमेल बिठाना चाहिए और आक्रामक छेड़छाड़ से बचना चाहिए।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Should humanity assert active Promethean control over natural forces, or harmonize and yield to ecological cycles?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: D24 evaluates physical/civilizational action toward nature, distinct from moral value attribution (D20).

negative_pole.definition_en: Radical Agency (-1.0): Human will is unconstrained and undetermined; individuals bear total responsibility for choices.
negative_pole.definition_hi: स्वतंत्र इच्छाशक्ति (-1.0): मानवीय इच्छाशक्ति स्वतंत्र है; व्यक्ति अपने प्रत्येक निर्णय के लिए पूरी तरह उत्तरदायी है।

positive_pole.definition_en: Strict Determinism / Karma / Fate (+1.0): Human action is completely conditioned by causal physics, divine predestination, or karma.
positive_pole.definition_hi: कठोर नियतिवाद / कर्मफल (+1.0): मानवीय कर्म भौतिक नियमों, ईश्वरीय विधान या पूर्व-निर्धारित प्रारब्ध से बंधे हैं।

dimensions.core_philosophical_question: Do human beings possess authentic unconditioned metaphysical free will, or are choices determined by causal necessity and fate?
dimensions.boundary_defense_rule: The Tri-Axial Freedom Defense: D25 evaluates metaphysical causality, completely distinct from institutional authority (D02) and societal liberty (D07).

clusters.defining_tension_en: Prioritizes individual moral authorship and self-determination over unchosen collective duties.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सामूहिक दायित्वों या व्यवस्था की तुलना में व्यक्तिगत आत्म-निर्णय और नैतिक स्वायत्तता को प्राथमिकता देता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C01 centers the existential sovereignty of the person; C04 centers contractual legal governance.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Centers bodily flourishing, science, and democratic well-being in earthly life.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: पारलौकिक उद्देश्यों को नकारकर इसी जीवन में विज्ञान, तर्क और मानव कल्याण को केंद्र में रखता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C02 centers eudaimonistic welfare in this life; C11 centers empirical ontology of nature.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Existence precedes essence; humans must author their own purpose in an unscripted cosmos.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: अस्तित्व सार से पहले है; मनुष्य को इस अर्थहीन ब्रह्मांड में अपने अर्थ का निर्माण स्वयं करना होता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C03 centers courageous meaning creation in the absurd; C01 centers political and moral sovereignty.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Social coordination based strictly on consent, property rights, and procedural justice.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सामाजिक व्यवस्था केवल सहमति, संपत्ति के अधिकार, स्वैच्छिक अनुबंध और न्यूनतम राज्य पर आधारित होनी चाहिए।
clusters.boundary_defense: C04 centers institutional decentralization and property law; C01 centers personal existential authenticity.

clusters.defining_tension_en: The person possesses infinite dignity that can never be subordinated to utility or systems.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का असीम और पवित्र नैतिक मूल्य है जिसे किसी उपयोगिता या व्यवस्था के लिए नहीं त्यागा जा सकता।
clusters.boundary_defense: C05 affirms relational sacred dignity; C01 affirms atomistic self-interest and radical independence.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Rejects the unencumbered self; flourishing is constituted within shared communal life.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: अलग-थलग व्यक्तिवाद को नकारकर मानता है कि मानवीय पहचान और उत्कर्ष समुदाय के भीतर ही संभव है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C06 centers reciprocal civic solidarity; C08 centers sacred inherited lineage and ancestral customs.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Freedom is active participation in a self-governing republic protected against tyranny.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: स्वतंत्रता केवल गैर-हस्तक्षेप नहीं है, बल्कि एक आत्म-शासित गणतंत्र में सक्रिय नागरिक भागीदारी है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C07 centers anti-oligarchic civic duty and political liberty; C09 centers centralized state planning.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Preserves communal harmony through sacred ancestral lineage and customary obligations.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सामुदायिक जीवन को पवित्र कुल-परंपराओं, पूर्वजों के ज्ञान और वंशानुगत कर्तव्यों से सुरक्षित रखता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C08 mandates inherited customary traditions; C06 can adapt to modern democratic communities.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Coordinates all resources and citizens under sovereign authority for collective destiny.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सामूहिक उद्देश्य या राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा के लिए संप्रभु सत्ता के अधीन केंद्रीकृत नियंत्रण को अनिवार्य मानता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C09 coordinates for state mobilization; C10 coordinates for stability of permanent differentiated social ranks.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Order and excellence depend on enduring institutions, constitutional roles, and established authority.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सामाजिक व्यवस्था और न्याय स्थायी संस्थाओं, स्थापित मर्यादाओं और स्पष्ट पदानुक्रम पर निर्भर करते हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C10 centers differentiated constitutional continuity; C09 centers radical centralized state mobilization.

clusters.defining_tension_en: The sensible natural world accessible to empirical science constitutes all real existence.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: प्राकृतिक और इंद्रियगोचर जगत, जो विज्ञान द्वारा मापा जा सकता है, वही संपूर्ण वास्तविक अस्तित्व है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C11 embraces emergent systemic wholes and ecological complexity; C15 mandates strict particle reductionism.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Conceptual clarity, logic, and rigorous formal decomposition are the benchmarks of truth.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: वैचारिक स्पष्टता, तार्किक विश्लेषण और कठोर गणितीय प्रमाण ही सत्य और ज्ञान के बुनियादी मानक हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C12 centers formal deduction and logic; C13 centers practical experimentation and instrumental consequences.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Judges ideas and institutions by practical consequences, experimental problem-solving, and fruitfulness.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: विचारों और संस्थाओं का मूल्यांकन उनके व्यावहारिक परिणामों और जीवन की समस्याओं को सुलझाने की क्षमता से करता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C13 asks 'What works in practice?'; C25 asks 'How can evolving complex frameworks adapt together?'.

clusters.defining_tension_en: All knowledge claims and institutions are historically situated, provisional, and subject to critique.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: मानव ज्ञान के सभी दावे और सामाजिक व्यवस्थाएं अनंतिम, सत्ता-प्रभावित और सतत संशोधन के योग्य हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C14 focuses on socio-epistemic power critique and fallibility; C12 focuses on formal logical validation.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Complex phenomena are fully explainable by fundamental physical components and causal mechanics.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: चेतना, जीवन और समाज सहित सभी जटिल परिघटनाओं को भौतिक घटकों और यांत्रिक नियमों में तोड़ा जा सकता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C15 mandates strict atomistic decomposition (D15=-1.0); C11 accepts macroscopic emergent systems.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Divine revelation and sacred scripture represent eternal truths governing life and order.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: ईश्वरीय संदेश और पवित्र ग्रंथ सनातन सत्य हैं जो मानव जीवन और समाज को दिशा देते हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C16 grounds universal morality in sacred revelation and dogma; C19 grounds it in natural human reason.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Ultimate reality transcends language, accessible through contemplative awareness and spiritual union.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: परम सत्य बौद्धिक शब्दों से परे है, जिसे प्रत्यक्ष ध्यान, आत्म-साक्षात्कार और एकत्व से जाना जा सकता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C17 is an experiential path of unitive gnosis; C18 is an ontological system of mind-first metaphysics.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Mind, idea, or consciousness is the fundamental fabric of reality; the cosmos is an expression of mind.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: चेतना या विचार ही अस्तित्व का मूल आधार है; संपूर्ण भौतिक जगत मन या आत्म-चेतना का ही प्रकटीकरण है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C18 centers the ontological primacy of mind; C17 centers the meditative practice of experiential transcendence.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Universal moral laws are woven into the rational fabric of nature and discoverable by human reason.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: सार्वभौमिक नैतिक नियम प्रकृति की तर्कसंगत व्यवस्था में अंतर्निहित हैं और मानव विवेक द्वारा जाने जा सकते हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C19 derives objective duty through rational philosophy; C16 derives it through historical sectarian revelation.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Diverse spiritual paths represent contextual facets of an inexhaustible, common transcendent truth.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: दुनिया के विभिन्न धर्म और आध्यात्मिक धाराएं एक ही असीम सत्य के अलग-अलग सांस्कृतिक प्रकटीकरण हैं।
clusters.boundary_defense: C20 embraces ecumenical syncretism and tolerance; C16 enforces exclusive scriptural orthodoxy.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Humans are interconnected members of the biotic community; all ecosystems possess intrinsic rights.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: मनुष्य पृथ्वी के जैव-समुदाय का अभिन्न अंग है; सभी पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों का अपना आंतरिक नैतिक मूल्य है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C21 rejects human primacy in favor of biocentrism; C22 preserves nature as a vital generational trust.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Civilization has a solemn intergenerational duty to preserve natural endowments and cultural inheritance.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: मानव सभ्यता का यह नैतिक कर्तव्य है कि वह प्राकृतिक संपदा और सांस्कृतिक धरोहर को आने वाली पीढ़ियों के लिए बचाए।
clusters.boundary_defense: C22 centers human responsibility and heritage conservation; C21 centers egalitarian rights of all non-human life.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Human biological and planetary limitations can be transcended through computing, biotech, and AI.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: विज्ञान, कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) और बायोटेक के माध्यम से मानव शरीर और जैविक सीमाओं को पार किया जा सकता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C23 pursues radical morphological and cosmic enhancement; C24 pursues institutional and social reform.

clusters.defining_tension_en: History exhibits moral progress achieved through democratic reform, education, and human rights.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: मानव इतिहास तर्कसंगत सुधारों, लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं, शिक्षा और मानवाधिकारों के जरिए निरंतर आगे बढ़ता है।
clusters.boundary_defense: C24 centers socio-political meliorism; C23 centers technological and post-biological enhancement.

clusters.defining_tension_en: Societies must dynamically navigate competing perspectives through metamodern adaptive learning networks.
clusters.defining_tension_hi: समाज को जटिल, बहुआयामी चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए विभिन्न दृष्टिकोणों का लचीला और अनुकूली समन्वय करना चाहिए।
clusters.boundary_defense: C25 centers systemic evolutionary learning across paradigms; C13 centers direct instrumental problem-solving.

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Oracular revelation, temple divination, and cuneiform scribal interpretation of cosmic decrees (Me).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Epic of Gilgamesh (-2100); The Descent of Inanna (-2000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Enheduanna: Queen of all the cosmic powers, radiant light, righteous woman clothed in brilliance.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ancient Mesopotamian temple religion structured around serving divine cosmic forces (Me) through civic hierarchy and temple administration.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन मेसोपोटामियाई मंदिर धर्म, जो दिव्य ब्रह्मांडीय आदेश (मे) और नगर-राज्य व्यवस्था पर केंद्रित था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ancient Mesopotamian temple religion structured around serving divine cosmic forces (Me) through civic hierarchy and temple administration.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्राचीन मेसोपोटामियाई मंदिर धर्म, जो दिव्य ब्रह्मांडीय आदेश (मे) और नगर-राज्य व्यवस्था पर केंद्रित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: Development of the world's earliest cuneiform temple economy and administrative writing; Establishment of the Ziggurat cosmic axis mundi architecture in southern Mesopotamia; Codification of primordial divine decrees (Me) governing civilization and human crafts

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Cuneiform alphabetic scribal transmission, mythic epic performance, and royal ritual divination.

worldviews.famous_quote: Baal Cycle Tablet: Baal sits upon his mountain, the god of storm and thunder, his voice thunders in the clouds.
worldviews.short_description_en: West Semitic coastal mythology depicting the cyclical cosmic conflict between Baal (Storm/Life) and Mot (Death/Aridity).
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन कनानी तटीय पौराणिक परंपरा, जो बाल (जीवन/तूफान) और मोत (मृत्यु) के बीच ब्रह्मांडीय संतुलन को दर्शाती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: West Semitic coastal mythology depicting the cyclical cosmic conflict between Baal (Storm/Life) and Mot (Death/Aridity).
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्राचीन कनानी तटीय पौराणिक परंपरा, जो बाल (जीवन/तूफान) और मोत (मृत्यु) के बीच ब्रह्मांडीय संतुलन को दर्शाती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Invention and utilization of one of history's earliest cuneiform alphabetic scripts; Literary preservation of Canaanite storm-god and death-god mythic cycles; Crucial linguistic and structural precursor to Biblical Hebrew poetic and prophetic forms

worldviews.historical_associations: Dynastic succession myths of gods that heavily influenced Hesiod's Greek Theogony; Cultural bridge connecting Mesopotamian theology to the Aegean basin via Hittite mediation; Mitanni kingdom religious diplomacy with New Kingdom Egypt

worldviews.short_description_en: Metaphysical philosophy positing that non-physical Forms represent the most accurate, eternal reality beyond sensory illusion.

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Empirical observation, logical deduction (syllogism), and induction from sensible particulars.

worldviews.short_description_en: Teleological ethical framework focusing on moral habituation, character development, and human flourishing (Eudaimonia).

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Canonic (sensory perception as the ultimate criterion of truth, alongside feelings of pleasure/pain).

worldviews.historical_associations: Establishment of 'The Garden' community in Athens admitting women and enslaved people on equal footing; The rediscovery of Lucretius's poem in 1417, fueling Enlightenment materialism; Providing a foundational philosophical critique of religious fear and supernaturalism

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Anti-dogmatic sensory critique, living directly according to nature (kata physin), and stripping away social convention.

worldviews.famous_quote: Diogenes of Sinope: I am a citizen of the world (Cosmopolitan).
worldviews.short_description_en: Radical philosophy advocating for complete virtue in harmony with nature through total rejection of societal luxuries and conventions.
worldviews.short_description_hi: डायोजनीज का दर्शन, जो सामाजिक आडंबरों, धन और सत्ता का त्याग कर पूर्ण प्राकृतिक सरलता और बेबाक स्वतंत्रता सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Radical philosophy advocating for complete virtue in harmony with nature through total rejection of societal luxuries and conventions.
worldviews.full_description_hi: डायोजनीज का दर्शन, जो सामाजिक आडंबरों, धन और सत्ता का त्याग कर पूर्ण प्राकृतिक सरलता और बेबाक स्वतंत्रता सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The radical public rejection of social convention, wealth, and political power in classical Greece; Coining the original concept of cosmopolitanism (citizenship of the cosmos rather than the city-state); Acting as a direct philosophical precursor to early Stoic ethics and radical ascetic movements

worldviews.short_description_hi: संदेहवादी पद्धति, जो सभी बौद्धिक सिद्धांतों पर निर्णय को स्थगित (Epoché) कर मानसिक शांति प्राप्त करने की वकालत करती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Epistemological method that suspends dogmatic judgment (Epoché) on all non-evident matters to achieve mental tranquility (Ataraxia).
worldviews.full_description_hi: संदेहवादी पद्धति, जो सभी बौद्धिक सिद्धांतों पर निर्णय को स्थगित (Epoché) कर मानसिक शांति प्राप्त करने की वकालत करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Pyrrho's formative philosophical journey to India alongside Alexander the Great's campaign; Systematization of the Ten Tropes of Epoché to quiet intellectual anxiety; Renaissance rediscovery profoundly shaping modern scientific method and Cartesian doubt

worldviews.historical_associations: The skeptical turn of Plato's Academy challenging Stoic dogmatic epistemology; Carneades' legendary philosophical embassy to Rome debating justice before the Senate; Bridging classical Greek inquiry into Roman rhetorical and legal philosophy via Cicero

worldviews.historical_associations: The systematic synthesis of Greek philosophy into a mystical theology of emanation from 'The One'; The integration of theurgy and late-pagan ritual into philosophical contemplation; Serving as the metaphysical bridge for Islamic Falsafa, Renaissance humanism, and Jewish Kabbalah

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Isaac the Blind / Moses de León / Isaac Luria
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Esoteric scriptural exegesis (Pardes / Sod), contemplative ascent through the Sefirot, and divine revelation.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Zohar (1280); Etz Chaim (Tree of Life) (1573)
worldviews.famous_quote: Isaac Luria: There are sparks of holy light trapped in all of material creation; our task is to liberate them through righteous action (Tikkun Olam).
worldviews.short_description_en: Esoteric Jewish mysticism exploring the infinite Godhead (Ein Sof), ten emanated Sefirot, and the cosmic repair of reality (Tikkun).
worldviews.short_description_hi: यहूदी रहस्यवादी दर्शन, जो अनंत ईश्वर (Ein Sof), दस दिव्य शक्तियों (सेफिरोत) और ब्रह्मांड की खोई हुई पवित्रता की बहाली (Tikkun) का अध्ययन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric Jewish mysticism exploring the infinite Godhead (Ein Sof), ten emanated Sefirot, and the cosmic repair of reality (Tikkun).
worldviews.full_description_hi: यहूदी रहस्यवादी दर्शन, जो अनंत ईश्वर (Ein Sof), दस दिव्य शक्तियों (सेफिरोत) और ब्रह्मांड की खोई हुई पवित्रता की बहाली (Tikkun) का अध्ययन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Compilation of the Sefer Yetzirah and Zoharic literature in medieval Iberia; The 16th-century mystical renaissance in Safed establishing Lurianic cosmology; Serving as the mystical heartbeat of the 18th-century Hasidic movement in Eastern Europe

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Gnostic illumination, divine revelation from Nous, and analogical correspondence (macrocosm/microcosm).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Corpus Hermeticum (200); The Emerald Tablet (700)
worldviews.famous_quote: The Emerald Tablet: That which is Below corresponds to that which is Above, and that which is Above corresponds to that which is Below, to accomplish the miracles of the One Thing.
worldviews.short_description_en: Hellenistic philosophical-esoteric tradition emphasizing the oneness of Mind (Nous), cosmic sympathy, and spiritual transmutation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मिस्र और यूनान के समन्वय से जन्मा गूढ़ दर्शन, जो 'जैसा ऊपर वैसा नीचे' (As above, so below) और मन की शक्ति से आत्म-रूपांतरण सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Hellenistic philosophical-esoteric tradition emphasizing the oneness of Mind (Nous), cosmic sympathy, and spiritual transmutation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मिस्र और यूनान के समन्वय से जन्मा गूढ़ दर्शन, जो 'जैसा ऊपर वैसा नीचे' (As above, so below) और मन की शक्ति से आत्म-रूपांतरण सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1460 Florentine rediscovery and translation of the Corpus Hermeticum by Marsilio Ficino; Direct philosophical inspiration for the Scientific Revolution through figures like Isaac Newton; Serving as the bedrock framework for Rosicrucianism, Freemasonry, and modern Western ceremonial magic

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Christian-Hermetic revelation, natural philosophy, alchemical illumination, and inner spiritual awakening.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fama Fraternitatis (1614); Confessio Fraternitatis (1615)
worldviews.famous_quote: Fama Fraternitatis: God hath certainly and most assuredly concluded to send to the world before her end a truth, light, life, and glory.
worldviews.short_description_en: Hermetic-Christian esoteric movement seeking universal spiritual enlightenment, alchemical regeneration, and healing.

worldviews.full_description_en: Hermetic-Christian esoteric movement seeking universal spiritual enlightenment, alchemical regeneration, and healing.
worldviews.full_description_hi: 17वीं शताब्दी का गूढ़ आंदोलन, जो रसायन विद्या, ईसाई रहस्यवाद और सार्वभौमिक वैज्ञानिक व आध्यात्मिक सुधार का आह्वान करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 17th-century 'Rosicrucian Enlightenment' manifestos calling for a universal reformation of arts and sciences; Pioneering early synthesis of laboratory alchemy, Christian mysticism, and early empirical science; Establishment of major modern international fraternal and mystical teaching orders

worldviews.historical_associations: The 19th-century introduction of Eastern philosophical frameworks (Karma, Reincarnation) to the Western world; Key leadership roles in the Indian independence movement and Buddhist educational revival in Sri Lanka; Serving as a direct catalyst for modern New Age spirituality and abstract modern art

worldviews.historical_associations: The founding of the worldwide Waldorf (Steiner) school education system; The invention of Biodynamic agriculture, marking the birth of modern organic farming methods; Development of Anthroposophic medicine, curative education, and Eurythmy art

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Esoteric Christian initiation, theurgic prayer, and internal mystical awakening via the 'Way of the Heart'.

worldviews.historical_associations: The Élus Coëns theurgic operational rituals of divine reconciliation in 18th-century France; The interiorized 'Way of the Heart' mystical philosophy of Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin; The 1891 revival by Papus in Belle Époque Paris bridging Masonic networks with Christian esotericism

worldviews.full_description_en: Dual operative-laboratory and spiritual tradition seeking the transformation of base matter and spirit into perfection (The Philosopher's Stone).

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Mathematical mysticism, numerical proportion, sacred geometry, and ascetic purification of the soul.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Introduction to Arithmetic (Nicomachus) (100); Life of Apollonius of Tyana (Philostratus) (220)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nicomachus of Gerasa: All things that have been constructed by nature seem both in their parts and in their entirety to have been determined by number.
worldviews.short_description_en: Revival of Pythagorean mystical philosophy positing numbers and geometric ratios as the divine blueprint of the universe.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पाइथागोरस का पुनर्जीवित दर्शन, जो संख्याओं, ज्यामिति और गणितीय सामंजस्य (Harmony of the Spheres) को ब्रह्मांड का आधार मानता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Revival of Pythagorean mystical philosophy positing numbers and geometric ratios as the divine blueprint of the universe.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पाइथागोरस का पुनर्जीवित दर्शन, जो संख्याओं, ज्यामिति और गणितीय सामंजस्य (Harmony of the Spheres) को ब्रह्मांड का आधार मानता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The revival of Pythagorean mathematical mysticism in Hellenistic Rome and Alexandria; The legendary ascetic and miracle-working life of Apollonius of Tyana, often compared by contemporaries to early Christian figures; Formulating the sacred geometry and the Quadrivium curriculum that shaped medieval European architecture and thought

worldviews.full_description_en: Absolute non-dualism asserting that the material world is illusory (Maya) and individual consciousness (Atman) is identical to Brahman.
worldviews.full_description_hi: शंकरचार्य का अद्वैत मत, जो संसार को व्यावहारिक सत्य (माया) व जीवात्मा व परमात्मा को पूर्ण रूप से एक मानता है.
worldviews.historical_associations: Establishment of the four Mathas across the four corners of India by Adi Shankara; Historic philosophical debates (Shastrartha) against Mimamsa and Buddhist scholars; The 19th-century Neo-Vedanta revival introducing non-dualism to the Western world at the 1893 Parliament of Religions

worldviews.short_description_hi: मध्वाचार्य का द्वैत वेदांत, जो ईश्वर, जीव और प्रकृति के बीच पूर्ण और वास्तविक भिन्नता (भेद) को स्थापित करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Strict ontological dualism asserting absolute distinction between God (Vishnu), individual souls, and material reality.

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pratyaksha (perception), Anumana (inference), and Aptavacana (reliable testimony).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Samkhya Karika (350); Tattva Samasa (-300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Samkhya Karika: Not any spirit is bound, nor does any migrate, nor is any released; it is Prakriti alone that is bound, migrates, and is released.
worldviews.short_description_en: Dualistic realist philosophy dividing reality into Purusha (pure consciousness) and Prakriti (matter/mind complex).
worldviews.short_description_hi: कपिल मुनि द्वारा रचित सांख्य दर्शन, जो पुरुष (चेतना) और प्रकृति (जड़ जगत) के द्वैत पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Dualistic realist philosophy dividing reality into Purusha (pure consciousness) and Prakriti (matter/mind complex).
worldviews.full_description_hi: कपिल मुनि द्वारा रचित सांख्य दर्शन, जो पुरुष (चेतना) और प्रकृति (जड़ जगत) के द्वैत पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Formulation of the 25 tattvas (elements of reality) mapping cosmic evolution; Serving as the foundational metaphysical psychology and cosmology underlying Patanjali's Yoga; Early formulation of rational enumeration and analytical categorization in Indian philosophy

worldviews.historical_associations: Codification of the Eight Limbs (Ashtanga) of mental discipline and ethical restraint; Integration of personal devotion to Ishvara with Samkhya analytical dualism; The 20th-century global health, wellness, and mindfulness revolution

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Rigid formal logic (five-step syllogism) and atomistic realism across four valid means of knowledge.

worldviews.short_description_hi: न्याय और वैशेषिक दर्शन, जो तर्कशास्त्र, प्रमाण-शास्त्र और ब्रह्मांडीय परमाणवाद (Atomism) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Analytical school combining rigorous logic, epistemology (Nyaya), and pluralistic atomistic physics (Vaisheshika).
worldviews.full_description_hi: न्याय और वैशेषिक दर्शन, जो तर्कशास्त्र, प्रमाण-शास्त्र और ब्रह्मांडीय परमाणवाद (Atomism) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Development of sophisticated Indian formal logic, epistemology, and debate rules; Formulation of ancient Indian atomism (Parmanu) and categorical physics; The Navya-Nyaya school's linguistic-logical analysis influencing modern analytic philosophy

worldviews.historical_associations: Development of the world's most sophisticated linguistic, semantic, and legal hermeneutical rules; Systematic defense of Vedic ritual orthopraxy against Buddhist and Jain skepticism; Laying the textual and interpretive foundation for traditional Hindu jurisprudence (Dharma Shastra)

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Simultaneous scriptural validity of both difference and non-difference between soul and ultimate reality.

worldviews.famous_quote: Bhaskara: The soul is simultaneously identical with and different from Brahman, just as waves are identical with and different from the ocean.
worldviews.short_description_en: Vedantic view holding that individual souls and the world are simultaneously different and non-different from Brahman.
worldviews.short_description_hi: भेदाभेद दर्शन, जिसके अनुसार जीवात्मा और जगत ब्रह्म से एक साथ भिन्न भी हैं और अभिन्न भी (जैसे समुद्र और लहरें)।
worldviews.full_description_en: Vedantic view holding that individual souls and the world are simultaneously different and non-different from Brahman.
worldviews.full_description_hi: भेदाभेद दर्शन, जिसके अनुसार जीवात्मा और जगत ब्रह्म से एक साथ भिन्न भी हैं और अभिन्न भी (जैसे समुद्र और लहरें)।
worldviews.historical_associations: Acting as an important pre-Shankara and post-Shankara bridge in Vedantic dialectic; Influencing future devotional theologians who grappled with the paradox of divine immanence and transcendence; Providing an early philosophical model for simultaneous unity-in-diversity

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Tripartite reality of Pati (Lord), Pasu (Soul), and Pasa (Bondage), verified through Agama scriptures and grace.

worldviews.short_description_hi: दक्षिण भारत का शैव सिद्धांत, जो पति, पशु और पाश के भेद को मानते हुए शिव की कृपा से मोक्ष प्राप्ति का मार्ग बताता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Pluralistic devotional Shaivism from South India asserting that souls achieve liberation (Mukti) through divine grace (Arul) of Shiva.

worldviews.historical_associations: The 7th to 9th-century Nayanar saint movement that revitalized Tamil devotional culture; Codification of the canonical Tirumurai poetry corpus by Nambi Andar Nambi; Establishment of major stone temple architecture and monastic mutts across South India

worldviews.short_description_hi: महाराष्ट्र का वारकरी संप्रदाय, जो विठोबा की भक्ति, समतावादी विचारों और आषाढ़ी वारी पदयात्रा के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Egalitarian Marathi bhakti movement devoted to Vithoba of Pandharpur, celebrated through annual pilgrimages and poetry.
worldviews.full_description_hi: महाराष्ट्र का वारकरी संप्रदाय, जो विठोबा की भक्ति, समतावादी विचारों और आषाढ़ी वारी पदयात्रा के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Annual pilgrimage (Pandharpur Wari) where millions walk hundreds of miles singing Abhangas; Challenging rigid caste hierarchies by welcoming all strata of society into the devotional fold; The Marathi literary renaissance spearheaded by saint-poets breaking Sanskrit scholarly exclusivity

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Shuddhadvaita (pure non-dualism) verified through scriptural revelation and divine grace (Pushti).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Anubhashya (1520); Shatashloki (1500)

worldviews.short_description_en: Grace-based devotion (Pushtimarg) emphasizing unconditional divine nourishment and loving surrender to Shrinathji.
worldviews.short_description_hi: वल्लभाचार्य द्वारा स्थापित पुष्टिमार्ग, जो भगवत्कृपा (पुष्टि) और श्रीनाथजी की सेवा-पूजा को मुक्ति का मार्ग मानता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Grace-based devotion (Pushtimarg) emphasizing unconditional divine nourishment and loving surrender to Shrinathji.
worldviews.full_description_hi: वल्लभाचार्य द्वारा स्थापित पुष्टिमार्ग, जो भगवत्कृपा (पुष्टि) और श्रीनाथजी की सेवा-पूजा को मुक्ति का मार्ग मानता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Establishment of the principal deity Shrinathji in Nathdwara, Rajasthan; Development of elaborate aesthetic temple worship (Seva), food offerings, and classical Haveli music; Cultivation of the Sur Sagar poetry celebrating the childhood and youth of Krishna

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Prapatti (complete self-surrender) as an accessible alternative path to rigorous scriptural yoga.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Nalayira Divya Prabandham (950); Sri Vachana Bhushanam (1300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ramanujacharya: Surrender (Prapatti) at the lotus feet of Sriman Narayana and Sri is the definitive refuge for all souls.
worldviews.short_description_en: Devotional tradition centered on supreme surrender (Prapatti) to Narayana and Goddess Sri, integrating Tamil and Sanskrit theology.
worldviews.short_description_hi: श्री वैष्णव परंपरा, जो नारायण और देवी लक्ष्मी की उपासना तथा पूर्ण आत्मसमर्पण (प्रपत्ति) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Devotional tradition centered on supreme surrender (Prapatti) to Narayana and Goddess Sri, integrating Tamil and Sanskrit theology.
worldviews.full_description_hi: श्री वैष्णव परंपरा, जो नारायण और देवी लक्ष्मी की उपासना तथा पूर्ण आत्मसमर्पण (प्रपत्ति) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Collection and liturgical canonization of the Tamil Alvar saint poetry alongside Sanskrit Vedas; Formulation of total surrender (Prapatti / Nyasa Vidya) making liberation accessible across caste and gender; Management of premier South Indian shrines, including Srirangam and Tirupati

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Direct inner realization, rejection of external religious hypocrisy, scriptural authority, and caste boundaries.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Bijak of Kabir (1500); Kabir Granthavali (1500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Kabir Das: Mohi tohe lagi kaise chutai, ek lahu ekai ritu bhai (How shall our separation end? We are of one blood, one breath).
worldviews.short_description_en: Iconoclastic devotional movement founded by Kabir, rejecting caste, ritualism, and sectarian division for formless inner divine realization.
worldviews.short_description_hi: संत कबीर द्वारा स्थापित कबीर पंथ, जो जाति-पांति, बाहरी कर्मकांडों का खंडन कर निराकार आंतरिक ईश्वर की भक्ति सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Iconoclastic devotional movement founded by Kabir, rejecting caste, ritualism, and sectarian division for formless inner divine realization.
worldviews.full_description_hi: संत कबीर द्वारा स्थापित कबीर पंथ, जो जाति-पांति, बाहरी कर्मकांडों का खंडन कर निराकार आंतरिक ईश्वर की भक्ति सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Iconoclastic social and religious critique challenging both Hindu ritualism and Islamic orthodoxy; Creation of accessible vernacular poetry (Dohas and Sakhis) sung across rural and urban India; Formation of an enduring egalitarian institutional panth spanning centuries

worldviews.historical_associations: The integration of Nirguna bhakti with disciplined ascetic orders (Naga warriors protecting temples); Prolific mystical poetry written in Rajasthani and Hindi vernacular dialects; Fostering religious harmony between Hindu and Muslim seekers in western India

worldviews.historical_associations: Swami Ramananda breaking centuries of caste exclusion by initiating Kabir, Raidas, and women into monastic life; Tulsidas composing the Ramcharitmanas, bringing high theology into accessible Awadhi vernacular; Providing the core spiritual backbone for the Kumbh Mela ascetic processions

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Monistic Shiva-bhakti, wearing of the Istalinga on the body, and rejection of Vedic ritualism and caste.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Vachana Sahitya (Basavanna and contemporaries) (1160)
worldviews.famous_quote: Basavanna: The rich will make temples for Shiva, what shall I, a poor man, do? My legs are pillars, the body the shrine, the head a cupola of gold.
worldviews.short_description_en: Reformist, egalitarian Shaivite movement founded by Basavanna, rejecting caste and ritualism in favor of personal devotion and the Istalinga.
worldviews.short_description_hi: बसवण्णा द्वारा स्थापित वीरशैव/लिंगायत संप्रदाय, जो जाति प्रथा और वैदिक कर्मकांड का विरोध कर इष्टलिंग धारण और शिव भक्ति सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Reformist, egalitarian Shaivite movement founded by Basavanna, rejecting caste and ritualism in favor of personal devotion and the Istalinga.
worldviews.full_description_hi: बसवण्णा द्वारा स्थापित वीरशैव/लिंगायत संप्रदाय, जो जाति प्रथा और वैदिक कर्मकांड का विरोध कर इष्टलिंग धारण और शिव भक्ति सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Establishment of the Anubhava Mantapa (Parliament of Experience) in 12th-century Kalyana, promoting radical social democracy; Rejection of child marriage, caste discrimination, and ritual purity taboos; Universal wearing of the Ishtalinga amulet by all initiates regardless of gender

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Body mysticism (Deha-tattva), internal breath control, music, and finding the divine 'Man of the Heart' (Moner Manush).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Songs of Lalon Shah (1890)
worldviews.famous_quote: Lalon Shah: Where shall I find the Man of my Heart? He lives within me, yet I wander in search of Him.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mystic wandering minstrels of Bengal seeking the divine 'Man of the Heart' through ecstatic music, poetry, and bodily yoga.
worldviews.short_description_hi: बंगाल के बाउल फकीर, जो संगीत, प्रेम और आंतरिक देह-साधना के माध्यम से हृदय के भीतर बसे ईश्वर (मनेर मानुष) की खोज करते हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: Mystic wandering minstrels of Bengal seeking the divine 'Man of the Heart' through ecstatic music, poetry, and bodily yoga.
worldviews.full_description_hi: बंगाल के बाउल फकीर, जो संगीत, प्रेम और आंतरिक देह-साधना के माध्यम से हृदय के भीतर बसे ईश्वर (मनेर मानुष) की खोज करते हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: Synthesis of Sufi Islamic mysticism, Vaishnava bhakti, and Tantric body practices in rural Bengal; Uncompromising rejection of organized religion, caste segregation, and religious fanaticism; Global cultural celebration through Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore's deep inspiration by Baul music

worldviews.canonical_texts: The Pali Tipitaka (-300); Dhammapada (-250)

worldviews.full_description_en: Nontheistic tradition emphasizing the Four Noble Truths, the Eightfold Path, impermanence (Anicca), and non-self (Anatta).
worldviews.full_description_hi: थेरवाद बौद्ध धर्म, जो चार आर्य सत्यों, अष्टांगिक मार्ग, अनित्यत्ता और अनात्मवाद के माध्यम से निर्वाण प्राप्ति पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The enlightenment of Siddhartha Gautama under the Bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya; The First Buddhist Council at Rajgir and preservation of the Pali Canon at the Aluvihara rock temple; The global spread of Vipassana meditation and forest monastery networks

worldviews.historical_associations: The life and ascetic renunciation of Lord Mahavira, the 24th Tirthankara; The great schism dividing the community into Digambara (sky-clad) and Svetambara (white-clad) orders; Pioneering absolute non-violence (Ahimsa) and vegetarianism in South Asian culture

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Fatalistic determinism (Niyati), denying free will and holding that all change is pre-ordained.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fragments preserved in Buddhist and Jain texts (-400)
worldviews.famous_quote: Makkhali Gosala (Sramanic account): There is no deed performed either by oneself or by others which can affect one's future destiny; all beings are subject to strict determinism.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ancient fatalistic heterodox school asserting absolute cosmic determinism (Niyati) where human free will is non-existent.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन आजीविक संप्रदाय, जो पूर्ण नियतिवाद (Niyati) में विश्वास रखता था और मानता था कि मनुष्य के पास स्वतंत्र इच्छा नहीं है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ancient fatalistic heterodox school asserting absolute cosmic determinism (Niyati) where human free will is non-existent.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्राचीन आजीविक संप्रदाय, जो पूर्ण नियतिवाद (Niyati) में विश्वास रखता था और मानता था कि मनुष्य के पास स्वतंत्र इच्छा नहीं है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Major rival ascetic movement to early Buddhism and Jainism during the Mauryan Empire; Royal patronage under Emperor Bindusara before the rise of Ashoka's Buddhist state policy; Gradual historical assimilation and extinction by the late medieval period

worldviews.famous_quote: Nagarjuna: Samsara is nothing essentially different from Nirvana; Nirvana is nothing essentially different from Samsara.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mahayana philosophical school founded by Nagarjuna, establishing that all phenomena are empty of inherent self-nature (Shunyata).
worldviews.short_description_hi: नागार्जुन द्वारा स्थापित शून्यवाद (माध्यमिक दर्शन), जो सिद्ध करता है कि सभी वस्तुएं स्वतंत्र स्वभाव से रहित (शून्य) हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: Mahayana philosophical school founded by Nagarjuna, establishing that all phenomena are empty of inherent self-nature (Shunyata).
worldviews.full_description_hi: नागार्जुन द्वारा स्थापित शून्यवाद (माध्यमिक दर्शन), जो सिद्ध करता है कि सभी वस्तुएं स्वतंत्र स्वभाव से रहित (शून्य) हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: Nagarjuna's radical philosophical revolution establishing the doctrine of Emptiness (Shunyata); The intellectual foundation for Tibetan monastic scholasticism and Zen paradoxical philosophy; Transforming Buddhist soteriology into universal compassion via the Boddhisattva ideal

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Phenomenological analysis of mind, storehouse consciousness (Alayavijnana), and 'Mind-Only' (Cittamatra) realization.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Trimshika-vijnaptikarika (Vasubandhu) (450); Samdhinirmocana Sutra (300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Vasubandhu: All this is mind only, because of the appearance of non-existent objects, just as a man with defective vision sees unreal nets of hair.

worldviews.short_description_hi: योगाचार या विज्ञानवाद दर्शन, जो यह सिद्ध करता है कि संपूर्ण अनुभव केवल चेतना (चित्तमात्र) का विलास है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Buddhist 'Mind-Only' (Cittamatra) phenomenology analyzing how consciousness constructs reality through storehouse karma (Alayavijnana).
worldviews.full_description_hi: योगाचार या विज्ञानवाद दर्शन, जो यह सिद्ध करता है कि संपूर्ण अनुभव केवल चेतना (चित्तमात्र) का विलास है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The systematic codification of Buddhist psychological phenomenology by the brothers Asanga and Vasubandhu; Invention of advanced Buddhist logic and epistemology by Dignaga and Dharmakirti; Deep integration into Tibetan monastic curriculum and East Asian Faxiang/Hosso traditions

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Direct transmission outside scriptures (A-sanskrita), sudden awakening (Satori), and non-dual meditative absorption (Zazen).
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Platform Sutra (Huineng) (780); Shobogenzo (Dogen) (1253)
worldviews.famous_quote: Bodhidharma: A special transmission outside the scriptures; No dependence upon words and letters; Direct pointing to the human mind; Seeing into one's nature and reaching Buddhahood.
worldviews.short_description_en: Meditation-focused Buddhist tradition emphasizing direct experiential realization, mindfulness, and sudden awakening (Satori).
worldviews.short_description_hi: जेन (चैन) बौद्ध धर्म, जो शास्त्रों के मोह को त्यागकर ध्यान (जाजेन) और अचानक बोधि प्राप्ति (सातोरी) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Meditation-focused Buddhist tradition emphasizing direct experiential realization, mindfulness, and sudden awakening (Satori).
worldviews.full_description_hi: जेन (चैन) बौद्ध धर्म, जो शास्त्रों के मोह को त्यागकर ध्यान (जाजेन) और अचानक बोधि प्राप्ति (सातोरी) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Bodhidharma traveling from India to Shaolin Temple in China, founding Chan Buddhism; The clash and integration of Buddhist metaphysics with Chinese Daoism; The global spread of Zen meditation, minimalism, tea ceremony, and aesthetic arts in the 20th century

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Faith (Shraddha) and recitation of Amitabha Buddha's name (Nianfo / Nembutsu) leading to rebirth in the Pure Land.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Larger Sukhāvatīvyūha Sūtra (100); Kyogyoshinsho (Shinran) (1235)
worldviews.famous_quote: Shinran Shonin: If even a good person can be reborn in the Pure Land, how much more so a wicked person!
worldviews.short_description_en: Devotional Buddhist school centered on faith in Amitabha Buddha and chanting his name to attain rebirth in the Pure Land.
worldviews.short_description_hi: शुद्ध भूमि बौद्ध संप्रदाय, जो अमिताभा बुद्ध की कृपा और उनके नाम (नेमबुत्सु) के जाप द्वारा सुखवती (शुद्ध भूमि) में जन्म पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Devotional Buddhist school centered on faith in Amitabha Buddha and chanting his name to attain rebirth in the Pure Land.
worldviews.full_description_hi: शुद्ध भूमि बौद्ध संप्रदाय, जो अमिताभा बुद्ध की कृपा और उनके नाम (नेमबुत्सु) के जाप द्वारा सुखवती (शुद्ध भूमि) में जन्म पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The popularization of devotionally accessible Buddhism across China, Korea, and Japan; Shinran's radical democratization of religion, abolishing clerical celibacy and monastic hierarchy in Jodo Shinshu; Becoming the most widely practiced devotional form of Buddhism in East Asia

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Esoteric empowerment (Abhisheka), deity yoga, visualization, and transformation of afflictions into wisdom.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Tibetan Book of the Dead (Bardo Thodol) (1350); Guhyasamaja Tantra (400)
worldviews.famous_quote: Padmasambhava: Though my view is as high as the sky, my actions and respect for karma are as fine as grains of flour.
worldviews.short_description_en: Esoteric Tantric Buddhism utilizing ritual, mantra, mandala, and deity yoga to accelerate attainment of enlightenment in one lifetime.
worldviews.short_description_hi: वज्रयान (तांत्रिक बौद्ध धर्म), जो मंत्र, मंडल, देवता योग और गूढ़ साधनाओं के माध्यम से एक ही जीवन में बोधि प्राप्ति का मार्ग है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric Tantric Buddhism utilizing ritual, mantra, mandala, and deity yoga to accelerate attainment of enlightenment in one lifetime.
worldviews.full_description_hi: वज्रयान (तांत्रिक बौद्ध धर्म), जो मंत्र, मंडल, देवता योग और गूढ़ साधनाओं के माध्यम से एक ही जीवन में बोधि प्राप्ति का मार्ग है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The establishment of Buddhism in Tibet under King Trisong Detsen and Guru Padmasambhava; The creation of the unique Tibetan monastic state and deep philosophical debate traditions; The global diaspora and introduction of Tibetan meditation and compassion practices to Western psychology

worldviews.full_description_en: Modern reformist Buddhist movement founded by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, reinterpreting Buddhism as a framework for social equality and liberty.
worldviews.full_description_hi: डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर द्वारा स्थापित नयान (नया मार्ग), जो बौद्ध धर्म को सामाजिक समानता, स्वतंत्रता और बंधुत्व के रूप में पुनर्परिभाषित करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The historic mass conversion ceremony of 500,000 Dalits led by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar in Nagpur on October 14, 1956; Reinterpreting early Buddhism as a social philosophy of liberty, equality, and fraternity; A powerful vehicle for Dalit self-respect, emancipation, and anti-caste social revolution in modern India

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pratyabhijna (recognition) of one's own identity as identical with universal Shiva consciousness (Paramashiva).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Shiva Sutras (850); Tantraloka (Abhinavagupta) (1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Abhinavagupta: By realizing that the entire universe is a play of one's own consciousness, one attains liberation while living (Jivanmukti).

worldviews.short_description_hi: कश्मीर शैव दर्शन, जो मानता है कि संपूर्ण जगत शिव की ही चेतन ऊर्जा (स्वातंत्र्य शक्ति) का विलास और प्रकटीकरण है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Non-dual idealistic Tantric philosophy asserting that reality is pure consciousness (Prakasha) manifesting the universe as a play of divine freedom (Svatantrya).
worldviews.full_description_hi: कश्मीर शैव दर्शन, जो मानता है कि संपूर्ण जगत शिव की ही चेतन ऊर्जा (स्वातंत्र्य शक्ति) का विलास और प्रकटीकरण है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The intellectual golden age of Kashmir producing profound non-dual aesthetics and philosophy; Formulation of the Spanda (divine pulsation) and Pratyabhijna (recognition) doctrines; Integration of high spiritual realization with worldly enjoyment (Bhoga as Yoga)

worldviews.historical_era: c. 14th Century CE (Roots in Kapalika tradition c. 7th CE)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Transgressive non-dualism: dissolving all mental categories of pure/impure through radical acceptance.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Vivek Sara (Kina Ram) (1650)
worldviews.famous_quote: Aghori Maxim: What is there to fear in this universe? When you see the divine in excrement and ambrosia alike, the illusion of disgust vanishes.
worldviews.short_description_en: Radical non-dual ascetic tradition that transcends all social taboos, pollution concepts, and fear through cremation ground practices.
worldviews.short_description_hi: अघोर पंथ, जो श्मशान साधना और सभी प्रकार के सामाजिक भेदभाव, घृणा व भय से परे जाकर समदृष्टि प्राप्त करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Radical non-dual ascetic tradition that transcends all social taboos, pollution concepts, and fear through cremation ground practices.
worldviews.full_description_hi: अघोर पंथ, जो श्मशान साधना और सभी प्रकार के सामाजिक भेदभाव, घृणा व भय से परे जाकर समदृष्टि प्राप्त करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Practicing cremation ground (Shmashana) sadhana to transcend ego and fear of death; Charitable healing and service to lepers and outcasts in Varanasi by the Kinaram lineage; Challenging orthodox ritual purity taboos through shocking counter-cultural behavior

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Internal bodily realization of divine love using human senses and emotions as the direct vehicle for liberation (Sahaja).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Amrita Sindhu (1600)
worldviews.famous_quote: Sahajiya Proverb: The body is the universe; whatever is outside is also within. He who realizes this is a true Sahajiya.
worldviews.short_description_en: Esoteric Bengali movement using human emotion and sensory experience as a vehicle for spontaneous spiritual liberation (Sahaja).
worldviews.short_description_hi: सहजीया परंपरा, जो मानव शरीर और भावनाओं को ही साधना का माध्यम मानकर सहज अवस्था (मोक्ष) की प्राप्ति करती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric Bengali movement using human emotion and sensory experience as a vehicle for spontaneous spiritual liberation (Sahaja).
worldviews.full_description_hi: सहजीया परंपरा, जो मानव शरीर और भावनाओं को ही साधना का माध्यम मानकर सहज अवस्था (मोक्ष) की प्राप्ति करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Reinterpreting Radha-Krishna love poetry into internal psychosexual yogic transformation; Direct rejection of rigid scriptural orthodoxies in favor of spontaneous natural (Sahaja) realization; Laying the direct historical groundwork for the Bengali Baul minstrel movement

worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric tantric lineage focused on the worship of the inner family of divine energies (Kaula) to attain non-dual liberation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: कौल तांत्रिक परंपरा, जो आंतरिक ऊर्जाओं और कुल (चेतना समूह) की साधना से अद्वैत सिद्धि प्राप्त करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The early medieval flourishing of esoteric goddess worship across Indian royal courts; Providing the core metaphysical foundation for Kashmir Shaivism and Shrividya traditions; Preservation of advanced internal visualization and ritual energy balancing (Yogini worship)

worldviews.historical_associations: Development of the traditional Siddha medical system of South India; Composition of profound Tamil philosophical and alchemical poetry defying ritualistic orthodoxy; Engineering physical immortality and transmutation of the human body into light (Vijnana deha)

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Syncretic fusion of Sufi inner breath (Dam) and Tantric Sahaja body channels through song and meditation.

worldviews.historical_associations: Successful synthesis of Islamic Sufism, Hindu Vaishnavism, and Tantric yoga in rural Bengal; Total rejection of communal disharmony, caste barriers, and religious fundamentalism; Preservation of oral esoteric philosophy through immortal folk songs

worldviews.famous_quote: Pashupata Sutra: By courting dishonor and acting as a madman in the eyes of society, the yogi destroys his ego and pleases Lord Pashupati.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ancient ascetic Shaivite school founded by Lakulisha, utilizing deliberate unconventional behavior and meditation to attain liberation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: लकुलिस द्वारा स्थापित प्राचीन पाशुपत संप्रदाय, जो जानबूझकर समाज में पागलपन जैसे आचरण कर अहंकार और कर्मों का नाश करता था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ancient ascetic Shaivite school founded by Lakulisha, utilizing deliberate unconventional behavior and meditation to attain liberation.

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Rectification of names (Zhengming), historical study of classics, moral intuition, and ritual propriety (Li).

worldviews.short_description_en: Ethical and sociopolitical philosophy emphasizing filial piety, humaneness (Ren), ritual propriety (Li), and moral self-cultivation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: कन्फ्यूशियस का दर्शन, जो पारिवारिक सम्मान (पित्रभक्ति), मानवता (रेन) और नैतिक आचार-व्यवहार (ली) पर आधारित है।

worldviews.historical_associations: Shaping the ethical, familial, and political fabric of Chinese civilization for over two millennia; Establishing the imperial civil service examination system based on classical mastery; Providing the core moral foundation for family filial piety and social harmony across East Asia

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Apophatic unlearning, intuitive alignment with the nameless Dao, and effortless action (Wu-wei).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Tao Te Ching (Daodejing) (-400); Zhuangzi (-300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Laozi: The Dao that can be told is not the eternal Dao.
worldviews.short_description_en: Naturalist metaphysics advocating effortless action (Wu-wei), spontaneity (Ziran), and harmony with the unnamable cosmic Way (Dao).
worldviews.short_description_hi: ताओवादी दर्शन, जो बिना प्रयास के कर्म (वु-वेई), प्राकृतिक सहजता (जिराण) और ताओ के साथ एकरूपता सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Naturalist metaphysics advocating effortless action (Wu-wei), spontaneity (Ziran), and harmony with the unnamable cosmic Way (Dao).
worldviews.full_description_hi: ताओवादी दर्शन, जो बिना प्रयास के कर्म (वु-वेई), प्राकृतिक सहजता (जिराण) और ताओ के साथ एकरूपता सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Providing the balancing mystical and naturalist counterweight to Confucian social duty in China; Inspiring classical Chinese landscape painting, poetry, calligraphy, and traditional medicine; Serving as a major philosophical inspiration for modern deep ecology and philosophical anarchism

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pragmatic verification through three tests: historical precedent, empirical observation, and practical utility for society.

worldviews.short_description_en: Pragmatic utilitarian philosophy advocating universal love (Jian'ai), pacifism, meritocracy, and anti-fatalism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मोजी का दर्शन, जो सार्वभौमिक प्रेम (जियान-आई), शांतिवाद, उपयोगितावाद और योग्यता आधारित शासन का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Pragmatic utilitarian philosophy advocating universal love (Jian'ai), pacifism, meritocracy, and anti-fatalism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मोजी का दर्शन, जो सार्वभौमिक प्रेम (जियान-आई), शांतिवाद, उपयोगितावाद और योग्यता आधारित शासन का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Advocating for universal impartial care (Jian'ai) and rigorous pacifist civil engineering during the Warring States; Developing early Chinese mathematical logic, optics, and defensive military science; Historical philosophical rival to Confucianism before fading during the Han dynasty

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Realpolitik administrative observation, strict penal law, and statecraft pragmatism over moral idealism.

worldviews.short_description_hi: विधिवाद (फाजिया), जो नैतिक शिक्षा के स्थान पर कठोर कानूनों (फा), प्रशासनिक तंत्र और सम्राट की शक्ति से राज्य संचालन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Authoritarian statecraft philosophy prioritizing strict laws (Fa), administrative methods (Shu), and absolute ruler power (Shi) to maintain order.
worldviews.full_description_hi: विधिवाद (फाजिया), जो नैतिक शिक्षा के स्थान पर कठोर कानूनों (फा), प्रशासनिक तंत्र और सम्राट की शक्ति से राज्य संचालन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Engineering the unification of China under the brutal efficiency of the Qin Dynasty (221 BCE); Establishing the imperial administrative machinery of laws (Fa), statecraft (Shu), and royal power (Shi); Serving as the practical shadow-statecraft underlying imperial Chinese dynastic governance

worldviews.historical_associations: Advocating for agrarian egalitarianism where rulers and subjects work the land together; Proposing classless self-sufficient village economies without commercial currency or division of labor; Historical early socialist/proto-anarchist peasant philosophy in ancient China

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Combining Daoist metaphysical cosmology (Dao) with Legalist penal efficiency and Yin-Yang statecraft.

worldviews.short_description_en: Syncretic philosophy uniting Daoist metaphysics (Laozi) and Legalist statecraft under the legendary Yellow Emperor.
worldviews.short_description_hi: ह्वांग-लाओ परंपरा, जो ताओवादी अध्यात्म (लाओजी) और विधिवादी प्रशासनिक कुशलता का अद्भुत समन्वय करती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Syncretic philosophy uniting Daoist metaphysics (Laozi) and Legalist statecraft under the legendary Yellow Emperor.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ह्वांग-लाओ परंपरा, जो ताओवादी अध्यात्म (लाओजी) और विधिवादी प्रशासनिक कुशलता का अद्भुत समन्वय करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Serving as the ruling state ideology during the early peaceful decades of the Han Dynasty (Rule by Non-Action / Wu-wei); Successfully recovering China from the devastation of the Qin wars through minimalist taxation and governance; Bridging metaphysical Daoism with pragmatic imperial administration before Confucian orthodoxy took over

worldviews.historical_associations: Revitalizing Confucianism by incorporating Buddhist and Daoist metaphysical depth; Serving as the official state orthodox ideology of imperial China and Joseon Korea for centuries; Shaping the rigorous moral education and examination system across East Asia

worldviews.epistemological_framework: In-naechon (Man is Heaven / God within), blending Confucian, Daoist, Buddhist, and Shamanic principles.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Donggyeong Daejeon (Great scriptures of Eastern Learning) (1880)
worldviews.famous_quote: Choe Je-u: Serve man as you serve God (In-naechon); treat all human beings with absolute equality.
worldviews.short_description_en: Korean syncretic religion originating from Donghak, teaching that humanity and God share a single divine essence.
worldviews.short_description_hi: कोरियाई धर्म चेन्दोइज्म (동학), जो 'इन्नैचोन' (मनुष्य ही ईश्वर है) के सिद्धांत द्वारा सामाजिक समानता की शिक्षा देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Korean syncretic religion originating from Donghak, teaching that humanity and God share a single divine essence.
worldviews.full_description_hi: कोरियाई धर्म चेन्दोइज्म (동학), जो 'इन्नैचोन' (मनुष्य ही ईश्वर है) के सिद्धांत द्वारा सामाजिक समानता की शिक्षा देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Spurring the massive 1894 Donghak Peasant Revolution against feudal corruption and foreign imperialism; Pioneering the radical social egalitarian doctrine that 'Man is Heaven'; Playing a central role in Korean nationalist resistance against Japanese colonial occupation
