worldviews.epistemological_framework: Spirit-medium revelation from the Supreme Being, unifying world religions under the Divine Eye.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Kinh Thien Dao va The Dao (Divine and Earthly Prayers) (1926)
worldviews.famous_quote: Cao Dai Divine Revelation: Buddha, Laozi, Confucius, Jesus, and Muhammad are all manifestations of the One Supreme Being.
worldviews.short_description_en: Vietnamese syncretic monotheistic religion uniting Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Confucianism, and Daoism under the Eye of God.
worldviews.short_description_hi: वियतनाम का काओ दाई धर्म, जो विश्व के सभी प्रमुख धर्मों (बौद्ध, ईसाई, कन्फ्यूशियस, ताओ) को एक ईश्वर की छत्रछाया में जोड़ता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Vietnamese syncretic monotheistic religion uniting Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Confucianism, and Daoism under the Eye of God.
worldviews.full_description_hi: वियतनाम का काओ दाई धर्म, जो विश्व के सभी प्रमुख धर्मों (बौद्ध, ईसाई, कन्फ्यूशियस, ताओ) को एक ईश्वर की छत्रछाया में जोड़ता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Establishment of the striking ornate Holy See temple complex in Tay Ninh, Vietnam; Organizing powerful political and military autonomy during the mid-20th century Indochina conflicts; Synthesizing Eastern and Western religious philosophies into a universal hierarchical order

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Animism, ancestor veneration, sacred grove reverence (Utaki), and female spiritual supremacy (Onarigami).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Omoro Soshi (Ancient Chants Compilation) (1531)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ryukyuan Tradition: The sister protects her brother on the seas and in battle through spiritual authority (Onarigami).
worldviews.short_description_en: Indigenous animistic religion of the Ryukyu Islands centered on sacred groves (Utaki), ancestor worship, and Noro priestesses.
worldviews.short_description_hi: ओकिनावा (र्युक्यू द्वीप समूह) का प्राचीन धर्म, जो पवित्र वनों (उताकी), पूर्वज पूजा और नोरु पुरोहितों की मातृसत्तात्मक परंपरा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Indigenous animistic religion of the Ryukyu Islands centered on sacred groves (Utaki), ancestor worship, and Noro priestesses.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ओकिनावा (र्युक्यू द्वीप समूह) का प्राचीन धर्म, जो पवित्र वनों (उताकी), पूर्वज पूजा और नोरु पुरोहितों की मातृसत्तात्मक परंपरा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The spiritual authority of Noro priestesses officially sanctioned by the Ryukyu Kingdom royal court; Veneration of Sefa-Utaki and sacred natural limestone caves and groves; Preservation of unique matriarchal spiritual structures distinct from mainland Japanese Shinto

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Yamabushi ascetic mountain trials, esoteric Buddhist ritual, Shinto kami reverence, and natural elemental mastery.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Shozan Engi (Records of Sacred Mountains) (1608)
worldviews.famous_quote: Shugendo Practice Maxim: Through scaling steep peaks and enduring elemental trials, one awakens the Buddha nature within the physical body.
worldviews.short_description_en: Syncretic Japanese ascetic mountain religion combining Buddhism, Shinto, and Daoism, practiced by Yamabushi monks.
worldviews.short_description_hi: जापानी पर्वतीय तपस्या धर्म (शुगेन्दो), जिसमें यामाबुशी साधु पहाड़ों पर कठिन साधना द्वारा बौद्ध और शिंतो शक्तियों को जागृत करते हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: Syncretic Japanese ascetic mountain religion combining Buddhism, Shinto, and Daoism, practiced by Yamabushi monks.
worldviews.full_description_hi: जापानी पर्वतीय तपस्या धर्म (शुगेन्दो), जिसमें यामाबुशी साधु पहाड़ों पर कठिन साधना द्वारा बौद्ध और शिंतो शक्तियों को जागृत करते हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: The syncretic synthesis of mountain shamanism, Shinto animism, Daoist magic, and Esoteric Buddhism; Yamabushi ascetics traversing forbidden peaks to gain spiritual and magical powers (Siddhi); Enduring resilience through centuries of government suppression and modern ecological revival

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Unifying the five major world religions under the Venerable Mother of the Infinite (Muguan Laomu).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Yiguandao Scriptures and Patriarchal Lineage Texts (1930)
worldviews.famous_quote: Yiguandao Teaching: Confucianism, Buddhism, Daoism, Christianity, and Islam all stem from the same root of divine truth.
worldviews.short_description_en: Chinese salvationist syncretic religion uniting the five major world faiths under the worship of the primordial Mother Goddess.
worldviews.short_description_hi: चीनी एकता मार्ग (यीगुआन्दो), जो कन्फ्यूशियस, बौद्ध, ताओ, ईसाई और इस्लाम धर्मों को एक मूल सत्य में जोड़ता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Chinese salvationist syncretic religion uniting the five major world faiths under the worship of the primordial Mother Goddess.
worldviews.full_description_hi: चीनी एकता मार्ग (यीगुआन्दो), जो कन्फ्यूशियस, बौद्ध, ताओ, ईसाई और इस्लाम धर्मों को एक मूल सत्य में जोड़ता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Rapid missionary expansion across China during the turbulent Republican era; Facing severe persecution and prohibition in mainland China after 1949, subsequently flourishing in Taiwan; Promoting vegetarianism, philanthropy, and interfaith unity

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Divine revelation through Oyasama (Nakayama Miki), cultivating the 'Joyous Life' (Yoki-gurashi) through charitable mental purification (Hinokishin).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Ofudesaki (Tip of the Writing Brush) (1869); Mikagurauta (Songs for the Service) (1867)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nakayama Miki (Oyasama): God desires nothing other than the joyous life of humankind.
worldviews.short_description_en: Japanese new religious movement founded by Nakayama Miki, teaching the 'Joyous Life' through selfless service and love.
worldviews.short_description_hi: जापानी नया धर्म तेनरिक्यो, जिसकी स्थापना नाकायामा मिकी ने की; यह सेवा और आनंदमय जीवन (योकी-गुराशी) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Japanese new religious movement founded by Nakayama Miki, teaching the 'Joyous Life' through selfless service and love.
worldviews.full_description_hi: जापानी नया धर्म तेनरिक्यो, जिसकी स्थापना नाकायामा मिकी ने की; यह सेवा और आनंदमय जीवन (योकी-गुराशी) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Founding by Nakayama Miki after being possessed by God (Tenri-O-no-Mikoto) in 1838; Building the city of Tenri in Nara as a model international spiritual community centered on education and sports; Pioneering massive voluntary disaster relief and community service worldwide

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Dzogchen (Great Perfection) non-dual realization, ancient Zhang Zhung scriptural revelation, and ritual purification.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Bön Kanjur and Tenjur (1000); Zhang Zhung Nyen Gyud (800)
worldviews.famous_quote: Tonpa Shenrab Miwo: True peace is found by resting in the natural state of primordial purity (Dzogchen).
worldviews.short_description_en: Indigenous Tibetan pre-Buddhist spiritual tradition featuring Dzogchen philosophy, ritual healing, and monastic scholarship.
worldviews.short_description_hi: तिब्बत का बौद्ध-पूर्व प्राचीन बोन धर्म, जो दज़ोगचेन (परम शुद्धता) दर्शन, शमन अनुष्ठानों और मठवासी शिक्षा का समन्वय है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Indigenous Tibetan pre-Buddhist spiritual tradition featuring Dzogchen philosophy, ritual healing, and monastic scholarship.
worldviews.full_description_hi: तिब्बत का बौद्ध-पूर्व प्राचीन बोन धर्म, जो दज़ोगचेन (परम शुद्धता) दर्शन, शमन अनुष्ठानों और मठवासी शिक्षा का समन्वय है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Serving as the indigenous spiritual and cosmological worldview of ancient Tibet before Buddhism arrived; The rediscovery of hidden texts (Terma) establishing Bön as a sophisticated philosophical monastic tradition; Official recognition by the Tibetan government-in-exile as the fifth legitimate school of Tibetan religion

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Good thoughts, good words, good deeds (Humata, Hukhta, Havarsta), guided by divine wisdom (Ahura Mazda) and free moral choice.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Avesta (Gathas) (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Zarathustra (Yasha 30.3): The two primeval spirits, who revealed themselves in vision as twins, are the Better and the Bad in thought and word and action.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ancient Iranian monotheistic faith centered on Ahura Mazda (Wisdom), cosmic dualism between Asha (Truth) and Druj (Chaos), and moral free will.

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Time (Zurvan) as the absolute primordial principle generating both Ahura Mazda and Angra Mainyu.

worldviews.famous_quote: Zurvanite Mythological Account: Before light and dark were created, Zurvan (Infinite Time) existed alone for a thousand years, desiring offspring.
worldviews.short_description_en: Sasanian-era Zoroastrian heresy proposing Infinite Time (Zurvan) as the ultimate primordial deity over good and evil.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सासानी काल का ज़ुर्वनिज़्म, जो अनंत काल (ज़ुर्वन) को अहुर मजदा और अंग्र मैन्यु दोनों का मूल पिता मानता था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Sasanian-era Zoroastrian heresy proposing Infinite Time (Zurvan) as the ultimate primordial deity over good and evil.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सासानी काल का ज़ुर्वनिज़्म, जो अनंत काल (ज़ुर्वन) को अहुर मजदा और अंग्र मैन्यु दोनों का मूल पिता मानता था।
worldviews.historical_associations: Popular theological variation during the Sasanian Empire attempting to solve the problem of dualism; Proposing Infinite Time (Zurvan) as the ultimate transcendent parent of both good and evil twin spirits; Gradually suppressed and absorbed back into orthodox Mazdaism by the late Sasanian period

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Divine revelation, cosmic gnosis separating Light from Darkness, and strict ascetic dualism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Shabuhragan (245); The Living Gospel (Mani) (240)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mani: My church surpasses all previous religions because those were partial, whereas mine embraces all wisdom and spans the whole universe.

worldviews.full_description_en: Gnostic universal religion founded by Mani, teaching absolute cosmic dualism between a realm of Light and a realm of Darkness.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पैगंबर मणि द्वारा स्थापित मनीकियन धर्म, जो प्रकाश और अंधकार के बीच पूर्ण ब्रह्मांडीय संघर्ष और ज्ञान (ग्नोसिस) पर आधारित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: Rapid missionary spread across the Roman Empire, North Africa, and along the Silk Road into China; Saint Augustine spending nearly a decade as a Manichaean 'Hearer' before converting to Christianity; Severe persecution by Sasanian Zoroastrian priests and Roman Christian emperors leading to extinction

worldviews.short_description_hi: मन्दई धर्म, जो जॉन द बैपटिस्ट (याह्या) को मानता है और बहती नदी में पवित्र बपतिस्मा (मस्बुता) द्वारा प्रकाश लोक की प्राप्ति करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ancient surviving Gnostic monotheistic tradition venerating Abel, Seth, and John the Baptist, centered on living water baptism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मन्दई धर्म, जो जॉन द बैपटिस्ट (याह्या) को मानता है और बहती नदी में पवित्र बपतिस्मा (मस्बुता) द्वारा प्रकाश लोक की प्राप्ति करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The sole surviving Gnostic religious community from antiquity that practices continuous river baptism; Severe displacement and refugee crisis of Mandaean communities from Iraq and Iran following recent geopolitical conflicts; Strict endogamy and preservation of ancient Eastern Aramaic liturgical language

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Gnostic illumination demanding the communal redistribution of wealth, property, and women to eradicate greed born of Darkness.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Sasanian chronicles and Persian historical fragments (600)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mazdak: God has provided the means of subsistence on earth equally among His creatures; no one has more right to them than another.
worldviews.short_description_en: Proto-socialist Gnostic movement in Sasanian Persia advocating communal property, pacifism, and the abolition of aristocratic privilege.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सासानी काल का मज़दकिज़्म, जो संपत्ति और धन के समान वितरण तथा कुलीन वर्ग के विशेषाधिकारों के अंत की मांग करने वाला क्रांतिकारी आंदोलन था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Proto-socialist Gnostic movement in Sasanian Persia advocating communal property, pacifism, and the abolition of aristocratic privilege.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सासानी काल का मज़दकिज़्म, जो संपत्ति और धन के समान वितरण तथा कुलीन वर्ग के विशेषाधिकारों के अंत की मांग करने वाला क्रांतिकारी आंदोलन था।
worldviews.historical_associations: A massive proto-socialist and gnostic peasant uprising in 5th-century Sasanian Persia challenging nobility and Zoroastrian clergy; Briefly winning the support of King Kavad I before facing ruthless extermination and massacre under Khosrow I in 528 CE; Leaving a deep historical legacy in Iranian political memory regarding social justice and wealth equality

worldviews.canonical_texts: Mishefa Reş (Black Book) (1200); Kirtêna Zarokan (1300)

worldviews.full_description_en: Monotheistic Kurdish religion venerating the Seven Angels and Malak Taus (the Peacock Angel), rooted in ancient Iranian cosmology.
worldviews.full_description_hi: यज़ीदी धर्म, जो प्राचीन ईरानी और कुर्दिश मान्यताओं पर आधारित है और सात देवदूतों तथा मलक ताऊस (मयूर देवदूत) की पूजा करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Centuries of survival in the mountains of northern Iraq amidst severe regional persecutions; Pilgrimage to the holy sanctuary of Lalish containing the sacred white fluted conical shrines; The tragic 2014 genocide and displacement perpetrated by ISIS, sparking international humanitarian rescue

worldviews.famous_quote: Mithraic Tauroctony Inscription: Save us, who have been redeemed by the blood of the bull.
worldviews.short_description_en: Roman mystery religion centered on the god Mithras, bull-slaying (Tauroctony), and seven planetary initiation grades.
worldviews.short_description_hi: रोमन साम्राज्य का गुप्त मिथ्राइज़्म पंथ, जो सूर्य देवता मिथ्रस, वृषवध (Tauroctony) और सात ग्रहों की दीक्षा श्रेणियों पर आधारित था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Roman mystery religion centered on the god Mithras, bull-slaying (Tauroctony), and seven planetary initiation grades.
worldviews.full_description_hi: रोमन साम्राज्य का गुप्त मिथ्राइज़्म पंथ, जो सूर्य देवता मिथ्रस, वृषवध (Tauroctony) और सात ग्रहों की दीक्षा श्रेणियों पर आधारित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: Exclusive underground initiatory brotherhood (Mithraeum) popular among Roman legionaries; The iconic ritual sculpture of the Tauroctony (Mithras slaying the primordial bull of creation); Major cultural and religious rival to early Christianity throughout the Western Roman Empire

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pneumatic spiritual awakening, mythological gnosis of the Pleroma (Divine Fullness), and salvation of the divine spark.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Gospel of Truth (150); Tripartite Tractate (200)
worldviews.famous_quote: Valentinus: Gnosis is the redemption of the inner man; it is knowing who we were, what we have become, where we were, into what we have been cast.
worldviews.short_description_en: Sophisticated Christian Gnostic school founded by Valentinus, mapping the divine Pleroma, Sophia's fall, and spiritual liberation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: वैलेंटाइनस का ईसाई ग्नॉस्टिक दर्शन, जो दिव्य पूर्णता (प्लेरोमा) और भौतिक भ्रम से मुक्ति के लिए आत्म-ज्ञान (ग्नोसिस) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Sophisticated Christian Gnostic school founded by Valentinus, mapping the divine Pleroma, Sophia's fall, and spiritual liberation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: वैलेंटाइनस का ईसाई ग्नॉस्टिक दर्शन, जो दिव्य पूर्णता (प्लेरोमा) और भौतिक भ्रम से मुक्ति के लिए आत्म-ज्ञान (ग्नोसिस) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The most sophisticated and intellectually successful Christian Gnostic philosophical school of the 2nd century; Vigorous theological debate and intellectual rivalry with proto-orthodox bishops like Irenaeus; Preservation of profound mystical exegesis of Christian scriptures

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Transcendent revelation, rejection of the blind material creator god (Yaldabaoth), and ascent through celestial aeon gates.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Apocryphon of John (180); The Nag Hammadi Library (350)
worldviews.famous_quote: Apocryphon of John: I am the light that is within you. I am the All, and the All came forth from me and to me all things return.
worldviews.short_description_en: Dualistic Gnostic movement viewing humanity's spiritual core as alienated from the material world created by the ignorant Demiurge.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सेथियन ग्नॉस्टिक परंपरा, जो मानती है कि इस भौतिक संसार का रचयिता (यल्दाबाओथ) एक भ्रष्ट शक्ति है और मनुष्य की आत्मा का स्रोत सर्वोच्च परम प्रकाश है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Dualistic Gnostic movement viewing humanity's spiritual core as alienated from the material world created by the ignorant Demiurge.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सेथियन ग्नॉस्टिक परंपरा, जो मानती है कि इस भौतिक संसार का रचयिता (यल्दाबाओथ) एक भ्रष्ट शक्ति है और मनुष्य की आत्मा का स्रोत सर्वोच्च परम प्रकाश है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Authorship of the primary texts discovered in the 1945 Nag Hammadi library cache in Egypt; Radical cosmological dualism separating the supreme unknowable God from the flawed creator of the material universe; Intense theological polemics with emerging orthodox Christianity leading to suppression

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Kashf (unveiling/direct mystical intuition), dhikr (remembrance), and realization of divine unity in multiplicity.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fusus al-Hikam (The Bezels of Wisdom) (1229); Mathnawi (Rumi) (1270)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ibn Arabi: My heart has become capable of every form: it is a pasture for gazelles and a convent for Christian monks... I follow the religion of Love.
worldviews.short_description_en: Esoteric Islamic mysticism emphasizing that only God truly exists (Unity of Being) and that the divine is mirrored in all creation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: इब्न अरबी का वहदत अल-वजूद (अस्तित्व की एकता), जिसके अनुसार इस ब्रह्मांड में केवल एक ही परम सत्य (ईश्वर) विभिन्न रूपों में प्रकट है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric Islamic mysticism emphasizing that only God truly exists (Unity of Being) and that the divine is mirrored in all creation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: इब्न अरबी का वहदत अल-वजूद (अस्तित्व की एकता), जिसके अनुसार इस ब्रह्मांड में केवल एक ही परम सत्य (ईश्वर) विभिन्न रूपों में प्रकट है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Formulation of the ontological doctrine of Wahdat al-Wujud (The Unity of Being); Spreading universal divine love and religious pluralism across Islamic civilization through poetry and music; Establishing the vast international network of Sufi tariqas (orders) spanning from West Africa to China

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Intuitive tasting (Dhauq), visionary illumination (Ishraq), and direct experiential knowledge of the 'Light of Lights'.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Hikmat al-Ishraq (Philosophy of Illumination) (1186)
worldviews.famous_quote: Suhrawardi: True wisdom is not attained through dry syllogistic logic alone, but through the direct contemplative dawn of divine Light upon the purified soul.
worldviews.short_description_en: Illuminationist philosophy synthesizing Peripatetic logic with visionary mystical experience of the hierarchy of pure Lights.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सोहरावर्दी का इश्राकी दर्शन, जो तार्किक ज्ञान के साथ-साथ दिव्य प्रकाश (नूर) के आंतरिक अनुभव (इश्राक) को सर्वोच्च सत्य मानता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Illuminationist philosophy synthesizing Peripatetic logic with visionary mystical experience of the hierarchy of pure Lights.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सोहरावर्दी का इश्राकी दर्शन, जो तार्किक ज्ञान के साथ-साथ दिव्य प्रकाश (नूर) के आंतरिक अनुभव (इश्राक) को सर्वोच्च सत्य मानता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Synthesizing ancient Persian royal light symbolism with Neoplatonism, Hermeticism, and Islamic theology; Suhrawardi's execution in Aleppo at age 38 for political and theological heterodoxy; Becoming a cornerstone of the Isfahan School of philosophy alongside Mulla Sadra

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Aristotelian logic, Neoplatonic emanation, and human intellect connecting with the Active Intellect (Aql al-Fa'al).
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Book of Healing (Kitab al-Shifa - Avicenna) (1027); The Incoherence of the Incoherence (Averroes) (1180)
worldviews.famous_quote: Avicenna: The Floating Man thought experiment: Imagine a man created in a full state of maturity suspended in air; he would know he exists without needing sensory input from his body.
worldviews.short_description_en: Rationalist Islamic philosophy (Falsafa) synthesizing Aristotelian natural science, Neoplatonism, and monotheistic theology.
worldviews.short_description_hi: इस्लामी दर्शन (फल्सफा), जिसने अरस्तू और प्लेटो के विचारों को इस्लामी एकेश्वरवाद के साथ जोड़कर चिकित्सा, तर्क और विज्ञान को उन्नत किया।
worldviews.full_description_en: Rationalist Islamic philosophy (Falsafa) synthesizing Aristotelian natural science, Neoplatonism, and monotheistic theology.
worldviews.full_description_hi: इस्लामी दर्शन (फल्सफा), जिसने अरस्तू और प्लेटो के विचारों को इस्लामी एकेश्वरवाद के साथ जोड़कर चिकित्सा, तर्क और विज्ञान को उन्नत किया।
worldviews.historical_associations: The Translation Movement in Abbasid Baghdad rendering Aristotle, Plato, and Galen into Arabic; Avicenna's medical encyclopedia (The Canon of Medicine) serving as the standard textbook in Europe and Asia for 600 years; Averroes' commentaries on Aristotle sparking the 13th-century Latin Scholastic revolution in Europe

worldviews.name_hi: मुल्ला सद्रा का दिव्य दर्शन (हिकमत अल-मुताअलिया)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Synthesis of demonstration (Burhan), mystical intuition (Irfan), and scriptural revelation, anchored in substantial motion.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Al-Hikma al-Muta'aliyah fi al-Asfar al-Arba'a (The Four Journeys) (1630)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mulla Sadra: Existence is a single, simple, all-inclusive reality that possesses degrees of intensity and gradation (Tashkik al-Wujud).
worldviews.short_description_en: Grand synthesis of Islamic philosophy uniting rational logic, Sufi mysticism, and theological revelation through the concept of evolving existence.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मुल्ला सद्रा का दिव्य दर्शन, जो तर्क, सूफी रहस्यवाद और धर्मशास्त्र को 'सतत गतिशीलता' (सद्भाव) के सिद्धांत के तहत एक सूत्र में पिरोता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Grand synthesis of Islamic philosophy uniting rational logic, Sufi mysticism, and theological revelation through the concept of evolving existence.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मुल्ला सद्रा का दिव्य दर्शन, जो तर्क, सूफी रहस्यवाद और धर्मशास्त्र को 'सतत गतिशीलता' (सद्भाव) के सिद्धांत के तहत एक सूत्र में पिरोता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The culmination of medieval Islamic philosophy synthesizing Peripatetic logic, Illuminationism, and Sufi metaphysics; Formulation of 'substantial motion' (al-harakat al-jawhariyya), proving that the physical cosmos is constantly evolving in its very substance; Serving as the reigning philosophical paradigm in traditional Iranian Islamic seminaries (Hawzas) to this day

worldviews.historical_era: c. 18th Century CE (Rooted in Hanbali Athari tradition c. 9th Century)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab / Ibn Taymiyyah (Historical forebear)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Strict literal adherence to Quran and Hadith interpreted through the early pious ancestors (Salaf), rejecting later philosophical Kalam.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Kitab al-Tawhid (Ibn Abd al-Wahhab) (1740); Al-Aqeedah al-Wasitiyyah (Ibn Taymiyyah) (1300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab: True monotheism (Tawhid) requires stripping away all saint veneration, tomb visitation, and philosophical innovations (Bid'ah) that compromise the unalloyed sovereignty of God.
worldviews.short_description_en: Puritanical Islamic reform movement advocating a return to the pristine practices of the early Muslim generations (Salaf) and absolute monotheism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सलाफी सुधार आंदोलन, जो शुरुआती मुस्लिम पीढ़ियों (सलाफ) के शुद्ध आचरण की ओर लौटने और सभी प्रकार के नवाचारों (बिदअत) के विरोध पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Puritanical Islamic reform movement advocating a return to the pristine practices of the early Muslim generations (Salaf) and absolute monotheism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सलाफी सुधार आंदोलन, जो शुरुआती मुस्लिम पीढ़ियों (सलाफ) के शुद्ध आचरण की ओर लौटने और सभी प्रकार के नवाचारों (बिदअत) के विरोध पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 18th-century religious revival and political alliance in Najd founding the modern Saudi state; Intense theological purification campaigns against popular Sufi shrine culture and folk religious practices; Global missionary spread supported by modern petroleum economics and publishing

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Harmonizing Islamic revelation with modern rationalism, science, constitutional democracy, and independent legal reasoning (Ijtihad).

worldviews.full_description_hi: इस्लामी आधुनिकतावाद, जो आधुनिक विज्ञान, लोकतंत्र और स्वतंत्र तार्किक विवेचन (इज्तिहाद) के साथ इस्लामी मूल्यों का समन्वय करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Intellectual response to European colonial hegemony by demonstrating compatibility between Islam and science; Founding of modern universities (like Aligarh Muslim University) combining secular sciences with religious ethics; Reinterpreting medieval jurisprudence to advocate for women's education, constitutional rights, and parliamentary democracy

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Ifá divination corpus (Odù Ifá), binary computational pattern recognition, and spiritual alignment with one's destiny (Ori).
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Odù Ifá Literary Corpus (Oral / Written) (-500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ifa Divination Verse: Character is beauty; a person may have all the wealth in the world, but without good character (Iwa), they are nothing.
worldviews.short_description_en: Sophisticated West African cosmological system centered on Olodumare (Supreme God), Orisha deities, and the binary Ifa divination oracle.
worldviews.short_description_hi: योरूबा लोगों की इफा-ओरिषा परंपरा, जो परमेश्वर (ओलोदुमारे), प्रकृति की शक्तियों (ओरिषा) और इफा ज्योतिषीय भविष्यवाणियों पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Sophisticated West African cosmological system centered on Olodumare (Supreme God), Orisha deities, and the binary Ifa divination oracle.
worldviews.full_description_hi: योरूबा लोगों की इफा-ओरिषा परंपरा, जो परमेश्वर (ओलोदुमारे), प्रकृति की शक्तियों (ओरिषा) और इफा ज्योतिषीय भविष्यवाणियों पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The ancient city of Ife serving as the spiritual cradle of Yoruba civilization and sacred kingship; Transatlantic preservation and adaptation of Orisha worship in Cuba (Santeria), Brazil (Candomble), and Haiti; UNESCO recognition of the Ifa Divination system as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity

worldviews.famous_quote: Ogotemmêli: The spoken word is water that nourishes the dry earth of the human soul and orders the stars in the sky.

worldviews.short_description_hi: माली के डोगोन समुदाय का जटिल ब्रह्मांड विज्ञान, जो सृष्टि की उत्पत्ति, तारे-नक्षत्रों के प्रतीक और आत्मा के द्वैत पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Intricate cosmological system of Mali featuring complex creation myths, astronomical symbolism, and spiritual duality.
worldviews.full_description_hi: माली के डोगोन समुदाय का जटिल ब्रह्मांड विज्ञान, जो सृष्टि की उत्पत्ति, तारे-नक्षत्रों के प्रतीक और आत्मा के द्वैत पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The dramatic architecture of Dogon cliff dwellings along the Bandiagara Escarpment in Mali; International attention drawn by Marcel Griaule's recording of complex cosmological and astronomical myths; Preservation of intricate sculpture, masked dances (Dama), and symbolic metallurgy

worldviews.famous_quote: Serer Tradition: Roog is the beginning and the end, the universal architect whose breath sustains all living things.

worldviews.short_description_hi: सेनेगल की सेरेर परंपरा, जो सर्वोच्च ईश्वर 'रूग', पूर्वज पूजा और प्राचीन खगोल विज्ञान (तारे-नक्षत्रों की गणना) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Monotheistic indigenous religion of Senegal centered on Supreme God Roog, ancestral veneration, and sophisticated stellar astronomy.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सेनेगल की सेरेर परंपरा, जो सर्वोच्च ईश्वर 'रूग', पूर्वज पूजा और प्राचीन खगोल विज्ञान (तारे-नक्षत्रों की गणना) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The annual Xoyo ceremony where Saltigue priests forecast agricultural yields, rainfall, and national events using astronomy; Preservation of matrilineal clan structures and sacred baobab tree veneration; Maintaining spiritual autonomy through centuries of regional Islamic and Christian expansion

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Relational personhood ('Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu'), ancestral mediation (Amadlozi), and communal harmony.

worldviews.famous_quote: Southern African Proverb (Ubuntu): Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu (A person is a person through other persons).
worldviews.short_description_en: Southern African philosophy asserting that human identity is thoroughly relational: 'I am because we are' (Ubuntu).
worldviews.short_description_hi: दक्षिण अफ्रीका का 'उबुन्तु' दर्शन, जो सिखाता है कि 'मैं इसलिए हूँ क्योंकि हम हैं' — मनुष्य का अस्तित्व दूसरों के साथ जुड़ा है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Southern African philosophy asserting that human identity is thoroughly relational: 'I am because we are' (Ubuntu).
worldviews.full_description_hi: दक्षिण अफ्रीका का 'उबुन्तु' दर्शन, जो सिखाता है कि 'मैं इसलिए हूँ क्योंकि हम हैं' — मनुष्य का अस्तित्व दूसरों के साथ जुड़ा है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Guiding post-apartheid South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission toward restorative justice; Serving as a global ethical benchmark for interconnected human dignity, empathy, and community; The spiritual practice of traditional healers (Sangomas and Inyangas) connecting with ancestral spirits

worldviews.name_hi: बांटू दार्शनिक प्रणाली (बल और जीवन दर्शन)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Dynamic vital force (Ntu), hierarchical energy interactions, and strengthening life force through moral action.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Bantu Philosophy (Placide Tempels) (1945)
worldviews.famous_quote: Bantu Ontological Axiom: Being is force; force is being. Man can increase or decrease his vital force and that of other beings.
worldviews.short_description_en: Central and Southern African metaphysics viewing reality as a hierarchy of dynamic vital forces (Ntu) rather than static matter.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मध्य और दक्षिण अफ्रीका का बांचू दर्शन, जो मानता है कि वास्तविकता जड़ पदार्थ नहीं, बल्कि गतिशील जीवन-ऊर्जा (नतू) का पदानुक्रम है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Central and Southern African metaphysics viewing reality as a hierarchy of dynamic vital forces (Ntu) rather than static matter.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मध्य और दक्षिण अफ्रीका का बांचू दर्शन, जो मानता है कि वास्तविकता जड़ पदार्थ नहीं, बल्कि गतिशील जीवन-ऊर्जा (नतू) का पदानुक्रम है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The codification and philosophical recognition of African ontology by Belgian missionary-philosopher Placide Tempels; Providing a coherent metaphysical framework for understanding African morality as the enhancement of life force; Unifying dozens of Bantu-speaking linguistic and cultural groups under a shared metaphysical umbrella

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Veneration of deified ancestors (Razana), taboo (Fady), and the Famadihana (turning of the bones) mortuary ritual.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Malagasy Kabary (Oratorical poetry corpus) (-500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Malagasy Proverb: Man passes away, but the ancestors remain; they are the true owners of the land and the guardians of life.
worldviews.short_description_en: Madagascan spiritual tradition uniting African and Asian roots, centered on deified ancestors (Razana) and ritual reburial.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेडागास्कर की मलागासी परंपरा, जो अफ्रीकी और एशियाई जड़ों का मेल है और पूर्वजों (राज़ाना) की पूजा तथा 'फामादिहाना' (हड्डियों का उत्सव) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Madagascan spiritual tradition uniting African and Asian roots, centered on deified ancestors (Razana) and ritual reburial.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेडागास्कर की मलागासी परंपरा, जो अफ्रीकी और एशियाई जड़ों का मेल है और पूर्वजों (राज़ाना) की पूजा तथा 'फामादिहाना' (हड्डियों का उत्सव) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The unique synthesis of Southeast Asian Austronesian and East African Bantu cultural heritages in Madagascar; The Famadihana ritual where families periodically exhume, re-wrap, and dance with ancestral remains; Strict observance of Fady (taboos) protecting sacred tombs, forests, and social order

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Worship of Ngai (Supreme Creator residing on Mount Kenya) facing sacred fig trees, generational initiation councils.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Facing Mount Kenya (Jomo Kenyatta) (1938)
worldviews.famous_quote: Kikuyu Prayer: Ngai, owner of brightness, dwell upon the holy mountain of Kirinyaga and bless our lands and children.
worldviews.short_description_en: East African indigenous monotheistic tradition of Kenya centered on Ngai (Creator) and sacred communion at Mount Kenya.
worldviews.short_description_hi: केन्या की किकुयू परंपरा, जो माउंट केन्या पर निवास करने वाले परमेश्वर 'न्गई' और पवित्र अंजीर वृक्षों के नीचे होने वाली पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: East African indigenous monotheistic tradition of Kenya centered on Ngai (Creator) and sacred communion at Mount Kenya.
worldviews.full_description_hi: केन्या की किकुयू परंपरा, जो माउंट केन्या पर निवास करने वाले परमेश्वर 'न्गई' और पवित्र अंजीर वृक्षों के नीचे होने वाली पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Performing sacred prayers facing Mount Kenya (Kirinyaga) around fig trees (Mugumo); Jomo Kenyatta's anthropological documentation of Kikuyu democratic governance and religion in Facing Mount Kenya; Resilient cultural memory and anti-colonial resistance rooted in ancestral land stewardship

worldviews.name_hi: लाकोटा पवित्र मार्ग (वाकन टंका - उत्तर अमेरिका)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: White Buffalo Calf Woman / Ancestral Seven Sacred Rites
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Mitakuye Oyasin ('All my relations'), vision quests (Hante Pi), sweat lodge purification (Inikagapi), and sacred pipe (Chanunpa) communion.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Black Elk Speaks (Recorded oral teachings by John Neihardt) (1932)
worldviews.famous_quote: Black Elk: The first peace, which is the most important, is that which comes within the souls of people when they realize their relationship, their oneness, with the universe.
worldviews.short_description_en: Plains Indigenous American tradition honoring Wakan Tanka (Great Mystery) and universal kinship through the Seven Sacred Rites.
worldviews.short_description_hi: उत्तरी अमेरिका के लाकोटा लोगों का पवित्र मार्ग, जो वाकन टंका (परम रहस्य) और समस्त सृष्टि के साथ भाईचारे (मिताकुये ओयासिन) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Plains Indigenous American tradition honoring Wakan Tanka (Great Mystery) and universal kinship through the Seven Sacred Rites.
worldviews.full_description_hi: उत्तरी अमेरिका के लाकोटा लोगों का पवित्र मार्ग, जो वाकन टंका (परम रहस्य) और समस्त सृष्टि के साथ भाईचारे (मिताकुये ओयासिन) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The transmission of the Sacred Chanunpa (Pipe) by the White Buffalo Calf Woman to unite all nations; Resilient survival of the Sun Dance and sacred ceremonies despite 19th-century US government bans; The profound ecological ethic of kinship with all living beings encapsulated in Mitakuye Oyasin

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Hózhǫ́ (balance, harmony, beauty, health, and goodness), sandpainting healing ceremonies, and walking in beauty.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Diné Bahaneʼ (The Navajo Creation Story) (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Navajo Blessingway Chant: With beauty before me, with beauty behind me, with beauty above me, with beauty below me, with beauty all around me, I walk.
worldviews.short_description_en: Southwestern Indigenous American philosophy centering on Hózhǫ́—the continuous cultivation of cosmic balance, harmony, and beauty.
worldviews.short_description_hi: नावाहो (दिने) लोगों का 'होजो' दर्शन, जो जीवन में निरंतर संतुलन, आंतरिक शांति और सौंदर्य (हार्मनी) बनाए रखने की साधना है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Southwestern Indigenous American philosophy centering on Hózhǫ́—the continuous cultivation of cosmic balance, harmony, and beauty.
worldviews.full_description_hi: नावाहो (दिने) लोगों का 'होजो' दर्शन, जो जीवन में निरंतर संतुलन, आंतरिक शांति और सौंदर्य (हार्मनी) बनाए रखने की साधना है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The Long Walk of the Navajo (1864) and their triumphant return to their sacred four-corner homeland; Preservation of intricate dry sandpaintings and complex multi-day healing chants (Nightway and Blessingway); Navajo Code Talkers using their complex tonal language to secure allied victory in World War II

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Ayni (sacred reciprocity: 'Today for you, tomorrow for me'), reverence for Pachamama (Mother Earth) and Apus (sacred mountains).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Andean Oral Mythology and Quipu Archives (-1200)
worldviews.famous_quote: Andean Andean Proverb: Do not steal, do not lie, do not be lazy — live in sacred reciprocity (Ayni) with the earth and all beings.
worldviews.short_description_en: High-altitude South American Indigenous worldview centered on sacred reciprocity (Ayni), Pachamama (Earth Mother), and mountain spirits.
worldviews.short_description_hi: एंडिज पर्वतमाला का प्राचीन दर्शन, जो पचमामा (धरती माता) के प्रति सम्मान और आपसी पवित्र लेन-देन (अइनी) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: High-altitude South American Indigenous worldview centered on sacred reciprocity (Ayni), Pachamama (Earth Mother), and mountain spirits.
worldviews.full_description_hi: एंडिज पर्वतमाला का प्राचीन दर्शन, जो पचमामा (धरती माता) के प्रति सम्मान और आपसी पवित्र लेन-देन (अइनी) पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The architectural and spiritual marvel of Machu Picchu aligned with solar and mountain energies; Surviving centuries of Spanish colonial evangelization by syncretizing Pachamama with the Virgin Mary; Bolivia and Ecuador enshrining 'Rights of Nature' (Mother Earth) in modern national constitutions inspired by indigenous philosophy

worldviews.name_hi: माया सभ्यता और पोपोल वुह दर्शन
worldviews.historical_era: Ancient Indigenous Tradition (Classic Maya c. 250 CE)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Cyclic time (Long Count calendar), interdependence with corn (Maize) creation, and cosmic balance between underworld and sky.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Popol Vuh (Book of the Council) (1550); Maya Hieroglyphic Codices (300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Popol Vuh Opening: This is the account of how all was in suspense, all calm, in silence; all motionless, still, and the expanse of the sky was empty.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mesoamerican cosmological tradition rooted in the Popol Vuh creation myth, advanced astronomy, and sacred maize agriculture.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेसोअमेरिका की माया संस्कृति, जो 'पोपोल वुह' ग्रंथ, मक्का की उत्पत्ति की कथा, और खगोलीय कैलंडर चक्रों पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Mesoamerican cosmological tradition rooted in the Popol Vuh creation myth, advanced astronomy, and sacred maize agriculture.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेसोअमेरिका की माया संस्कृति, जो 'पोपोल वुह' ग्रंथ, मक्का की उत्पत्ति की कथा, और खगोलीय कैलंडर चक्रों पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The construction of monumental pyramid temples at Tikal, Palenque, and Chichen Itza aligned with stellar equinoxes; The preservation of the Popol Vuh manuscript in Quiche language during the early colonial period; The 2012 global re-emergence of Maya calendar consciousness and indigenous cultural renaissance

worldviews.historical_era: c. 14th Century CE (Rooted in Mesoamerican antiquity)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Ometeotl (Dual Supreme Creator), cosmic energy nourishment through sacred breath/sacrifice, and cyclical destruction/rebirth of Suns.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Florentine Codex (Bernardino de Sahagun compilation) (1577); Aztec Calendar Stone Inscriptions (1479)
worldviews.famous_quote: King Nezahualcoyotl: Is it true indeed that one lives on earth? Not forever on earth: only a little while here.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mesoamerican imperial cosmology centered on Ometeotl (dual creator), solar nourishment, and fleeting earthly existence.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन मेक्सिका (एजटेक) दर्शन, जो ओमेतेओत्ल (द्वैत परमेश्वर), सूर्य के पोषण और इस नश्वर संसार की क्षणभंगुरता पर केंद्रित है।

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Direct animistic communication with plant spirits (Icaros / sacred songs), visionary healing, and ecological interconnectedness.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Oral Shamanic Icaros and Plant Spirit Lore (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Amazonian Shamanic Proverb: The plants do not just heal the physical body; they sing to the soul and teach humans how to live in harmony with the forest.

worldviews.historical_associations: Millennia of indigenous botanical pharmacology discovering complex brews like Ayahuasca; The late 20th and 21st-century global diaspora of Amazonian healing ceremonies across Western societies; Indigenous political movements defending the Amazon rainforest as a living sacred entity against deforestation

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Guaraní Shamans (Caraí) / Ñande Ru (Our Great Father)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Seeking Yvy Marãe'ỹ (Land Without Evil) through sacred dance, song, moral purity, and transcending earthly suffering.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Guaraní Mythological and Chants Corpus (Recorded by Curt Nimuendajú) (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Guaraní Shamanic Chant: We dance to lift our bodies into lightness, seeking the sacred Land Without Evil where death and sorrow do not exist.
worldviews.short_description_en: South American Indigenous vision of attaining immortality and earthly paradise (Yvy Marãe'ỹ) through sacred dance and song.
worldviews.short_description_hi: दक्षिण अमेरिका के गुआरानी लोगों की खोज, जो पवित्र नृत्य और संगीत के माध्यम से इस लोक में 'अमृत भूमि' (इवी मराएय) प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: South American Indigenous vision of attaining immortality and earthly paradise (Yvy Marãe'ỹ) through sacred dance and song.
worldviews.full_description_hi: दक्षिण अमेरिका के गुआरानी लोगों की खोज, जो पवित्र नृत्य और संगीत के माध्यम से इस लोक में 'अमृत भूमि' (इवी मराएय) प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: Historical mass migrations of Guaraní communities across South America searching for the earthly paradise; Preservation of the rich Guaraní language, which remains an official national language of Paraguay alongside Spanish; The spiritual resilience of forest-dwelling communities defending their ancestral lands

worldviews.name_hi: हाउडेनोसौनी शांति का महान नियम (इरोक़्वाइ संविधान)
worldviews.geographic_origin: Northeastern North America (Upstate New York / Canada)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Consensual democracy, the Seventh Generation principle (evaluating decisions for future descendants), and matrilineal clan governance.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Great Law of Peace Wampum Belt Oral Constitution (1142)
worldviews.famous_quote: Haudenosaunee Great Law Principle: In our every deliberation, we must consider the impact of our decisions on the next seven generations.
worldviews.short_description_en: Northeastern Indigenous American constitutional democracy centered on the Great Law of Peace, consensus, and future generations.
worldviews.short_description_hi: उत्तर-पूर्वी अमेरिका के इरोक़्वाइ (हाउडेनोसौनी) लोगों का शांति और लोकतंत्र का महान संविधान, जो 'सात पीढ़ियों' की दूरदर्शिता सिखाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Northeastern Indigenous American constitutional democracy centered on the Great Law of Peace, consensus, and future generations.
worldviews.full_description_hi: उत्तर-पूर्वी अमेरिका के इरोक़्वाइ (हाउडेनोसौनी) लोगों का शांति और लोकतंत्र का महान संविधान, जो 'सात पीढ़ियों' की दूरदर्शिता सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The union of the Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga, Seneca, and Tuscarora nations into the Iroquois Confederacy; Direct philosophical inspiration for the framing of the United States Constitution and federal democracy; The Code of Handsome Lake (Gai'wiio) revitalizing traditional longhouse spirituality and temperance

worldviews.name_hi: इन्युइट शमनवाद (सिला और प्रकृति आत्माएं - आर्कटिक)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sila (breath/consciousness of the cosmos), respect for marine mammal spirits (Sedna), and strict taboo observance.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Inuit Circumpolar Oral Mythology and Sedna Legends (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Aua (Inuit Shaman interviewed by Knud Rasmussen): The greatest danger of life lies in the fact that human food consists entirely of souls... We do not believe, we fear; we fear the spirits of life and death.
worldviews.short_description_en: Arctic Indigenous worldview centering on Sila (cosmic breath/mind), respect for animal souls, and appeasement of sea goddess Sedna.
worldviews.short_description_hi: आर्कटिक क्षेत्र के इन्युइट लोगों का धर्म, जो ब्रह्मांडीय चेतना 'सिला', समुद्री देवी 'सेद्ना' और जीवों की आत्माओं के प्रति आदर पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Arctic Indigenous worldview centering on Sila (cosmic breath/mind), respect for animal souls, and appeasement of sea goddess Sedna.
worldviews.full_description_hi: आर्कटिक क्षेत्र के इन्युइट लोगों का धर्म, जो ब्रह्मांडीय चेतना 'सिला', समुद्री देवी 'सेद्ना' और जीवों की आत्माओं के प्रति आदर पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Survival and profound ecological attunement across the harshest polar climates on Earth; Shamanic soul flights led by Angakkuq to the bottom of the ocean to appease Sedna and ensure whale and seal hunting success; Modern Inuit leadership in global climate change advocacy grounded in traditional ice wisdom

worldviews.canonical_texts: Hopi Emergence and Prophecy Oral Traditions (-1000)

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Breaking the 'mitote' (dream of the planet), mastery of awareness, and transforming personal agreements through impeccable word and intent.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Four Agreements (Don Miguel Ruiz) (1997); Ancient Toltec Codex Fragments (1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Don Miguel Ruiz: Be impeccable with your word. Don't take anything personally. Don't make assumptions. Always do your best.

worldviews.short_description_hi: मेसोअमेरिका की तोल्तेक परंपरा, जो भ्रम की निद्रा (मितोते) को तोड़कर व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता, सत्य और क्वेतजाल्कोआत्ल के ज्ञान मार्ग पर चलती है।

worldviews.full_description_hi: मेसोअमेरिका की तोल्तेक परंपरा, जो भ्रम की निद्रा (मितोते) को तोड़कर व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता, सत्य और क्वेतजाल्कोआत्ल के ज्ञान मार्ग पर चलती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The historical Toltec civilization of Tula serving as the cultural and spiritual teacher for subsequent Mesoamerican empires; The mythos of Quetzalcoatl (The Feathered Serpent) as the patron of wisdom, priesthood, and inner transformation; The late 20th-century global popularization of Toltec agreements for personal psychological freedom

worldviews.name_hi: जापोतेक शमनवाद और पूर्वज पूजा (ओक्साका, मैक्सिको)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Veneration of natural forces (Cocijo - rain/lightning), 260-day calendar divination (Pije), and direct communion with ancestors (Pichina).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Monte Albán Epigraphic and Archaeological Codices (-300)
worldviews.famous_quote: Zapotec Traditional Saying: The ancestors walk beside us in the stones of Monte Albán; we are never truly alone.
worldviews.short_description_en: Oaxacan indigenous tradition centered on Monte Albán sacred geography, lightning deity Cocijo, and ancestral communion.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेक्सिको के ओक्साका क्षेत्र की जापोतेक परंपरा, जो मोंते अल्बान के प्राचीन मंदिरों, तड़ित देवता 'कोसिजो' और पूर्वजों के सम्मान पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Oaxacan indigenous tradition centered on Monte Albán sacred geography, lightning deity Cocijo, and ancestral communion.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेक्सिको के ओक्साका क्षेत्र की जापोतेक परंपरा, जो मोंते अल्बान के प्राचीन मंदिरों, तड़ित देवता 'कोसिजो' और पूर्वजों के सम्मान पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The construction of the majestic mountaintop ceremonial city of Monte Albán in Oaxaca; Preservation of sophisticated 260-day divinatory calendar systems (Pije) used across generations; Syncretic blending of ancient Zapotec rain and lightning deities with Catholic patron saints

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Mixtec Scribes / Lord 8 Deer Jaguar Claw
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pictographic history reading, genealogical lineage anchoring to sacred trees (Apoala), and duality of creator gods (One Deer).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Codex Nuttall (1350); Codex Vindobonensis Mexicanus I (1250)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mixtec Codex Narrative: From the great sacred tree of Apoala emerged our noble ancestors, born directly from the earth and sky.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mesoamerican pictographic tradition recording divine genealogies, sacred creation at Apoala, and royal dynasties in painted codices.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मिक्स्तेक संस्कृति की चित्रलिपि परंपरा, जो अपोआला के पवित्र वृक्ष से राजवंशों की उत्पत्ति और प्राचीन मिक्स्तेक इतिहास को चित्रित करती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Mesoamerican pictographic tradition recording divine genealogies, sacred creation at Apoala, and royal dynasties in painted codices.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मिक्स्तेक संस्कृति की चित्रलिपि परंपरा, जो अपोआला के पवित्र वृक्ष से राजवंशों की उत्पत्ति और प्राचीन मिक्स्तेक इतिहास को चित्रित करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Creation of some of the world's most exquisitely painted pre-Columbian folding screen deer-skin codices; The epic military and marital unification campaigns of Lord 8 Deer Jaguar Claw across Oaxaca; Resilient preservation of Mixtec language, textiles, and ritual calendar reckoning

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Solar and fire worship (Curicaueri), veneration of the underworld goddess Cuerauaperi, and unique metal/metallurgical sacred arts.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Relación de Michoacán (1541)
worldviews.famous_quote: Relación de Michoacán: Curicaueri is our grand father the fire, who warms the cosmos and feeds the empire with his sacred flame.
worldviews.short_description_en: Pre-Columbian tradition of Michoacán centered on solar deity Curicaueri, sacred fire temples (Yácatas), and metallurgy.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मिचोआकान के पुरेपेचा लोगों का धर्म, जो सूर्य देवता 'कुरिकाउेरि', अर्धवृत्ताकार पिरामिडों (याकाता) और पवित्र अग्नि पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Pre-Columbian tradition of Michoacán centered on solar deity Curicaueri, sacred fire temples (Yácatas), and metallurgy.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मिचोआकान के पुरेपेचा लोगों का धर्म, जो सूर्य देवता 'कुरिकाउेरि', अर्धवृत्ताकार पिरामिडों (याकाता) और पवित्र अग्नि पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The Purépecha Empire remaining one of the few great Mesoamerican powers undefeated by the Aztec military machine; Pioneering advanced pre-Columbian metallurgy in copper and bronze for sacred bells, tools, and ornaments; The vibrant annual celebration of the Night of the Dead (Día de Muertos) around Lake Pátzcuaro

worldviews.name_hi: विचोल / विसारिका परंपरा और विरिकूटा तीर्थयात्रा (मैक्सिको)
worldviews.geographic_origin: Sierra Madre Occidental (Jalisco / Nayarit / San Luis Potosí, Mexico)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Visionary plant communion (Hikuri / Peyote), annual sacred desert pilgrimage to Wirikuta, and yarn painting cosmology.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Wixárika Oral Mythological and Shamanic Song Corpus (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Wixárika Shamanic Teaching: We walk the ancient trail to Wirikuta to find the Blue Deer, to see through the eyes of the gods, and to bring back rain and life for our people.
worldviews.short_description_en: Mexican indigenous tradition centering on Grandfather Fire (Tatewari), the Blue Deer, and the annual sacred pilgrimage to Wirikuta.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेक्सिको के विचोल (विसारिका) लोगों की परंपरा, जो 'दादा अग्नि' (तातेवारी) और विरिकूटा मरुस्थल की पवित्र तीर्थयात्रा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Mexican indigenous tradition centering on Grandfather Fire (Tatewari), the Blue Deer, and the annual sacred pilgrimage to Wirikuta.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेक्सिको के विचोल (विसारिका) लोगों की परंपरा, जो 'दादा अग्नि' (तातेवारी) और विरिकूटा मरुस्थल की पवित्र तीर्थयात्रा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The arduous annual 300-mile foot pilgrimage across desert and mountain to the sacred homeland of Wirikuta; The creation of intricate yarn paintings and beadwork mapping divine visions and creation realms; Relentless indigenous legal defense of Wirikuta against transnational mining and corporate desecration

worldviews.name_hi: तिवानाकू ब्रह्मांड विज्ञान और सूर्य द्वार (बोलीविया)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Solar alignment architecture, Gateway of the Sun symbolism, and reverence for Lake Titicaca as the cosmic womb of creation.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Gateway of the Sun Iconography and Aymara Oral Legends (500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Aymara Traditional Andean Saying: Lake Titicaca is the mirror of the sky where the creator sun first emerged to warm the high altiplano.
worldviews.short_description_en: Pre-Inca Andean civilization centered on Lake Titicaca, the Gateway of the Sun, and solar-agricultural cosmic alignment.
worldviews.short_description_hi: टिटिचाका झील के पास स्थित प्राचीन तिवानाकू सभ्यता, जो सूर्य द्वार (गेटवे ऑफ द सन) और उच्चाल्टीप्लानो के खगोलीय दर्शन पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Pre-Inca Andean civilization centered on Lake Titicaca, the Gateway of the Sun, and solar-agricultural cosmic alignment.
worldviews.full_description_hi: टिटिचाका झील के पास स्थित प्राचीन तिवानाकू सभ्यता, जो सूर्य द्वार (गेटवे ऑफ द सन) और उच्चाल्टीप्लानो के खगोलीय दर्शन पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The monumental stonework and engineering of Pumapunku and the Gateway of the Sun near Lake Titicaca; Serving as the spiritual and political prototype for subsequent Andean states, including the Inca Empire; Modern Aymara indigenous spiritual celebrations held at Tiwanaku ruins during the Southern Hemisphere winter solstice

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Transformational jaguar shamanism, hallucinogenic San Pedro cactus rituals, and subterranean acoustic oracle chambers (El Lanzón).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Chavín de Huántar Architectural and Sculptural Iconography (-800)
worldviews.famous_quote: Archaeological Iconographic Interpretation: Through the fangs of the jaguar and the vision of San Pedro, the shaman bridges the underworld and the sky inside the stone labyrinth.
worldviews.short_description_en: Early Andean horizon religion centered on Chavín de Huántar, subterranean oracle stones, and transformational jaguar shamanism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पेरू की प्राचीन चाविन संस्कृति, जो भूमिगत गूंजने वाले मंदिरों (एल लांसोन), सैन पेड्रो कैक्टस के प्रयोग और जगुआर शमन साधना पर आधारित थी।
worldviews.full_description_en: Early Andean horizon religion centered on Chavín de Huántar, subterranean oracle stones, and transformational jaguar shamanism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पेरू की प्राचीन चाविन संस्कृति, जो भूमिगत गूंजने वाले मंदिरों (एल लांसोन), सैन पेड्रो कैक्टस के प्रयोग और जगुआर शमन साधना पर आधारित थी।
worldviews.historical_associations: The construction of the Chavín de Huántar temple labyrinth with rushing water channels simulating roaring jaguars; The widespread dissemination of feline-human iconography across early Andean civilization; Pioneering complex psychoactive plant use (San Pedro cactus) for state-level religious oracle consultation

worldviews.name_hi: मोचे सभ्यता और पवित्र धातु कर्म (उत्तरी पेरू)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sacred metallurgy as spiritual transformation, elite warrior-priest sacrifice rituals, and coastal marine animism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Moche Ceramic Portrait Vessels and Tomb Murals (500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Archaeological Tomb Interpretation: In the tombs of Sipán, gold and silver are not mere wealth; they are the luminous skin of the sun and moon embodied in earthly rulers.
worldviews.short_description_en: Pre-Inca northern Peruvian coastal civilization renowned for exquisite gold metallurgy, portrait ceramics, and elite sacrificial rites.
worldviews.short_description_hi: उत्तरी पेरू की प्राचीन मोचे सभ्यता, जो उन्नत स्वर्ण धातु कर्म (गोल्डस्मिथ्री), सजीव मिट्टी के बर्तनों और राजसी अनुष्ठानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध थी।
worldviews.full_description_en: Pre-Inca northern Peruvian coastal civilization renowned for exquisite gold metallurgy, portrait ceramics, and elite sacrificial rites.
worldviews.full_description_hi: उत्तरी पेरू की प्राचीन मोचे सभ्यता, जो उन्नत स्वर्ण धातु कर्म (गोल्डस्मिथ्री), सजीव मिट्टी के बर्तनों और राजसी अनुष्ठानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध थी।
worldviews.historical_associations: The breathtaking archaeological discovery of the unlooted royal tomb of the Lord of Sipán in 1987; Mastery of advanced gold, silver, and copper electrochemical plating and metallurgy; Intricate ceramic portrait vessels depicting vivid human emotions, deities, and ritual combat

worldviews.name_hi: नास्का रेखाएं और मरुस्थलीय खगोल दर्शन (पेरू)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Ritual walking paths, underground aqueduct engineering (Puquios), and water/fertility invocation etched into the desert floor.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Nasca Desert Geoglyph Lines and Ceramic Iconography (400)
worldviews.famous_quote: Archaeological Water-Cult Interpretation: The massive lines etched across the desert floor are sacred pathways and prayers for water addressed to the mountain gods above.
worldviews.short_description_en: Southern Peruvian desert civilization famous for colossal geoglyphs, subterranean aqueducts, and water-fertility rituals.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पेरू के नास्का मरुस्थल की विशाल भू-रेखाएं (Geoglyphs), भूमिगत जल प्रणालियों (पुकियोस) और वर्षा जल अनुष्ठानों की प्राचीन संस्कृति।
worldviews.full_description_en: Southern Peruvian desert civilization famous for colossal geoglyphs, subterranean aqueducts, and water-fertility rituals.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पेरू के नास्का मरुस्थल की विशाल भू-रेखाएं (Geoglyphs), भूमिगत जल प्रणालियों (पुकियोस) और वर्षा जल अनुष्ठानों की प्राचीन संस्कृति।
worldviews.historical_associations: The creation of hundreds of colossal geometric lines, animal, and plant geoglyphs visible only from the sky; Engineering sophisticated underground aqueducts (Puquios) that still bring desert water to arid valleys today; Ceremonial walking rituals along geoglyph paths to invoke rain and agricultural abundance

worldviews.name_hi: इंका राज्य धर्म (सूर्य देवता इंती और इंतिहुताना)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sun worship (Inti), Emperor as Son of the Sun (Sapa Inca), astronomical hitching posts (Intihuatana), and huacas (sacred sites).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Inca Oral Chronicles recorded by chroniclers (Garcilaso de la Vega) (1609)
worldviews.famous_quote: Inca Sun Prayer: O Sun! Father of our empire, shine upon your children in Tawantinsuyu and keep the balance of the four quarters of the earth.
worldviews.short_description_en: Imperial Andean state religion centered on Inti (Sun God), the Sapa Inca, stone astronomical observatories, and massive sun festivals.
worldviews.short_description_hi: इंका साम्राज्य का राजकीय धर्म, जो सूर्य देवता 'इंति', सम्राट (सपा इंका), मन्दिरों (कोरिकांच) और इंतिहुताना वेधशालाओं पर आधारित था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Imperial Andean state religion centered on Inti (Sun God), the Sapa Inca, stone astronomical observatories, and massive sun festivals.
worldviews.full_description_hi: इंका साम्राज्य का राजकीय धर्म, जो सूर्य देवता 'इंति', सम्राट (सपा इंका), मन्दिरों (कोरिकांच) और इंतिहुताना वेधशालाओं पर आधारित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: The vast Tawantinsuyu Empire uniting the Andes through magnificent stone masonry, roads, and administrative systems; The annual winter solstice festival of Inti Raymi celebrated in Cuzco to hitch the sun back from its farthest journey; The sacred golden Sun Disc enshrined in the Qorikancha temple in Cuzco before Spanish conquest

worldviews.epistemological_framework: The Dreaming (everywhen: past, present, and future simultaneously), sacred songlines (Tjukurrpa), country stewardship, and custodial kinship.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Songlines and Rock Art Sacred Epigraphic Corpus (-60000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Bill Neidjie (Gangalidda Elder): The earth is mother to us all; when you damage the earth, you damage yourself and your future generations.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ancient Australian Indigenous worldview centering on 'The Dreaming'—an all-encompassing dimension of past, present, and future creation and law.
worldviews.short_description_hi: ऑस्ट्रेलियाई आदिवासियों का 'ड्रीमिकी' (तुकुर्पा) दर्शन, जो भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य को एक साथ जोड़ने वाली शाश्वत सृष्टि और प्रकृति से अटूट नाते पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ancient Australian Indigenous worldview centering on 'The Dreaming'—an all-encompassing dimension of past, present, and future creation and law.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ऑस्ट्रेलियाई आदिवासियों का 'ड्रीमिकी' (तुकुर्पा) दर्शन, जो भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य को एक साथ जोड़ने वाली शाश्वत सृष्टि और प्रकृति से अटूट नाते पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Maintaining the world's oldest continuous living culture spanning over 65,000 years of unbroken oral history; Navigating the entire Australian continent using intricate songlines (mapping sacred geography through song and story); Modern global ecological recognition of Aboriginal land management and fire-stick farming wisdom

worldviews.name_hi: माओरी ब्रह्मांड विज्ञान (वाकापापा, तापु और नोआ - न्यूजीलैंड)
worldviews.historical_era: Ancient / Pre-European Polynesian Migration (c. 13th Century CE in Aotearoa)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Ranginui (Sky Father) and Papatūānuku (Earth Mother) Lineage
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Whakapapa (genealogical connection to all living things), Tapu (sacred/restricted) and Noa (ordinary/balanced) duality, and Kaitiakitanga (guardianship).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Māori Oral Whakapapa and Creation Chants (1200)
worldviews.famous_quote: Māori Proverb (Whakataukī): Ko au te whenua, ko te whenua ko au — I am the land, and the land is me.
worldviews.short_description_en: Polynesian worldview rooted in ancestral genealogy (Whakapapa), earth mother Papatūānuku, sacred law (Tapu), and environmental guardianship.
worldviews.short_description_hi: न्यूजीलैंड के माओरी लोगों का दर्शन, जो पृथ्वी माता (पापातुआनुकू) से वंशीय जुड़ाव (वाकापापा), पवित्रता के नियमों (तापु) और पर्यावरण संरक्षण पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Polynesian worldview rooted in ancestral genealogy (Whakapapa), earth mother Papatūānuku, sacred law (Tapu), and environmental guardianship.
worldviews.full_description_hi: न्यूजीलैंड के माओरी लोगों का दर्शन, जो पृथ्वी माता (पापातुआनुकू) से वंशीय जुड़ाव (वाकापापा), पवित्रता के नियमों (तापु) और पर्यावरण संरक्षण पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The epic Polynesian voyaging migration navigating across thousands of miles of open ocean to settle Aotearoa; The signing and ongoing legal/spiritual advocacy surrounding the Treaty of Waitangi; New Zealand legally granting legal personhood rights to the Whanganui River and Te Urewera forest based on Māori kaitiakitanga

worldviews.canonical_texts: Kumulipo (Hawaiian Creation Chant) (-1700)
worldviews.famous_quote: Aloha Spirit Law (Hawaii Revised Statutes): Aloha is the coordination of mind and heart within each person. It brings each person to the Self.
worldviews.short_description_en: Polynesian Hawaiian tradition centered on Mana (spiritual energy), Aloha spirit, reconciliation (Ho'oponopono), and volcano goddess Pele.
worldviews.short_description_hi: हवाई द्वीप की पारंपरिक संस्कृति, जो आध्यात्मिक ऊर्जा (माना), क्षमा-प्रार्थना (हूओपोनोपोनो) और 'अलोहा' (प्रेम और सद्भाव) के भाव पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Polynesian Hawaiian tradition centered on Mana (spiritual energy), Aloha spirit, reconciliation (Ho'oponopono), and volcano goddess Pele.
worldviews.full_description_hi: हवाई द्वीप की पारंपरिक संस्कृति, जो आध्यात्मिक ऊर्जा (माना), क्षमा-प्रार्थना (हूओपोनोपोनो) और 'अलोहा' (प्रेम और सद्भाव) के भाव पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The composition of the Kumulipo creation chant mapping genealogical evolution from coral polyps to humans; The traditional practice of Ho'oponopono for family and community emotional reconciliation and healing; The spiritual stewardship of sacred volcanic craters, temples (Heiau), and ocean waters across the islands

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Fa'asamoa ('The Samoan Way'), Matai title stewardship, communal village organization (Aiga), and profound respect (Loo/Faaaloalo).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Samoan Oral Genealogies and Tagaloa Creation Chants (-1000)

worldviews.full_description_en: Polynesian Samoan way of life structured on family (Aiga), chief title stewardship (Matai), respect, and communal solidarity.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सामोआ की पारंपरिक जीवनशैली (फा'असामोआ), जो परिवार (आइगा), मुखियाओं (माताई) के नेतृत्व और आपसी सम्मान पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Maintaining one of Polynesia's most intact and uncompromised traditional social structures (Fa'asamoa); The vital governance role of Matai (chiefs) managing village lands, justice, and communal welfare; Seamless integration of Christian church life with ancient communal Polynesian ethics

worldviews.name_hi: फिजीयन 'वानुआ' (भूमि और समुदाय का पवित्र बंधन)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Vanua (the land, people, chiefs, and spiritual customs as a single living organism), Tabu, and Kava (Yaqona) communion.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fijian Oral Mythology and Degei Legends (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Fijian Cultural Proverb: The Vanua is not just the soil we farm; it is our identity, our chiefs, our rivers, and our ancestors breathing as one.
worldviews.short_description_en: Melanesian-Polynesian Fijian philosophy uniting land, people, traditions, and chiefdom into a single sacred entity (Vanua).
worldviews.short_description_hi: फिजी की 'वानुआ' अवधारणा, जो भूमि, लोगों, परंपराओं और मुखियाओं को एक ही जीवंत पवित्र इकाई मानती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Melanesian-Polynesian Fijian philosophy uniting land, people, traditions, and chiefdom into a single sacred entity (Vanua).
worldviews.full_description_hi: फिजी की 'वानुआ' अवधारणा, जो भूमि, लोगों, परंपराओं और मुखियाओं को एक ही जीवंत पवित्र इकाई मानती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The sacred Kava (Yaqona) root ceremony cementing peace, alliances, and spiritual communion across villages; Protecting communal land ownership where over 80% of land in Fiji remains under indigenous Vanua title; Preservation of robust traditional village governance alongside national law

worldviews.name_en: Rapa Nui (Easter Island) Mana & Ancestor Cult
worldviews.name_hi: रापा नूई (ईस्टर द्वीप) मोवाई मूर्तियां और 'माना' पूर्वज पूजा
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Mana (spiritual power of ancestors channeled through chiefs), Moai stone statues as ancestral protectors, and Birdman (Tangata Manu) cult.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Rapa Nui Rongorongo Inscriptions (Undeciphered tablets) (1400)
worldviews.famous_quote: Rapa Nui Traditional Oral Tradition: The Moai watch over our island home from the ahu platforms, holding the Mana of our fathers to protect our people.
worldviews.short_description_en: Isolated Polynesian Rapa Nui tradition famous for colossal stone ancestral statues (Moai), Mana, and the Birdman cult.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्रशांत महासागर के एकांत द्वीप रापा नूई (ईस्टर द्वीप) की संस्कृति, जो विशालकाय मोवाई पूर्वज मूर्तियों, 'माना' ऊर्जा और बर्डमैन अनुष्ठानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Isolated Polynesian Rapa Nui tradition famous for colossal stone ancestral statues (Moai), Mana, and the Birdman cult.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्रशांत महासागर के एकांत द्वीप रापा नूई (ईस्टर द्वीप) की संस्कृति, जो विशालकाय मोवाई पूर्वज मूर्तियों, 'माना' ऊर्जा और बर्डमैन अनुष्ठानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The monumental engineering and transport of nearly 900 colossal stone Moai statues across Easter Island; The fascinating historical transition from ancestor statue worship to the competitive Birdman (Tangata Manu) annual endurance cult; Modern cultural resurgence, language preservation, and stewardship of Rapa Nui National Park

worldviews.historical_era: Ancient Indigenous Tradition (Cargo movements c. 19th-20th Century CE)
worldviews.geographic_origin: Vanuatu, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Kastom (traditional laws, customs, and ancestral land ties), ritual exchange, and symbolic anticipation of abundance (Cargo).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Melanesian Oral Kastom Laws (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Vanuatu Kastom Proverb: If we lose our Kastom, we lose our land, our language, and our connection to the ancestors who walk this earth.
worldviews.short_description_en: Melanesian traditional law (Kastom) and prophetic movements (Cargo cults) bridging ancestral heritage with modern geopolitical encounters.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेलानीशियाई 'कास्तोम' (पारंपरिक कानून) और कार्गो पंथ, जो पूर्वजों की संस्कृति की रक्षा और आधुनिक पश्चिमी वस्तुओं के आगमन की भविष्यवाणियों से जुड़े हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: Melanesian traditional law (Kastom) and prophetic movements (Cargo cults) bridging ancestral heritage with modern geopolitical encounters.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेलानीशियाई 'कास्तोम' (पारंपरिक कानून) और कार्गो पंथ, जो पूर्वजों की संस्कृति की रक्षा और आधुनिक पश्चिमी वस्तुओं के आगमन की भविष्यवाणियों से जुड़े हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: The emergence of 'Cargo Cults' during WWII as indigenous societies witnessed massive allied military supply drops; Vanuatu enshrining 'Kastom' as a foundational pillar of its national constitution and land tenure system upon independence in 1980; Preservation of diverse languages and traditional village self-reliance across Melanesian islands

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Syncretic monotheism combining traditional Palauan animist deities with Christian moral elements to preserve indigenous identity against colonial pressures.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Modekngei Hymnals and Oral Prayers (1920)
worldviews.famous_quote: Modekngei Teaching: We unite our traditional spirits and respect for the ancestral islands under one supreme God who protects Palau.
worldviews.short_description_en: Micronesian indigenous religion of Palau founded in the early 20th century to preserve local customs and unity against colonial forces.
worldviews.short_description_hi: माइक्रोनेशिया के पलाऊ द्वीप का 'मोदेकनेई' धर्म, जिसकी स्थापना औपनिवेशिक प्रभावों के बीच स्वदेशी संस्कृति और एकता की रक्षा के लिए हुई थी।
worldviews.full_description_en: Micronesian indigenous religion of Palau founded in the early 20th century to preserve local customs and unity against colonial forces.
worldviews.full_description_hi: माइक्रोनेशिया के पलाऊ द्वीप का 'मोदेकनेई' धर्म, जिसकी स्थापना औपनिवेशिक प्रभावों के बीच स्वदेशी संस्कृति और एकता की रक्षा के लिए हुई थी।
worldviews.historical_associations: Emergence during Japanese colonial rule in Micronesia as a powerful vehicle for cultural self-preservation; Overcoming decades of colonial suppression and missionary pressure to achieve official religious recognition in Palau; Maintaining traditional Palauan chanting, healing arts, and community solidarity

worldviews.name_hi: चामोरो 'ताओताओमोना' पूर्वज पूजा (गुआम और मरियाना द्वीप)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Respect for Taotaomona (ancestral spirits inhabiting ancient latte stone sites, banyan trees, and jungles), seeking permission before entering sacred lands.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Chamorro Oral Genealogies and Latte Stone Lore (-1500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Chamorro Cultural Proverb: Always ask permission of the Taotaomona before stepping into the jungle or touching the latte stones, for the ancestors are always watching.
worldviews.short_description_en: Indigenous Chamorro tradition of Guam and the Marianas centering on deep respect and ritual permission-seeking from ancestral spirits (Taotaomona).
worldviews.short_description_hi: गुआम और मरियाना द्वीप समूह के चामोरो लोगों की परंपरा, जो प्राचीन 'ताओताओमोना' (पूर्वजों की आत्माओं) के प्रति आदर और अनुमति मांगने पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Indigenous Chamorro tradition of Guam and the Marianas centering on deep respect and ritual permission-seeking from ancestral spirits (Taotaomona).
worldviews.full_description_hi: गुआम और मरियाना द्वीप समूह के चामोरो लोगों की परंपरा, जो प्राचीन 'ताओताओमोना' (पूर्वजों की आत्माओं) के प्रति आदर और अनुमति मांगने पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The ancient megalithic Latte Stone architecture serving as sacred ancestral foundations across Guam and the Marianas; Surviving centuries of intense Spanish, Japanese, and American colonial rule and military base land acquisitions; The vital healing role of Suruhåna (traditional herbalists) blending Catholic prayer with ancient plant medicine

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Rapa Nui Island Chiefs and Bird Cult Priests
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Competitive annual survival test scaling cliffs to retrieve the first Sooty Tern egg of the season to determine political leadership and divine favor.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Orongo Petroglyph Rock Carvings and Birdman Legends (1650)
worldviews.famous_quote: Rapa Nui Birdman Tradition: The first egg of the manutara bird brought down from the sea cliffs by the champion grants spiritual power to his clan chief for the entire year.
worldviews.short_description_en: Historical Rapa Nui competitive religious cult dedicated to the creator Make-make and the annual perilous quest for the first migratory bird egg.
worldviews.short_description_hi: ईस्टर द्वीप का ऐतिहासिक 'बर्डमैन' (तांगाता मनु) धार्मिक अनुष्ठान, जो देवता 'माके-माके' की आराधना और वर्ष के पहले समुद्री पक्षी अंडे की खतरनाक खोज पर आधारित था।
worldviews.full_description_en: Historical Rapa Nui competitive religious cult dedicated to the creator Make-make and the annual perilous quest for the first migratory bird egg.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ईस्टर द्वीप का ऐतिहासिक 'बर्डमैन' (तांगाता मनु) धार्मिक अनुष्ठान, जो देवता 'माके-माके' की आराधना और वर्ष के पहले समुद्री पक्षी अंडे की खतरनाक खोज पर आधारित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: The historic sociopolitical shift on Easter Island from giant Moai statue construction to the perilous annual Birdman competition at Orongo; Extensive petroglyph rock carvings of half-human, half-bird figures at the stone village of Orongo overlooking the volcanic crater; Rapid decline following European contact and the introduction of Christianity in the 1860s

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Reconstructionist scholarship of sagas and Eddas, personal honor (Drengskapur), reciprocity with the Æsir and Vanir, and ancestral remembrance (Blót).

worldviews.famous_quote: Hávamál (Poetic Edda): Cattle die, kinsmen die, you yourself will die; but the word of honor never dies, of one who has earned a good name.
worldviews.short_description_en: Modern reconstruction of pre-Christian Germanic and Norse religion honoring the Æsir and Vanir, focusing on honor, kinship, and oaths.

worldviews.famous_quote: Celtic Reconstructionist Maxim: Honor the gods of our ancestors, respect the lore of the manuscripts, and maintain good relations with the spirits of the land.

worldviews.historical_associations: Scholarly preservation and translation of medieval Irish and Welsh mythological manuscripts by modern practitioners; Restoring authentic polytheistic worship of deities like Lugh, Bridget, and the Morrigan distinct from eclectic Wicca; Reviving seasonal fire festivals (Samhain, Imbolc, Beltane, Lughnasadh) across Celtic lands

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Hellenic Sages / Supreme Council of Ethnic Hellenes (YSEE)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Neoplatonic metaphysics, Homeric/Hesiodic mythology, virtues of Xenia (hospitality), and ritual piety (Eusebeia) toward the Olympian gods.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Homeric Hymns (-650); Orphic Hymns (200)
worldviews.famous_quote: Emperor Julian: The Hellenes are bound to the gods by piety, gratitude, and the remembrance of the divine order that governs the cosmos.
worldviews.short_description_en: Reconstructionist revival of ancient Greek religion, honoring the Olympian pantheon through philosophy, hospitality (Xenia), and piety.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन यूनानी धर्म (हेलेनिस्मोस) का आधुनिक पुनरुत्थान, जो ओलंपियन देवी-देवताओं की पूजा, अतिथि सत्कार (ज़ेनिया) और प्लेटोनिक दर्शन पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Reconstructionist revival of ancient Greek religion, honoring the Olympian pantheon through philosophy, hospitality (Xenia), and piety.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्राचीन यूनानी धर्म (हेलेनिस्मोस) का आधुनिक पुनरुत्थान, जो ओलंपियन देवी-देवताओं की पूजा, अतिथि सत्कार (ज़ेनिया) और प्लेटोनिक दर्शन पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Official legal recognition granted to Hellenic Polytheism as a known religion by Greek courts in 2017; Restoring public rituals at ancient archaeological sites such as the Temple of Apollo at Delphi and Mount Olympus; Synthesizing ancient Platonic and Neoplatonic theology with revivalist ritual practice
