worldviews.historical_era: Pre-Christian Baltic Antiquity / Modern Revival c. 1967 CE
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Darna (harmony with nature and cosmos), veneration of Dievas (Supreme God) and goddess Saule (Sun), sacred fire (Auguras), and folkloric song preservation (Dainos).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Lithuanian Folk Songs (Dainos Corpus) (1800)
worldviews.famous_quote: Jonas Trinkūnas: Romuva is the hearth of our ancient spirit, where we celebrate the sacred harmony (Darna) between human beings, nature, and the divine.
worldviews.short_description_en: Revival of traditional Baltic pagan religion centered in Lithuania, honoring cosmic harmony (Darna), sacred fire, and nature deities.
worldviews.short_description_hi: लिथुआनिया का पारंपरिक बाल्टिक धर्म (रोमुवा), जो प्रकृति के साथ ब्रह्मांडीय सामंजस्य (दारना), पवित्र अग्नि और सूर्य देवी की पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Revival of traditional Baltic pagan religion centered in Lithuania, honoring cosmic harmony (Darna), sacred fire, and nature deities.
worldviews.full_description_hi: लिथुआनिया का पारंपरिक बाल्टिक धर्म (रोमुवा), जो प्रकृति के साथ ब्रह्मांडीय सामंजस्य (दारना), पवित्र अग्नि और सूर्य देवी की पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Surviving centuries of intense Christian crusades and Soviet suppression through secret folkloric song and hearth preservation; The formal founding of Romuva as a neo-pagan movement by Jonas Trinkūnas in Soviet-occupied Lithuania in 1967; Deep integration into Lithuanian national cultural identity, choir singing festivals, and nature conservation

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Rod (Supreme ancestral life-force), Prav-Nav-Yav cosmology (order, spirit realm, manifest world), and communal seasonal rites.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Book of Veles (Modern/Folkloric texts) (1950)

worldviews.full_description_en: Reconstructionist Slavic native faith honoring ancestral god Rod, Perun, and Veles, celebrating seasonal cycles and kinship.
worldviews.full_description_hi: स्लाविक मूल धर्म (रोद्नोवेरी), जो पूर्वज देवता 'रोद', पेरुण और वेलेस की पूजा तथा प्रकृति के ऋतु चक्रों के उत्सव पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The modern resurgence of pre-Christian Slavic spirituality across Russia, Ukraine, Poland, and Belarus; Revival of traditional seasonal solstitial festivals like Kupala Night and Maslenitsa; Complex interactions between indigenous pagan reconstruction, nationalism, and folkloric preservation

worldviews.historical_era: Pre-Christian Finno-Ugric Antiquity / Modern Revival c. 1990s CE
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Finnish Folklorists / Modern Taivaan Napapiiri Guilds
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Veneration of Ukko (Thunder God), Tapio (Forest Spirit), Ahti (Water Spirit), and ancestral Runo singing.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Kalevala (Compiled by Elias Lönnrot) (1835)
worldviews.famous_quote: The Kalevala Opening: Mind impels me, and an urge awakens to begin the singing, to let loose the word of power...

worldviews.short_description_hi: फिनिश मूल धर्म (सुओमेन उस्को), जो 'कलेवाला' महाकाव्य, गर्जना देवता 'उक्को', वन आत्माओं और प्रकृति की पवित्रता पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Reconstruction of traditional Finnish pagan religion based on the Kalevala epic, honoring Ukko, forest spirits, and nature.
worldviews.full_description_hi: फिनिश मूल धर्म (सुओमेन उस्को), जो 'कलेवाला' महाकाव्य, गर्जना देवता 'उक्को', वन आत्माओं और प्रकृति की पवित्रता पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The monumental 19th-century compilation of Karelian and Finnish oral epic poetry into the national epic Kalevala; Preservation of ancient animistic reverence for sacred forests, lakes, and thunder deities; The modern legal establishment of recognized native pagan organizations in Finland

worldviews.name_hi: मारी मूल धर्म (मारला - रूस का स्वदेशी धर्म)
worldviews.historical_era: Pre-Christian Uralic Antiquity (Unbroken living folk tradition)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Mari Elders and Sacred Grove Priests (Karta)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sacred grove (Kusoto) worship, offering prayers and animal sacrifices to Oosh Kugu Jumo (Great White God) and nature spirits.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Mari Oral Prayers and Sacred Grove Ritual Liturgies (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mari Traditional Prayer: Great White God, creator of all things, protect our sacred groves, feed our lands, and keep our people in health and peace.
worldviews.short_description_en: Europe's largest surviving continuous native pagan religion, practiced by the Mari people in Russia inside sacred groves (Kusoto).
worldviews.short_description_hi: रूस के मारी गणराज्य का स्वदेशी धर्म, जो यूरोप का सबसे बड़ा जीवित और निरंतर चला आ रहा पवित्र वनों (कुसोतो) का पावन धर्म है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Europe's largest surviving continuous native pagan religion, practiced by the Mari people in Russia inside sacred groves (Kusoto).
worldviews.full_description_hi: रूस के मारी गणराज्य का स्वदेशी धर्म, जो यूरोप का सबसे बड़ा जीवित और निरंतर चला आ रहा पवित्र वनों (कुसोतो) का पावन धर्म है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Remarkably remaining Europe's largest continuously surviving un-Christianized indigenous pagan religion; Conducting massive official state-sanctioned prayer gatherings inside ancient sacred oak and birch groves (Kusoto); Enduring Tsarist and Soviet antireligious campaigns while preserving an unbroken priesthood of Kartas

worldviews.name_hi: अर्मेनियाई मूल धर्म (हेतानूतीउन - प्राचीन अर्मेनियाई धर्म पुनरुत्थान)
worldviews.historical_era: Pre-Christian Armenian Antiquity / Modern Revival c. 1990s CE
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Veneration of pre-Christian Armenian pantheon (Aramazd, Anahit, Vahagn), cosmic order, and sacred Armenian highlands.
worldviews.canonical_texts: History of Armenia (Movses Khorenatsi - Mythological strata) (480)
worldviews.famous_quote: Vahagn Epic Fragment: Heaven and earth were in travail, and the crimson waters were in travail... and from the flame sprang the youthful god Vahagn.
worldviews.short_description_en: Reconstructionist revival of pre-Christian Armenian religion honoring Aramazd, Anahit, and Vahagn in the shadow of Mount Ararat.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्राचीन अर्मेनियाई धर्म (हेतानूतीउन) का पुनरुत्थान, जो अरामज़्द, अनाहित और वाहाग्न जैसे प्राचीन अर्मेनियाई देवी-देवताओं की पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Reconstructionist revival of pre-Christian Armenian religion honoring Aramazd, Anahit, and Vahagn in the shadow of Mount Ararat.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्राचीन अर्मेनियाई धर्म (हेतानूतीउन) का पुनरुत्थान, जो अरामज़्द, अनाहित और वाहाग्न जैसे प्राचीन अर्मेनियाई देवी-देवताओं की पूजा पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Preserving the memory of ancient Armenian paganism before Tiridates III converted the nation to Christianity in 301 CE; Establishing the Garni Temple reconstruction as a focal point for modern neo-pagan rituals in Armenia; Fusing ancient Indo-European Armenian mythology with modern patriotic and cultural identity

worldviews.name_hi: जॉर्जियाई पर्वतीय लोक धर्म (खेवसुरेती और पशाव परंपरा)
worldviews.historical_era: Pre-Christian Caucasian Antiquity (Unbroken mountain folk tradition)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Syncretic mountain shrines (Jvari/Khati), oracle consultation, and sacred blood/beer ritual offerings to local deities under Christian veneer.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Caucasian Mountain Oral Ritual Songs and Shrine Law (-1000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Highland Georgian Shrine Proverb: The Jvari (shrine) watches over the mountain passes; its law is older than kingdoms and sharper than a sword.
worldviews.short_description_en: Highland Georgian folk religion operating in remote Caucasus valleys, blending ancient pagan shrine law with Christian saints.
worldviews.short_description_hi: काकेशस पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों (जॉर्जिया) का लोक धर्म, जो ईसाई संतों के आवरण में प्राचीन पर्वतीय देवताओं (खाती) और शमन Oracle परंपरा को जीवित रखे हुए है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Highland Georgian folk religion operating in remote Caucasus valleys, blending ancient pagan shrine law with Christian saints.
worldviews.full_description_hi: काकेशस पर्वतीय क्षेत्रों (जॉर्जिया) का लोक धर्म, जो ईसाई संतों के आवरण में प्राचीन पर्वतीय देवताओं (खाती) और शमन Oracle परंपरा को जीवित रखे हुए है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The striking survival of ancient pre-Christian Caucasian animism masked inside Christian Saint George shrines in remote mountain valleys; The role of Kadagi (trance oracles) communicating direct messages from mountain deities to clan assemblies; Preservation of ancient armor, sacred beer brewing, and mountain sanctuary laws in Khevsureti and Tusheti

worldviews.historical_era: Ancient Scythian-Alanian Antiquity / Modern Revival c. 1980s CE
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Uatsdin (True Faith), Nart epic mythology, worship of Xucaw (Supreme God) and patron spirits (Dzuwr), and sacred three-pie ritual feasts.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Nart Sagas (Caucasian Epic Corpus) (-500)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ossetian Toast Prayer: May Almighty Xucaw and holy Uastyrji grant us truth, health, and protection upon our sacred Caucasian lands.
worldviews.short_description_en: Caucasian traditional religion of the Ossetians rooted in ancient Scythian-Alanian heritage, Nart epics, and sacred three-pie feasts.
worldviews.short_description_hi: कॉकेशस के ओस्सेशियन लोगों का पारंपरिक धर्म (वासीदीन), जो प्राचीन सीथियन-एलन विरासत और 'नारत महाकाव्य' की कथाओं पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Caucasian traditional religion of the Ossetians rooted in ancient Scythian-Alanian heritage, Nart epics, and sacred three-pie feasts.
worldviews.full_description_hi: कॉकेशस के ओस्सेशियन लोगों का पारंपरिक धर्म (वासीदीन), जो प्राचीन सीथियन-एलन विरासत और 'नारत महाकाव्य' की कथाओं पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Direct cultural and linguistic descent from the ancient nomadic Scythian and Alan tribes of the Eurasian steppe; The Nart Sagas providing a rich heroic mythological universe shared across Caucasian peoples; The modern organized religious revival of Assianism (Uatsdin) seeking to formalize and protect traditional Ossetian faith

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Empirical rationalism, natural rights (life, liberty, property), methodological individualism, and free-market price signals.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Second Treatise of Government (Locke) (1689); The Wealth of Nations (Smith) (1776)
worldviews.famous_quote: Adam Smith: It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest.
worldviews.short_description_en: Political and economic ideology prioritizing individual liberty, private property, free markets, rule of law, and limited government.
worldviews.short_description_hi: शास्त्रीय उदारवाद, जो व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता, निजी संपत्ति, मुक्त बाजार, कानून के शासन और सीमित सरकार का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Political and economic ideology prioritizing individual liberty, private property, free markets, rule of law, and limited government.
worldviews.full_description_hi: शास्त्रीय उदारवाद, जो व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता, निजी संपत्ति, मुक्त बाजार, कानून के शासन और सीमित सरकार का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The intellectual driving force behind the Glorious Revolution, the American Revolution, and early industrial capitalism; Formulation of the 'invisible hand' theory of market self-regulation and limited constitutional government; Laying the institutional groundwork for modern global trade, private property rights, and rule of law

worldviews.founder_key_figures: T.H. Green / L.T. Hobhouse / John Maynard Keynes
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pragmatic empiricism, positive liberty (freedom as capability), welfare economics, and institutional regulation of markets.
worldviews.canonical_texts: A Theory of Justice (John Rawls) (1971); The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money (Keynes) (1936)
worldviews.famous_quote: John Rawls: Justice is the first virtue of social institutions, as truth is of systems of thought.
worldviews.short_description_en: Political ideology combining capitalist markets with state welfare programs, civil rights protection, and regulation to ensure positive freedom.
worldviews.short_description_hi: आधुनिक सामाजिक उदारवाद, जो मुक्त बाजार के साथ सामाजिक सुरक्षा, कल्याणकारी राज्य और सकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता (अवसर की समानता) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Political ideology combining capitalist markets with state welfare programs, civil rights protection, and regulation to ensure positive freedom.
worldviews.full_description_hi: आधुनिक सामाजिक उदारवाद, जो मुक्त बाजार के साथ सामाजिक सुरक्षा, कल्याणकारी राज्य और सकारात्मक स्वतंत्रता (अवसर की समानता) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The implementation of New Deal social safety nets, public education, and labor regulations in the 20th century; Formulation of Rawlsian 'Justice as Fairness' and the 'Veil of Ignorance' thought experiment; Balancing capitalist market economies with state intervention to alleviate poverty and economic inequality

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Empirical skepticism toward abstract reason, respect for tradition, organic society, institutional continuity, and original sin/human fallibility.

worldviews.short_description_en: Political philosophy prioritizing tradition, social order, organic institutions, and skepticism toward sudden revolutionary utopian engineering.
worldviews.short_description_hi: शास्त्रीय रूढ़िवाद, जो परंपराओं, सामाजिक व्यवस्था, ऐतिहासिक संस्थाओं और क्रांतिकारी बदलावों के प्रति संदेह पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Political philosophy prioritizing tradition, social order, organic institutions, and skepticism toward sudden revolutionary utopian engineering.
worldviews.full_description_hi: शास्त्रीय रूढ़िवाद, जो परंपराओं, सामाजिक व्यवस्था, ऐतिहासिक संस्थाओं और क्रांतिकारी बदलावों के प्रति संदेह पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Edmund Burke's prophetic critique of the radical violence and utopian abstraction of the French Revolution; Preserving historical constitutional checks, social stability, and cultural inheritance across generations; Balancing ordered liberty with institutional duty and civic virtue

worldviews.historical_era: Mid-20th Century CE (Rooted in classical liberal economics)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Ayn Rand / Ludwig von Mises / Friedrich Hayek / Robert Nozick
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Austrian School economics, absolute self-ownership, non-aggression principle (NAP), and radical methodological individualism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Road to Serfdom (Hayek) (1944); Anarchy, State, and Utopia (Nozick) (1974)

worldviews.short_description_en: Political philosophy advocating minimal government ('night-watchman state'), absolute free markets, and individual self-ownership.

worldviews.full_description_en: Political philosophy advocating minimal government ('night-watchman state'), absolute free markets, and individual self-ownership.
worldviews.full_description_hi: न्यूनतम राज्यवाद (मिनारकिज्म), जो सरकार के अधिकार क्षेत्र को केवल पुलिस, न्याय और रक्षा तक सीमित कर पूर्ण मुक्त बाजार और आत्म-स्वामित्व का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The founding of the Mont Pelerin Society in 1947 by Hayek, Mises, and Friedman to counter state socialism; Formulating the calculation argument proving that socialist centrally planned economies are economically impossible; Advocating for privatization, deregulation, gold standard currency, and the abolition of the welfare state

worldviews.famous_quote: Thorstein Veblen: The outcome of this state of industrial arts is a situation where the machine process places an exacting requirement on the coordination of operations.
worldviews.short_description_en: Governance philosophy replacing traditional politics with scientific, data-driven decision-making by credentialed domain experts.

worldviews.full_description_hi: तकनीकी प्रबंधवाद (टेक्नोक्रेसी), जो राजनीतिक बहसों के स्थान पर वैज्ञानिकों, अर्थशास्त्रियों और विशेषज्ञों द्वारा डेटा-आधारित शासन का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The rise of specialized federal regulatory agencies, central banks, and expert policy think tanks in the 20th century; Managing complex global monetary and public health systems through econometric and epidemiological modeling; Criticized by populists for replacing democratic accountability with rule by unelected credentialed experts

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Chalmers Johnson / Lee Kuan Yew / East Asian Economic Planners
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pragmatic industrial policy, state-guided capital allocation, export-led growth, and prioritizing national modernization over abstract ideology.
worldviews.canonical_texts: MITI and the Japanese Miracle (Chalmers Johnson) (1982)
worldviews.famous_quote: Lee Kuan Yew: We are pragmatic. We don't stick to any ideology. Does it work? If it works, let's try it.
worldviews.short_description_en: Economic model where the state actively guides industrial development, investment, and exports to rapidly modernize national economies.
worldviews.short_description_hi: विकासवादी राज्य मॉडल, जिसमें सरकार रणनीतिक रूप से उद्योगों और निवेश का मार्गदर्शन कर देश को तेजी से आर्थिक महाशक्ति बनाती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Economic model where the state actively guides industrial development, investment, and exports to rapidly modernize national economies.
worldviews.full_description_hi: विकासवादी राज्य मॉडल, जिसमें सरकार रणनीतिक रूप से उद्योगों और निवेश का मार्गदर्शन कर देश को तेजी से आर्थिक महाशक्ति बनाती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The miraculous post-WWII economic transformations of Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Singapore (Asian Tigers); State agencies strategically picking winning industries, subsidizing exports, and fostering national corporate champions (Chaebols/Keiretsu); Proving that rapid industrialization can occur under strong state guidance combined with global market capitalism

worldviews.founder_key_figures: G.K. Chesterton / Hilaire Belloc / Pope Leo XIII
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Catholic social teaching (Rerum Novarum), principle of subsidiarity, wide distribution of private property, and anti-monopoly localism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Rerum Novarum (Papal Encyclical - Leo XIII) (1891); The Outline of Sanity (Chesterton) (1926)
worldviews.famous_quote: G.K. Chesterton: Too much capitalism does not mean too many capitalists, but too few capitalists.
worldviews.short_description_en: Third-way economic philosophy holding that productive property should be widely owned by families and cooperatives rather than centralized in state or corporate hands.
worldviews.short_description_hi: वितरणवाद (डिस्ट्रिब्यूटिज़्म), जो पूंजीवाद और समाजवाद दोनों का विरोध कर उत्पादक संपत्ति के व्यापक विकेंद्रीकरण (परिवारों और सहकारिता) का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Third-way economic philosophy holding that productive property should be widely owned by families and cooperatives rather than centralized in state or corporate hands.
worldviews.full_description_hi: वितरणवाद (डिस्ट्रिब्यूटिज़्म), जो पूंजीवाद और समाजवाद दोनों का विरोध कर उत्पादक संपत्ति के व्यापक विकेंद्रीकरण (परिवारों और सहकारिता) का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The intellectual response by Catholic writers to the twin injustices of unbridled industrial capitalism and state-enforced socialism; Promoting worker cooperatives, family farms, small independent craft guilds, and local credit unions; Inspiration for modern solidarity economy and regenerative localism movements

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Zero-sum national wealth view, bullionism (accumulating gold/silver reserves), export surpluses, and protectionist tariffs.
worldviews.canonical_texts: England's Treasure by Forraign Trade (Mun) (1664)
worldviews.famous_quote: Thomas Mun: The ordinary means therefore to increase our wealth and treasure is by Foreign Trade, wherein we must ever observe this rule; to sell more to strangers yearly than we consume of theirs.
worldviews.short_description_en: Economic nationalism prioritizing state power through positive trade balances, export protectionism, and bullion accumulation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: व्यापारीवाद (मर्केंटलिज्म), जो निर्यात अधिकृत कर, आयात शुल्क लगाकर और सोने-चांदी का खजाना जमा कर राष्ट्रीय शक्ति बढ़ाने पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Economic nationalism prioritizing state power through positive trade balances, export protectionism, and bullion accumulation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: व्यापारीवाद (मर्केंटलिज्म), जो निर्यात अधिकृत कर, आयात शुल्क लगाकर और सोने-चांदी का खजाना जमा कर राष्ट्रीय शक्ति बढ़ाने पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Powering the maritime colonial expansion, charter trading companies, and navigation acts of early modern European empires; Adam Smith's Wealth of Nations serving as the definitive dismantling critique of mercantilist monopolies and trade restrictions; Modern echoes in contemporary trade protectionism, currency manipulation debates, and strategic supply-chain nationalism

worldviews.historical_era: Late 20th Century CE (Rooted in limits-to-growth ecology)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Serge Latouche / Giorgos Kallis / Herman Daly
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Ecological economics, biophysical limits to infinite material growth on a finite planet, wellbeing metrics over GDP, and conviviality.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Steady-State Economics (Herman Daly) (1977); The Degrowth Vocabulary (Kallis et al.) (2018)
worldviews.famous_quote: Herman Daly: A steady-state economy is an economy with constant population and constant stock of capital, maintained by a low rate of throughput.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ecological economic framework calling for a democratically planned reduction of material production and consumption to ensure planetary sustainability.
worldviews.short_description_hi: डीग्रोथ (विकास-विरोध) पारिस्थितिक अर्थशास्त्र है, जो पृथ्वी की सीमित क्षमता को देखते हुए अनंत जीडीपी वृद्धि के स्थान पर समता और संतुलन पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ecological economic framework calling for a democratically planned reduction of material production and consumption to ensure planetary sustainability.
worldviews.full_description_hi: डीग्रोथ (विकास-विरोध) पारिस्थितिक अर्थशास्त्र है, जो पृथ्वी की सीमित क्षमता को देखते हुए अनंत जीडीपी वृद्धि के स्थान पर समता और संतुलन पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1972 Club of Rome report 'Limits to Growth' raising alarm over planetary resource exhaustion; Challenging the global obsession with perpetual GDP growth as ecologically destructive and socially unfulfilling; Proposing reduced material consumption in affluent nations while ensuring global equity and human flourishing

worldviews.historical_associations: The 1917 October Revolution establishing the world's first socialist state (Soviet Union); Sparking global anti-colonial liberation movements and mid-20th-century communist state formations; Rigorous critique of capitalist exploitation, alienation, and commodity fetishism

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Permanent revolution, critique of Stalinist bureaucracy, workers' democracy, and internationalist working-class solidarity.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Permanent Revolution (Trotsky) (1930); The Revolution Betrayed (Trotsky) (1936)
worldviews.famous_quote: Leon Trotsky: Permanent revolution means a revolution which does not compromise with any form of class rule, which does not stop at the democratic stage, but goes over to socialist measures.

worldviews.short_description_hi: ट्रोट्स्कीवाद, जो विश्व स्तर पर 'सतत क्रांति', स्टालिनवादी नौकरशाही के विरोध और वास्तविक मजदूरों के लोकतंत्र की वकालत करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Marxist current advocating permanent international revolution, opposition to totalitarian bureaucratization, and workers' self-management.

worldviews.historical_associations: Founding the Left Opposition against Joseph Stalin's 'Socialism in One Country' doctrine; Assassination of Leon Trotsky in Mexico in 1940 by a Soviet agent; Maintaining persistent internationalist revolutionary socialist critique throughout the Cold War and modern era

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Protracted people's war, peasant-led revolution, New Democracy, mass line politics, and continuous cultural revolution.

worldviews.historical_associations: The victorious 1949 Chinese Communist Revolution establishing the People's Republic of China; The turbulent mass mobilizations of the Great Leap Forward and the Cultural Revolution; Inspiring global revolutionary insurgencies across the Global South, including Naxalism in India and the Shining Path in Peru

worldviews.name_hi: पश्चिमी मार्क्सवाद और फ्रैंकफर्ट स्कूल (क्रिटिकल थ्योरी)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Max Horkheimer / Theodor Adorno / Herbert Marcuse / Jürgen Habermas
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Critical theory, psychoanalytic critique of authoritarian personality, cultural industry analysis, and critique of instrumental rationality.

worldviews.full_description_en: Intellectual movement combining Marxist critique with psychoanalysis and sociology to critique modern mass culture and domination.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पश्चिमी मार्क्सवाद और फ्रैंकफर्ट स्कूल, जो पूंजीवादी जन-संस्कृति, तकनीक के दमन और सामाजिक अलगाव की आलोचना करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Fleeing Nazi Germany to establish the Institute for Social Research at Columbia University in New York; Providing the intellectual spark for the 1968 student uprisings and New Left cultural movements; Pioneering the interdisciplinary critique of mass media, consumer capitalism, and totalitarian technology

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Abolition of state, private property, and wage labor; federation of self-governing communes operating on 'From each according to ability, to each according to need'.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Conquest of Bread (Kropotkin) (1892); Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution (Kropotkin) (1902)
worldviews.famous_quote: Pyotr Kropotkin: Prisons are universities of crime maintained by the state. Wellbeing for all is not a dream; it is possible and realizable.
worldviews.short_description_en: Libertarian socialist ideology advocating the abolition of the state and capitalism in favor of a decentralized network of communist communes.
worldviews.short_description_hi: अराजकता-साम्यवाद, जो राज्य और पूंजीवाद दोनों को समाप्त कर स्वतंत्र स्वायत्त समुदायों और पारस्परिक सहयोग (म्यूचुअल एड) पर आधारित समाज चाहता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Libertarian socialist ideology advocating the abolition of the state and capitalism in favor of a decentralized network of communist communes.
worldviews.full_description_hi: अराजकता-साम्यवाद, जो राज्य और पूंजीवाद दोनों को समाप्त कर स्वतंत्र स्वायत्त समुदायों और पारस्परिक सहयोग (म्यूचुअल एड) पर आधारित समाज चाहता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The establishment of the Free Territory during the Russian Civil War and the Anarchist Catalonia experiment during the Spanish Civil War (1936); Kropotkin's biological refutation of strict Social Darwinism through documenting cooperation in nature (Mutual Aid); Inspiring modern decentralized mutual aid networks and ecological direct action

worldviews.full_description_hi: अराजकता-सिंडिकेटवाद, जो क्रांतिकारी मजदूर यूनियनों के माध्यम से पूंजीवाद को उखाड़ फेंकने और उद्योगों पर श्रमिकों के सीधे नियंत्रण की बात करता है।

worldviews.canonical_texts: The Combahee River Collective Statement (1977); Women, Race, and Class (Angela Davis) (1981)
worldviews.famous_quote: Combahee River Collective: If Black women were free, it would mean that everyone else would have to be free since our freedom would necessitate the destruction of all the systems of oppression.

worldviews.full_description_en: Emancipatory political framework integrating anti-racism, anti-capitalism, and feminist critique of interlocking systems of oppression.
worldviews.full_description_hi: अश्वेत नारीवादी समाजवाद, जो नस्ल, लिंग और वर्ग के पारस्परिक उत्पीड़न (इंटरसेक्शनलिटी) का एक साथ विरोध कर पूंजीवादी पितृसत्ता को चुनौती देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The formulation of intersectionality by Kimberlé Crenshaw and its expansion into anti-capitalist socialist activism; Prison abolitionist organizing and grassroots mobilization against systemic racism and police violence; Challenging mainstream white feminism and class-reductionist leftism to center the most marginalized workers

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Critique of the 'Society of the Spectacle', psychogeography, détournement (subversion of mass media), and construction of disruptive situations.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Society of the Spectacle (Guy Debord) (1967); The Revolution of Everyday Life (Vaneigem) (1967)
worldviews.famous_quote: Guy Debord: In societies where modern conditions of production prevail, all of life presents itself as an immense accumulation of spectacles. Everything that was directly lived has receded into a representation.
worldviews.short_description_en: Avant-garde radical political and artistic movement critiquing consumer capitalism as a alienating 'Society of the Spectacle'.
worldviews.short_description_hi: परिस्थितिवादी आंदोलन, जो उपभोक्तावादी पूंजीवाद को 'तमाशे का समाज' (Society of the Spectacle) कहकर कला और संस्कृति के जरिए उसका विरोध करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Avant-garde radical political and artistic movement critiquing consumer capitalism as a alienating 'Society of the Spectacle'.
worldviews.full_description_hi: परिस्थितिवादी आंदोलन, जो उपभोक्तावादी पूंजीवाद को 'तमाशे का समाज' (Society of the Spectacle) कहकर कला और संस्कृति के जरिए उसका विरोध करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Providing the avant-garde graffiti slogans and theoretical critique that fueled the May 1968 student and worker general strikes in Paris; Pioneering artistic subversion of advertising and mass media (détournement); Critiquing consumer capitalism as an alienated spectacle replacing direct human experience

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Mario Tronti / Antonio Negri / Silvia Federici
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Working-class self-activity independent of trade unions and parties, 'social factory' analysis, and refusal of work.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Caliban and the Witch (Silvia Federici) (2004); Empire (Hardt and Negri) (2000)
worldviews.famous_quote: Mario Tronti: We first saw the capitalist development and then the capitalist crisis; we should instead see the capitalist crisis and then the capitalist development.
worldviews.short_description_en: Marxist current emphasizing the autonomous power of the working class to shape social and economic change independently of formal institutions.
worldviews.short_description_hi: ऑटोनोमिस्ट मार्क्सवाद, जो पारंपरिक मजदूर संघों और दलों से स्वतंत्र श्रमिकों की स्वतःस्फूर्त शक्ति तथा घरेलू श्रम के शोषण का विश्लेषण करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Marxist current emphasizing the autonomous power of the working class to shape social and economic change independently of formal institutions.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ऑटोनोमिस्ट मार्क्सवाद, जो पारंपरिक मजदूर संघों और दलों से स्वतंत्र श्रमिकों की स्वतःस्फूर्त शक्ति तथा घरेलू श्रम के शोषण का विश्लेषण करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1960s and 70s Italian 'Autonomia' factory struggles bypassing traditional communist party hierarchies; Silvia Federici's pathbreaking feminist Marxist analysis of primitive accumulation and unpaid domestic reproductive labor; Analyzing cognitive capitalism, immaterial labor, and the globalization of sovereign power (Empire)

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Subcomandante Marcos / Zapatista Army of National Liberation (EZLN)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Horizontal autonomy ('Walking by asking'), anti-capitalist indigenous communalism, dignity over seizing state power, and 'A world in which many worlds fit'.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Zapatista Communiqués and Declarations from the Lacandon Jungle (1994)
worldviews.famous_quote: Zapatista Slogan: Preguntando caminamos — Asking, we walk. Lead by obeying (Mandar obedeciendo).
worldviews.short_description_en: Indigenous libertarian socialist movement in Chiapas, Mexico, practicing horizontal autonomy, community self-defense, and anti-globalization.
worldviews.short_description_hi: मेक्सिको के चियापास राज्य का जापतिस्ता आंदोलन, जो स्वदेशी स्वायत्तता, सत्ता हथियाने के बजाय समाज बदलने ('आदेश देते हुए पालन करना') और पूंजीवाद विरोध पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Indigenous libertarian socialist movement in Chiapas, Mexico, practicing horizontal autonomy, community self-defense, and anti-globalization.
worldviews.full_description_hi: मेक्सिको के चियापास राज्य का जापतिस्ता आंदोलन, जो स्वदेशी स्वायत्तता, सत्ता हथियाने के बजाय समाज बदलने ('आदेश देते हुए पालन करना') और पूंजीवाद विरोध पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1994 indigenous uprising in Chiapas, Mexico, timed precisely to protest the signing of NAFTA; Pioneering autonomous indigenous self-governance, healthcare, education, and agroecology without state funding; Inspiring the global alter-globalization movement with the revolutionary ethos of changing the world without taking power

worldviews.founder_key_figures: René Guénon / Ananda Coomaraswamy / Frithjof Schuon
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sophia Perennis (The Eternal Wisdom), transcendent unity of religions, intellectual intuition (Buddhi), and anti-modern critique.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Crisis of the Modern World (Guénon) (1927); The Transcendent Unity of Religions (Schuon) (1948)
worldviews.famous_quote: René Guénon: The modern world is plunged in darkness because it has severed its ties with traditional metaphysics and divine hierarchy.
worldviews.short_description_en: Esoteric traditionalist philosophy asserting the existence of a single divine Universal Truth (Sophia Perennis) expressed through all authentic religions.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पारंपरिक स्कूल (सनातन दर्शन), जो सभी धर्मों के मूल में एक ही शाश्वत दिव्य सत्य (सोफिया पेरेनिस) को मानता है और आधुनिकता की घोर आलोचना करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Esoteric traditionalist philosophy asserting the existence of a single divine Universal Truth (Sophia Perennis) expressed through all authentic religions.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पारंपरिक स्कूल (सनातन दर्शन), जो सभी धर्मों के मूल में एक ही शाश्वत दिव्य सत्य (सोफिया पेरेनिस) को मानता है और आधुनिकता की घोर आलोचना करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Formulating the 20th-century intellectual critique of modern secularism, materialism, and industrial technology; Inspiring cross-cultural comparative study of sacred art, symbolism, and metaphysics; Profound influence on conservative cultural critics, religious scholars, and traditionalist thinkers globally

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Joseph de Maistre / Louis de Bonald
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Providential order, divine right of kings, theological pessimism, skepticism toward social contract theory and democracy.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Considerations on France (De Maistre) (1797); The Theory of Political and Religious Power (De Bonald) (1796)
worldviews.famous_quote: Joseph de Maistre: The counter-revolution will not be a contrary revolution, but the contrary of revolution.
worldviews.short_description_en: Counter-Enlightenment political philosophy defending absolute monarchy, divine right, social hierarchy, and traditional religious authority.
worldviews.short_description_hi: प्रतिक्रियावादी राजशाही दर्शन, जो फ्रांसीसी क्रांति और ज्ञानोदय (Enlightenment) का विरोध कर ईश्वर-प्रदत्त राजशाही और धार्मिक सत्ता का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Counter-Enlightenment political philosophy defending absolute monarchy, divine right, social hierarchy, and traditional religious authority.
worldviews.full_description_hi: प्रतिक्रियावादी राजशाही दर्शन, जो फ्रांसीसी क्रांति और ज्ञानोदय (Enlightenment) का विरोध कर ईश्वर-प्रदत्त राजशाही और धार्मिक सत्ता का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The fierce intellectual backlash against the secular rationalism and bloodshed of the French Revolution; Defending papal infallibility, absolute monarchy, and execution as a divine instrument of justice; Laying the uncompromising rhetorical foundation for radical right-wing anti-liberal critique

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Supremacy of Catholic moral law over civil law, rejection of political liberalism, and subordination of temporal state to spiritual church authority.

worldviews.full_description_en: Political philosophy holding that the Catholic Church should be recognized as the official religion of the state and public life governed by Catholic moral law.
worldviews.full_description_hi: कैथोलिक इंटीग्रलिज्म, जो मांग करता है कि राज्य का धर्म कैथोलिक चर्च होना चाहिए और सभी सार्वजनिक नीतियां ईसाई नैतिक कानून के अधीन होनी चाहिए।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 19th-century Vatican resistance against secular nationalism, separation of church and state, and modern liberties; The historical political regimes of Gabriel García Moreno in Ecuador and early 20th-century corporatism; Modern intellectual revival among traditionalist Catholic legal scholars and philosophers

worldviews.name_hi: यूरोपीय न्यू राइट (नया दक्षिणपंथ) और एथनो-राष्ट्रवाद
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Cultural ethnopluralism (preserving distinct cultural/ethnic identities through separation), anti-egalitarianism, and critique of American cultural hegemony.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Vu de Droite (Alain de Benoist) (1977)
worldviews.famous_quote: Alain de Benoist: We defend the diversity of the world against the homogenizing steamroller of global capitalism and universalist egalitarianism.
worldviews.short_description_en: Intellectual right-wing movement rejecting universalist egalitarianism in favor of cultural ethnopluralism, pagan traditionalism, and anti-globalism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: यूरोपीय 'न्यू राइट', जो सार्वभौमिक समानतावाद का विरोध कर सांस्कृतिक बहुलता (एथनो-प्लुरलिज्म), पैतृक परंपराओं और भूमंडलीकरण विरोध पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Intellectual right-wing movement rejecting universalist egalitarianism in favor of cultural ethnopluralism, pagan traditionalism, and anti-globalism.

worldviews.historical_associations: The founding of the GRECE think tank in France in 1968 aiming to build a metapolitical right-wing counter-hegemony; Shifting right-wing rhetoric from biological racism toward cultural 'ethnopluralism' and preservation of European heritage; Providing the intellectual scaffolding for contemporary European nationalist and populist movements

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Hyper-capitalist market competition, technological singularity, rejection of democracy as unreformable, and neocameralist corporate governance.
worldviews.canonical_texts: An Open Letter to Open-Minded Progressives (Curtis Yarvin) (2007); The Dark Enlightenment (Nick Land) (2012)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nick Land: Democracy is a doom-loop. Capitalism is a runaway train speeding toward technological singularity.
worldviews.short_description_en: Anti-democratic, technofuturist right-wing philosophy advocating hyper-capitalism, corporate governance models, and the collapse of liberal democracy.
worldviews.short_description_hi: डार्क एनलाइटेनमेंट और एक्सेलेरेशनिज़्म, जो लोकतंत्र को विफल मानकर कॉरपोरेट राज्यों, तकनीकी सिंगुलैरिटी और अति-पूंजीवाद का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Anti-democratic, technofuturist right-wing philosophy advocating hyper-capitalism, corporate governance models, and the collapse of liberal democracy.
worldviews.full_description_hi: डार्क एनलाइटेनमेंट और एक्सेलेरेशनिज़्म, जो लोकतंत्र को विफल मानकर कॉरपोरेट राज्यों, तकनीकी सिंगुलैरिटी और अति-पूंजीवाद का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Emerging from cybernetic philosophy at the University of Warwick into an influential internet-based political philosophy; Arguing that Western liberal democracy is hopelessly corrupt ('The Cathedral') and advocating for sovereign corporate city-states (Neocameralism); Profound influence on certain factions of Silicon Valley tech entrepreneurs and techno-authoritarian political discourse

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Totalitarian statism ('Everything in the State, nothing outside the State, nothing against the State'), corporatism, myth of national rebirth, and rejection of individualism/democracy.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Doctrine of Fascism (Mussolini & Gentile) (1932)
worldviews.famous_quote: Benito Mussolini: Fascism should more appropriately be called Corporatism because it is a merger of state and corporate power.
worldviews.short_description_en: Totalitarian, authoritarian nationalist ideology subordinating all aspects of society to an all-powerful, militaristic national state.
worldviews.short_description_hi: शास्त्रीय फासीवाद, जो 'सब कुछ राज्य के भीतर है, राज्य से बाहर कुछ नहीं, राज्य के खिलाफ कुछ नहीं' के सिद्धांत पर आधारित अधिनायकवादी विचारधारा है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Totalitarian, authoritarian nationalist ideology subordinating all aspects of society to an all-powerful, militaristic national state.
worldviews.full_description_hi: शास्त्रीय फासीवाद, जो 'सब कुछ राज्य के भीतर है, राज्य से बाहर कुछ नहीं, राज्य के खिलाफ कुछ नहीं' के सिद्धांत पर आधारित अधिनायकवादी विचारधारा है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Mussolini's March on Rome in 1922 establishing the world's first fascist dictatorship in Italy; Giovanni Gentile's Actual Idealist philosophy merging individual ego into the absolute ethical totality of the State; Catastrophic involvement in World War II leading to total military defeat and the collapse of the regime in 1943–1945

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Pseudoscientific racial determinism (Aryan supremacy), eliminationist antisemitism, social Darwinist struggle for Lebensraum (living space), and totalitarian dictatorship (Führerprinzip).

worldviews.full_description_en: Totalitarian, genocidal racial-nationalist ideology centering on Aryan supremacy, antisemitism, and aggressive territorial conquest.
worldviews.full_description_hi: राष्ट्रीय समाजवाद (नाजीवाद), जो नस्लीय श्रेष्ठता (आर्यन सर्वोच्चता), घृणा आधारित यहूदी नरसंहार (होलोकॉस्ट) और तानाशाही पर आधारित था।
worldviews.historical_associations: The establishment of the Third Reich in Germany in 1933, plunging Europe into World War II; The industrial genocide of six million Jews and millions of others in the Holocaust (Shoah); Universal moral condemnation establishing the definitive historical benchmark for absolute political evil

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Moral binary dividing society into 'the pure people' versus 'the corrupt elite', economic nationalism, border sovereignty, and skepticism toward globalism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: What is Populism? (Jan-Werner Müller) (2016)
worldviews.famous_quote: General Populist Tenet: We are putting our nation and our hard-working citizens first, taking back control from globalist technocrats.
worldviews.short_description_en: Political ideology pitting the ordinary 'virtuous people' against a self-serving elite, emphasizing national sovereignty, borders, and cultural preservation.
worldviews.short_description_hi: दक्षिणपंथी लोकलुभावन राष्ट्रवाद, जो 'साधारण जनता' बनाम 'भ्रष्ट अभिजात वर्ग' की राजनीति करते हुए राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता, सीमाओं और संस्कृति की रक्षा करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Political ideology pitting the ordinary 'virtuous people' against a self-serving elite, emphasizing national sovereignty, borders, and cultural preservation.
worldviews.full_description_hi: दक्षिणपंथी लोकलुभावन राष्ट्रवाद, जो 'साधारण जनता' बनाम 'भ्रष्ट अभिजात वर्ग' की राजनीति करते हुए राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता, सीमाओं और संस्कृति की रक्षा करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Surging electoral power across Western and developing democracies in the 2010s and 2020s; Challenging international free-trade agreements, mass migration policies, and supranational governance bodies; Redistributing political coalitions away from traditional center-left/center-right parties toward working-class nationalist blocks

worldviews.historical_era: Late 20th Century CE (Emerged as reaction against neoconservatism)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Russell Kirk / Samuel Francis / Pat Buchanan
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Old Right tradition, strict constitutionalism, anti-interventionist foreign policy (non-imperialism), decentralized federalism, and traditional cultural morality.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Conservative Mind (Russell Kirk) (1953); A Republic, Not an Empire (Pat Buchanan) (1999)
worldviews.famous_quote: Pat Buchanan: America First does not mean isolationism; it means keeping our republic out of foreign quagmires and defending our own borders.
worldviews.short_description_en: Traditional American conservative movement emphasizing nationalism, strict immigration control, non-interventionist foreign policy, and decentralization.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पारंपरिक अमेरिकी रूढ़िवाद (पैलियोकंजर्वेटिज़्म), जो अमेरिकी संविधान, कड़े आप्रवासन नियंत्रण, और विदेशी युद्धों में हस्तक्षेप न करने (अमेरिका फर्स्ट) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Traditional American conservative movement emphasizing nationalism, strict immigration control, non-interventionist foreign policy, and decentralization.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पारंपरिक अमेरिकी रूढ़िवाद (पैलियोकंजर्वेटिज़्म), जो अमेरिकी संविधान, कड़े आप्रवासन नियंत्रण, और विदेशी युद्धों में हस्तक्षेप न करने (अमेरिका फर्स्ट) पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The fierce intellectual resistance against Cold War neoconservative interventionism and global empire building; Advocating for strict immigration controls, tariff protectionism, and decentralized American constitutionalism; Laying crucial ideological groundwork for the contemporary 'America First' political movement

worldviews.short_description_en: Political ideology combining free-market capitalism with an assertive, interventionist foreign policy aimed at promoting democracy abroad.

worldviews.full_description_en: Political ideology combining free-market capitalism with an assertive, interventionist foreign policy aimed at promoting democracy abroad.
worldviews.full_description_hi: नया रूढ़िवाद (नियोकंजर्वेटिज़्म), जो अमेरिकी सैन्य शक्ति और हस्तक्षेपवादी विदेश नीति के जरिए दुनिया भर में लोकतंत्र थोपने और स्थापित करने का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The migration of disillusioned 1960s liberal intellectuals toward a robust defense of capitalist democracy and military strength; Shaping US foreign policy and interventionist military strategy following the events of September 11, 2001; Advocating for the global promotion of democracy through American hard power

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Edmund Husserl / Martin Heidegger / Maurice Merleau-Ponty
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Epoche (bracketing assumptions), direct descriptive analysis of lived conscious experience (Erlebnis), and intentionality of consciousness.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Logical Investigations (Husserl) (1900); Being and Time (Heidegger) (1927)
worldviews.famous_quote: Edmund Husserl: To the things themselves! (Zu den Sachen selbst!) We must return to that naive world in which we live and experience.
worldviews.short_description_en: Philosophical method studying the structures of conscious experience and human subjectivity from the first-person perspective.
worldviews.short_description_hi: घटना विज्ञान (फेनोमेनोलॉजी), जो बाहरी सिद्धांतों को छोड़कर सीधे मानवीय चेतना और जीवंत अनुभवों (Lived Experience) के अध्ययन पर बल देता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Philosophical method studying the structures of conscious experience and human subjectivity from the first-person perspective.
worldviews.full_description_hi: घटना विज्ञान (फेनोमेनोलॉजी), जो बाहरी सिद्धांतों को छोड़कर सीधे मानवीय चेतना और जीवंत अनुभवों (Lived Experience) के अध्ययन पर बल देता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The revolutionary philosophical turn away from abstract metaphysical systems toward a rigorous science of subjective consciousness; Profound influence on 20th-century psychology, psychiatry (Binswanger), literary criticism, and cognitive science; Bridging epistemology with the lived bodily reality of human existence in the world

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Søren Kierkegaard / Jean-Paul Sartre / Albert Camus
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Existence precedes essence, radical personal freedom, subjective truth, confronting the absurd, and radical moral responsibility.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fear and Trembling (Kierkegaard) (1843); Being and Nothingness (Sartre) (1943)
worldviews.famous_quote: Jean-Paul Sartre: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does.
worldviews.short_description_en: Philosophical movement emphasizing individual freedom, choice, responsibility, and the search for meaning in an indifferent universe.
worldviews.short_description_hi: अस्तित्ववाद, जो यह मानता है कि मनुष्य का अस्तित्व उसकी परिभाषा (सार) से पहले आता है और प्रत्येक व्यक्ति अपने कर्मों के लिए पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र व जिम्मेदार है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Philosophical movement emphasizing individual freedom, choice, responsibility, and the search for meaning in an indifferent universe.
worldviews.full_description_hi: अस्तित्ववाद, जो यह मानता है कि मनुष्य का अस्तित्व उसकी परिभाषा (सार) से पहले आता है और प्रत्येक व्यक्ति अपने कर्मों के लिए पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र व जिम्मेदार है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The post-WWII intellectual explosion in Paris cafes centering on human freedom, angst, and authenticity; Simone de Beauvoir's foundational feminist text 'The Second Sex' ('One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman'); Albert Camus's philosophical exploration of the absurd and the revolt against meaningless suffering

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Confronting the fundamental conflict between human search for meaning and the cold, silent, indifferent universe without resorting to philosophical suicide (religion/hope).
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Myth of Sisyphus (Camus) (1942); The Stranger (Camus) (1942)
worldviews.famous_quote: Albert Camus: One must imagine Sisyphus happy.
worldviews.short_description_en: Philosophical framework asserting that human beings exist in a meaningless, chaotic universe and that any attempt to find inherent meaning is absurd.
worldviews.short_description_hi: एब्सर्डिज़्म (व्यर्थतावाद), जो मानता है कि मनुष्य अर्थ की तलाश करता है और ब्रह्मांड मौन रहता है; इस विडंबना को स्वीकार कर हमें विद्रोह और स्वतंत्रता से जीना चाहिए।
worldviews.full_description_en: Philosophical framework asserting that human beings exist in a meaningless, chaotic universe and that any attempt to find inherent meaning is absurd.
worldviews.full_description_hi: एब्सर्डिज़्म (व्यर्थतावाद), जो मानता है कि मनुष्य अर्थ की तलाश करता है और ब्रह्मांड मौन रहता है; इस विडंबना को स्वीकार कर हमें विद्रोह और स्वतंत्रता से जीना चाहिए।
worldviews.historical_associations: Albert Camus's wartime and postwar essays in France addressing suicide, rebellion, and human dignity; The artistic expression of existential absurdity in modern theatre and literature; Rejecting both religious leap of faith and nihilistic despair in favor of defiant lucidity and joy

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Jacques Derrida / Michel Foucault / Gilles Deleuze / Roland Barthes
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Deconstruction, critique of binary oppositions, différance (deferred meaning), genealogy of power/knowledge, and anti-essentialism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Of Grammatology (Derrida) (1967); Discipline and Punish (Foucault) (1975)
worldviews.famous_quote: Jacques Derrida: There is nothing outside the text (Il n'y a pas de hors-texte).
worldviews.short_description_en: Philosophical movement critiquing structuralism by demonstrating the instability of language, inherent binaries, and shifting power structures.
worldviews.short_description_hi: उत्तर-संरचनावाद और विघटनवाद (Deconstruction), जो भाषा के स्थिर अर्थ को चुनौती देता है और सत्ता तथा ज्ञान के संबंधों का पर्दाफाश करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Philosophical movement critiquing structuralism by demonstrating the instability of language, inherent binaries, and shifting power structures.
worldviews.full_description_hi: उत्तर-संरचनावाद और विघटनवाद (Deconstruction), जो भाषा के स्थिर अर्थ को चुनौती देता है और सत्ता तथा ज्ञान के संबंधों का पर्दाफाश करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1966 Johns Hopkins conference introducing French post-structuralism to Anglo-American academia; Foucault's groundbreaking historical genealogies of madness, punishment, sexuality, and disciplinary power institutions; Radically transforming literary criticism, legal theory, architecture, and cultural critique

worldviews.full_description_en: Sociological and philosophical project aiming for human emancipation through rational communication, public discourse, and democratic consensus.
worldviews.full_description_hi: जूर्गेन हाबरमास का आलोचनात्मक सिद्धांत, जो विवेकसंगत संवाद (कम्युनिकेटिव एक्शन), जनसभाओं (पब्लिक स्फीयर) और लोकतांत्रिक सहमति पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Habermas defending the unfinished project of Enlightenment rationality against postmodern pessimism; Formulating the concept of the democratic public sphere and media democratization; Pioneering theories of constitutional patriotism, European integration, and deliberative ethics

worldviews.name_hi: दार्शनिक हर्मेनेयुटिक्स (गादामेर और रिकर - व्याख्या शास्त्र)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Fusion of horizons (Horizontverschmelzung), prejudice as a condition of understanding, narrative identity, and text interpretation.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Truth and Method (Gadamer) (1960); Time and Narrative (Ricoeur) (1983)
worldviews.famous_quote: Hans-Georg Gadamer: To reach an understanding with one's partner in a dialogue is not merely a matter of playing one's trump cards... rather, it is a transformation into a communion.
worldviews.short_description_en: Philosophical theory of interpretation focusing on how historical context, tradition, and dialogue shape human understanding.
worldviews.short_description_hi: हर्मेनेयुटिक्स (व्याख्या शास्त्र), जो अध्ययन करता है कि ऐतिहासिक परंपराएं, भाषा और पूर्वाग्रह मिलकर किस प्रकार मानवीय समझ और संवाद का निर्माण करते हैं।
worldviews.full_description_en: Philosophical theory of interpretation focusing on how historical context, tradition, and dialogue shape human understanding.
worldviews.full_description_hi: हर्मेनेयुटिक्स (व्याख्या शास्त्र), जो अध्ययन करता है कि ऐतिहासिक परंपराएं, भाषा और पूर्वाग्रह मिलकर किस प्रकार मानवीय समझ और संवाद का निर्माण करते हैं।
worldviews.historical_associations: Gadamer's monumental work establishing understanding as an ontological condition of human existence rather than a mere scientific method; Paul Ricoeur bridging continental phenomenology with Anglo-American analytic philosophy and narrative ethics; Transforming biblical, legal, and literary interpretation across global academia

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Incredulity toward metanarratives (grand narratives), hyperreality, simulation, and fragmentation of objective truth.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Postmodern Condition (Lyotard) (1979); Simulacra and Simulation (Baudrillard) (1981)
worldviews.famous_quote: Jean-François Lyotard: Simplifying to the extreme, I define postmodern as incredulity toward metanarratives.
worldviews.short_description_en: Cultural and philosophical condition marked by skepticism toward grand universal theories (metanarratives) and the rise of media simulations.
worldviews.short_description_hi: उत्तर-आधुनिकतावाद, जो सार्वभौमिक महान कथाओं (Metanarratives) में अविश्वास और मीडिया-निर्मित आभासी दुनिया (Hyperreality) का विश्लेषण करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Cultural and philosophical condition marked by skepticism toward grand universal theories (metanarratives) and the rise of media simulations.
worldviews.full_description_hi: उत्तर-आधुनिकतावाद, जो सार्वभौमिक महान कथाओं (Metanarratives) में अविश्वास और मीडिया-निर्मित आभासी दुनिया (Hyperreality) का विश्लेषण करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1979 publication of Lyotard's report on knowledge in advanced industrial societies; Baudrillard's theoretical analysis of the Gulf War as a televised media simulation (hyperreality); Radically disrupting 19th-century optimistic progress narratives in art, architecture, and philosophy

worldviews.name_hi: देलेउज का दर्शन (राजोमुक्ति और अंतर का दर्शन)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Rhizomatic thinking (non-hierarchical, multi-directional networks), immanence, ontology of difference, and anti-Oedipal psychoanalysis.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Difference and Repetition (Deleuze) (1968); A Thousand Plateaus (Deleuze & Guattari) (1980)
worldviews.famous_quote: Deleuze & Guattari: A rhizome ceaselessly establishes connections between semiotic chains, organizations of power, and circumstances relative to the arts, sciences, and social struggles.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ontology of difference and multiplicity replacing hierarchical tree-like structures with decentralized, interconnecting networks (rhizomes).
worldviews.short_description_hi: जीश देलेउज का दर्शन, जो पिरामिडनुमा पदानुक्रम को नकारकर भूमिगत जड़ों (Rhizome) की तरह अनंतिम और विकेन्द्रीकृत अंतर्संबंधों का दर्शन प्रस्तुत करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ontology of difference and multiplicity replacing hierarchical tree-like structures with decentralized, interconnecting networks (rhizomes).
worldviews.full_description_hi: जीश देलेउज का दर्शन, जो पिरामिडनुमा पदानुक्रम को नकारकर भूमिगत जड़ों (Rhizome) की तरह अनंतिम और विकेन्द्रीकृत अंतर्संबंधों का दर्शन प्रस्तुत करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Collaborative philosophical partnership between philosopher Gilles Deleuze and psychoanalyst Félix Guattari following the events of May 1968; Revolutionizing psychoanalysis with the critique of capitalist Oedipal domestic structures (Anti-Oedipus); Inspiring decentralized network theories, digital media studies, and contemporary aesthetic philosophy

worldviews.name_hi: पर्यावरण दर्शन और डीप इकोलॉजी (गहन पारिस्थितिकी)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Arne Næss / Félix Guattari / Bruno Latour
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Biocentrism (all life has intrinsic value independent of human utility), ecocentric self-realization, and critique of human exceptionalism.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Shallow and the Deep, Long-Range Ecology Movement (Naess) (1973); We Have Never Been Modern (Latour) (1991)
worldviews.famous_quote: Arne Næss: The well-being and flourishing of human and nonhuman life on Earth have value in themselves. These values are independent of the usefulness of the nonhuman world for human purposes.
worldviews.short_description_en: Ecological philosophy rejecting human-centeredness (anthropocentrism) to argue for the inherent intrinsic value of all natural ecosystems.
worldviews.short_description_hi: गहन पारिस्थितिकी (डीप इकोलॉजी), जो मनुष्य को प्रकृति का मालिक मानने के बजाय संपूर्ण जैवमंडल (Biocentrism) का सह-निवासी और समान आदरणीय मानती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ecological philosophy rejecting human-centeredness (anthropocentrism) to argue for the inherent intrinsic value of all natural ecosystems.
worldviews.full_description_hi: गहन पारिस्थितिकी (डीप इकोलॉजी), जो मनुष्य को प्रकृति का मालिक मानने के बजाय संपूर्ण जैवमंडल (Biocentrism) का सह-निवासी और समान आदरणीय मानती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Arne Næss formulating the distinction between 'shallow' anthropocentric resource conservation and 'deep' ecocentric biocentrism; Bruno Latour's Actor-Network Theory dissolving the strict dualism between human society and non-human nature; Providing the philosophical backbone for radical ecological direct action, ecofeminism, and earth jurisprudence

worldviews.name_hi: दार्शनिक एक्सेलेरेशनिज़्म (निकलैंड और सीसीआरयू - तकनीकी त्वरणवाद)
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Nick Land / Cybernetic Culture Research Unit (CCRU)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Cybernetic feedback loops, hyper-capitalist techno-commercial intensification, inhuman planetary intelligence, and pushing capitalist alienation to its ultimate collapse/singularity.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Fanged Noumena: Collected Writings 1987-2007 (Nick Land) (2011)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nick Land: The future is arriving faster than the past can decompose it. Capital accelerates history into the inhuman singularity.
worldviews.short_description_en: Radical philosophical current arguing that technological capitalism and cybernetic systems should be radically accelerated rather than resisted.
worldviews.short_description_hi: दार्शनिक एक्सेलेरेशनिज़्म, जो मानता है कि तकनीकी पूंजीवाद और कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) के विकास का विरोध करने के बजाय उसे उसकी चरमोत्क्रीति तक तेज कर देना चाहिए।
worldviews.full_description_en: Radical philosophical current arguing that technological capitalism and cybernetic systems should be radically accelerated rather than resisted.
worldviews.full_description_hi: दार्शनिक एक्सेलेरेशनिज़्म, जो मानता है कि तकनीकी पूंजीवाद और कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) के विकास का विरोध करने के बजाय उसे उसकी चरमोत्क्रीति तक तेज कर देना चाहिए।
worldviews.historical_associations: The formation of the legendary Cybernetic Culture Research Unit (CCRU) at Warwick University mixing rave culture, sci-fi, and continental philosophy; Blending Deleuze and Guattari's nomadology with cybernetics and hyper-capitalist market acceleration; Inspiring contemporary techno-optimist, AI-accelerationist, and cyber-Gnostic intellectual subcultures

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Julian Huxley / Max More / Ray Kurzweil / Nick Bostrom
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Technological optimism, rationalist empiricism, morphological freedom, radical life extension, and overcoming biological human limitations.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Singularity Is Near (Ray Kurzweil) (2005); Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies (Bostrom) (2014)
worldviews.famous_quote: Ray Kurzweil: The singularity will allow us to transcend these limitations of our biological bodies and brains... We will gain power over our destinies.
worldviews.short_description_en: Intellectual and cultural movement that aims to fundamentally transform the human condition by developing technologies to enhance human intellect and physiology.
worldviews.short_description_hi: पार-मानववाद (ट्रांसहुमानिज़्म), जो विज्ञान और तकनीक (AI, बायोटेक, नैनोटेक) के जरिए मानव शरीर और बौद्धिक सीमाओं को पार कर अमरता और सुपरइंटेलिजेंस पाना चाहता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Intellectual and cultural movement that aims to fundamentally transform the human condition by developing technologies to enhance human intellect and physiology.
worldviews.full_description_hi: पार-मानववाद (ट्रांसहुमानिज़्म), जो विज्ञान और तकनीक (AI, बायोटेक, नैनोटेक) के जरिए मानव शरीर और बौद्धिक सीमाओं को पार कर अमरता और सुपरइंटेलिजेंस पाना चाहता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The transition from 20th-century eugenic-tinged evolutionary humanism to modern cybernetic and genetic life extension; Pioneering research into artificial intelligence, cryonics, nanotechnology, and human-computer neural interfaces; Intense philosophical debate regarding existential risks (X-risks) of artificial general intelligence (AGI)

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Nikolai Fedorov / Konstantin Tsiolkovsky / Vladimir Vernadsky
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Synthesis of Eastern Orthodox mysticism, scientific rationalism, active evolution, universal resurrection of ancestors, and space migration.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Philosophy of the Common Task (Nikolai Fedorov) (1906); The Biosphere (Vernadsky) (1926)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nikolai Fedorov: The common task of all humanity is the resurrection of our ancestors through scientific and physical means, and the colonization of the cosmos.
worldviews.short_description_en: Visionary Russian philosophical movement combining science, religion, and space exploration to conquer death, resurrect ancestors, and populate the cosmos.
worldviews.short_description_hi: रूसी कॉस्मिज़्म, जो विज्ञान और अध्यात्म को मिलाकर मृत्यु पर विजय, पूर्वजों के पुनरुत्थान और अंतरिक्ष विजय (रॉकेट विज्ञान) का सपना देखता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Visionary Russian philosophical movement combining science, religion, and space exploration to conquer death, resurrect ancestors, and populate the cosmos.
worldviews.full_description_hi: रूसी कॉस्मिज़्म, जो विज्ञान और अध्यात्म को मिलाकर मृत्यु पर विजय, पूर्वजों के पुनरुत्थान और अंतरिक्ष विजय (रॉकेट विज्ञान) का सपना देखता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Fedorov teaching in a Moscow library where young Konstantin Tsiolkovsky was inspired to invent rocketry math; Vladimir Vernadsky formulating the revolutionary concept of the 'Noosphere' (sphere of human thought governing Earth); Direct ideological fuel for the Soviet space program, culminating in Sputnik and Yuri Gagarin's first human spaceflight

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Probabilistic techno-skepticism, computational metaphysics, physical matrix simulation models, and digital ontology.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Are You Living in a Computer Simulation? (Nick Bostrom) (2003)
worldviews.famous_quote: Nick Bostrom: One of these propositions is true: (1) all civilizations vanish before reaching 'posthuman' stage; (2) posthuman civilizations are uninterested in running ancestor simulations; (3) we are almost certainly living in a simulation.
worldviews.short_description_en: Techno-philosophical hypothesis suggesting that reality is an artificial computer simulation run by a more advanced posthuman civilization.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सिमुलेशन परिकल्पना, जो तर्क देती है कि हमारी यह पूरी वास्तविकता किसी अत्यधिक उन्नत सभ्यता द्वारा चलाई जा रही एक डिजिटल कंप्यूटर सिमुलेशन हो सकती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Techno-philosophical hypothesis suggesting that reality is an artificial computer simulation run by a more advanced posthuman civilization.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सिमुलेशन परिकल्पना, जो तर्क देती है कि हमारी यह पूरी वास्तविकता किसी अत्यधिक उन्नत सभ्यता द्वारा चलाई जा रही एक डिजिटल कंप्यूटर सिमुलेशन हो सकती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Bostrom's 2003 philosophical paper sparking massive academic and popular debate across physics, computer science, and theology; Influencing modern science fiction, cyberpunk cinema, and speculative cosmology; Providing a digital-age analog to ancient Maya, Hindu (Maya), and Gnostic philosophical concepts of universal illusion

worldviews.historical_associations: Soviet astronomer Nikolai Kardashev proposing his revolutionary energy-consumption scale for intelligent civilizations in 1964; Inspiring Freeman Dyson's theoretical Dyson Sphere megastructures capturing stellar energy output; Providing the foundational cosmological framework for science fiction, futurism, and astrophysical search for alien megastructures

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Evolutionary teleology, spiritualization of matter, the Noosphere (sphere of human thought), and convergence toward the Omega Point (Christ consciousness).
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Phenomenon of Man (Teilhard de Chardin) (1955)
worldviews.famous_quote: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin: We are not human beings having a spiritual experience. We are spiritual beings having a human experience... The universe is an evolution toward spirit.
worldviews.short_description_en: Christian evolutionary mysticism proposing that Earth is evolving from the biosphere into the noosphere, converging toward ultimate divine unity at the Omega Point.
worldviews.short_description_hi: तेइयार्ड डी शार्दिन का आध्यात्मिक विकासवाद, जो मानता है कि पृथ्वी जीवमंडल से निकलकर 'नूस्फीयर' (विचारों के गोले) की ओर बढ़ रही है और अंततः 'ओमेगा पॉइंट' पर ईश्वर से मिल जाएगी।
worldviews.full_description_en: Christian evolutionary mysticism proposing that Earth is evolving from the biosphere into the noosphere, converging toward ultimate divine unity at the Omega Point.
worldviews.full_description_hi: तेइयार्ड डी शार्दिन का आध्यात्मिक विकासवाद, जो मानता है कि पृथ्वी जीवमंडल से निकलकर 'नूस्फीयर' (विचारों के गोले) की ओर बढ़ रही है और अंततः 'ओमेगा पॉइंट' पर ईश्वर से मिल जाएगी।
worldviews.historical_associations: Teilhard de Chardin working as a Jesuit paleontologist and participating in the discovery of Peking Man; Silenced by Catholic Church authorities during his lifetime for unorthodox evolutionary theology, later celebrated posthumously; Profoundly influencing modern ecological theology, internet connectivity metaphors (early vision of global web as Noosphere), and cosmic optimism

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Sentientism (granting moral consideration to all sentient beings capable of suffering), utilitarian harm reduction, and expanding the moral circle to AI and animals.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Animal Liberation (Peter Singer) (1975); Speciesism (Richard Ryder) (2010)
worldviews.famous_quote: Peter Singer: The question is not, Can they reason? nor, Can they talk? but, Can they suffer?
worldviews.short_description_en: Ethical worldview granting moral standing and rights to all sentient beings capable of suffering, including animals and future artificial intelligences.
worldviews.short_description_hi: सेंशियंटिज़्म (संवेदना-वाद), जो किसी भी जीव (चाहे जानवर हो या भविष्य का AI) की पीड़ा महसूस करने की क्षमता को ही नैतिकता और अधिकारों का आधार मानता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Ethical worldview granting moral standing and rights to all sentient beings capable of suffering, including animals and future artificial intelligences.
worldviews.full_description_hi: सेंशियंटिज़्म (संवेदना-वाद), जो किसी भी जीव (चाहे जानवर हो या भविष्य का AI) की पीड़ा महसूस करने की क्षमता को ही नैतिकता और अधिकारों का आधार मानता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Peter Singer's 1975 groundbreaking book 'Animal Liberation' sparking the modern global animal rights and vegetarian/vegan movement; Coining the term 'speciesism' to critique human prejudice against non-human sentient animals; Expanding in the 21st century to address the upcoming ethical rights and suffering of artificial intelligence and synthetic sentience

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Epistemological instrumentalism ('Nothing is true, everything is permitted'), belief as a programmable tool, paradigm shifting, and gnosis states.
worldviews.canonical_texts: Liber Null & Psychonaut (Peter Carroll) (1987); Condensed Chaos (Phil Hine) (1992)
worldviews.famous_quote: Peter J. Carroll: Magic is not a supernatural phenomenon, but a technique of the mind and will operating in ways not yet recognized by consensus reality.
worldviews.short_description_en: Post-modern magical tradition treating belief as a flexible tool and ritual frameworks as arbitrary paradigms designed to achieve willed psychological results.
worldviews.short_description_hi: केओस मैजिक (अराजक जादू), जो किसी भी निश्चित धार्मिक सत्य को न मानकर 'विश्वास' को एक सॉफ्टवेयर की तरह बदलकर मनचाहे परिणाम हासिल करने की तकनीक है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Post-modern magical tradition treating belief as a flexible tool and ritual frameworks as arbitrary paradigms designed to achieve willed psychological results.
worldviews.full_description_hi: केओस मैजिक (अराजक जादू), जो किसी भी निश्चित धार्मिक सत्य को न मानकर 'विश्वास' को एक सॉफ्टवेयर की तरह बदलकर मनचाहे परिणाम हासिल करने की तकनीक है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Emerging from the punk rock counterculture and Austin Osman Spare's sigil magic in late 20th-century Britain; Radically stripping traditional ceremonial magic of dogmatic rituals, deities, and rigid lineages in favor of results-oriented pragmatism; Pioneering pop-culture magic (Sigils inspired by comic books, cyberpunk, and modern fiction)

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Thelema Law ('Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law'), Holy Guardian Angel communion, and magical will (Magick with a 'k').
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Book of the Law (Liber AL vel Legis) (1904); Magick in Theory and Practice (Crowley) (1929)
worldviews.famous_quote: Aleister Crowley (The Book of the Law): Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law... Love is the law, love under will.
worldviews.short_description_en: Western esoteric religion founded by Aleister Crowley centering on discovering and executing one's True Will under the law of Thelema.
worldviews.short_description_hi: एलिस्टर क्रोली द्वारा स्थापित थेलिमा धर्म, जिसका मूल मंत्र 'जो तुम्हारी इच्छा हो वही करो, यही संपूर्ण नियम है' (Do what thou wilt) है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Western esoteric religion founded by Aleister Crowley centering on discovering and executing one's True Will under the law of Thelema.
worldviews.full_description_hi: एलिस्टर क्रोली द्वारा स्थापित थेलिमा धर्म, जिसका मूल मंत्र 'जो तुम्हारी इच्छा हो वही करो, यही संपूर्ण नियम है' (Do what thou wilt) है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Crowley receiving 'The Book of the Law' from the disembodied entity Aiwass in Cairo in April 1904; Synthesizing Qabalah, Eastern yoga, ceremonial magic, and antinomian spiritual philosophy; Profound cultural and musical influence on 20th-century counterculture, rock music, and modern esotericism

worldviews.name_hi: विक्का (आधुनिक पैगन जादू-टोना और देवी उपासना)
worldviews.historical_era: Mid-20th Century CE (Publicly revealed c. 1954 CE)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Duotheism (Horned God and Triple Goddess), ritual magic, seasonal wheel of the year sabbats, and the Wiccan Rede ('An it harm none, do what ye will').
worldviews.canonical_texts: Witchcraft Today (Gerald Gardner) (1954); The Book of Shadows (1950)
worldviews.famous_quote: The Wiccan Rede: An it harm none, do what ye will.
worldviews.short_description_en: Modern duotheistic nature religion celebrating the Triple Goddess and Horned God, ritual magic, and ecological harmony.
worldviews.short_description_hi: विक्का (आधुनिक डायन-विद्या / देवी पूजा), जो त्रिदेवी (Triple Goddess) और सींग वाले देवता की पूजा, प्रकृति के ऋतु चक्र और 'किसी को नुकसान न पहुंचाओ' के नियम पर आधारित है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Modern duotheistic nature religion celebrating the Triple Goddess and Horned God, ritual magic, and ecological harmony.
worldviews.full_description_hi: विक्का (आधुनिक डायन-विद्या / देवी पूजा), जो त्रिदेवी (Triple Goddess) और सींग वाले देवता की पूजा, प्रकृति के ऋतु चक्र और 'किसी को नुकसान न पहुंचाओ' के नियम पर आधारित है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Gerald Gardner repealing of the British Witchcraft Act in 1951 and publishing Gardnerian Witchcraft in 1954; The explosion of feminist and ecofeminist spirituality in the 1970s and 1980s via figures like Starhawk; Establishing neo-pagan witchcraft as a respected, legally recognized modern religion across Western democracies

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Atheistic carnal self-indulgence, social Darwinism, Ayn Randian individualism, ritual psychodrama, and anti-Christian inversion.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Satanic Bible (Anton LaVey) (1969); The Satanic Rituals (1972)
worldviews.famous_quote: Anton LaVey (The Nine Satanic Statements): Satan represents indulgence instead of abstinence! Satan represents vital existence instead of spiritual pipe dreams!
worldviews.short_description_en: Atheistic philosophy using the symbolic figure of Satan to represent individualism, carnality, pragmatism, and opposition to Christian asceticism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: लावेयन सातानवाद एक अनीश्वरवादी दर्शन है, जो 'शैतान' के प्रतीक का उपयोग कर इंसान की शारीरिक इच्छाओं, अहंकार और स्वतंत्रता का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Atheistic philosophy using the symbolic figure of Satan to represent individualism, carnality, pragmatism, and opposition to Christian asceticism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: लावेयन सातानवाद एक अनीश्वरवादी दर्शन है, जो 'शैतान' के प्रतीक का उपयोग कर इंसान की शारीरिक इच्छाओं, अहंकार और स्वतंत्रता का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Anton LaVey founding the Church of Satan in San Francisco on Walpurgis Night 1966; Pioneering theatrical psychodrama rituals to purge emotional repressions and celebrate human carnality; Providing a provocative secular-atheist counter-cultural shock philosophy against religious authoritarianism

worldviews.full_description_en: Eclectic spiritual movement emphasizing holistic healing, personal transformation, channeling, and the dawning of the Age of Aquarius.
worldviews.full_description_hi: न्यू एज आंदोलन, जो विभिन्न धर्मों, ज्योतिष, क्रिस्टल हीलिंग, योग और मानसिक शक्ति को मिलाकर व्यक्तिगत और वैश्विक चेतना के परिवर्तन की बात करता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1970s counter-cultural shift in California merging psychotherapy, Eastern mysticism, and alternative medicine; The massive popularization of yoga, meditation, crystal healing, astrology, and mind-power seminars globally; Transitioning from organized institutional religion into decentralized consumer spiritual seeking

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Soul travel (astral projection), HU chanting (sacred name of God), and direct spiritual guidance by the Living Eck Master.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Tiger's Fang (Paul Twitchell) (1967); Eckankar: Key to Secret Worlds (1969)
worldviews.famous_quote: Sri Harold Klemp: Soul is ancient. You are Soul, a spark of God, on a journey of spiritual awakening through the worlds of light and sound.

worldviews.full_description_en: Modern spiritual movement teaching soul travel, karma, reincarnation, and connecting with the divine Sound and Light (HU).
worldviews.full_description_hi: एककार, एक आधुनिक आध्यात्मिक आंदोलन जो आत्मा की यात्रा (सोल ट्रैवल), कर्म, पुनर्जन्म और 'हू' (HU) शब्द के जाप द्वारा ईश्वर से मिलन सिखाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Paul Twitchell founding Eckankar in 1965, synthesizing Sant Mat traditions, Theosophy, and modern spiritual techniques; Popularizing 'Soul Travel' (astral projection) as a direct method for individuals to experience higher spiritual planes; Establishing international spiritual discourse centers and contemplative HU chanting groups worldwide

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Bio-psycho-social memetic value systems, helical stages of psychological development (Beige, Purple, Red, Blue, Orange, Green, Yellow, Turquoise).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Spiral Dynamics: Mastering Values, Leadership, and Change (Beck & Cowan) (1996)
worldviews.famous_quote: Don Beck: We do not change people; we change the conditions of their existence so that their minds can emerge to higher spirals of complexity.
worldviews.short_description_en: Model of psychological and cultural evolution mapping human values and societal worldviews across distinct, ascending memetic stages (vMEMEs).
