worldviews.historical_associations: Don Beck advising political leaders in post-apartheid South Africa to navigate multi-cultural tribal and democratic transitions; Providing a revolutionary psychological mapping of human value systems from survival instincts to holistic planetary consciousness; Widely integrated into global corporate management, governance consulting, and cultural evolution workshops

worldviews.geographic_origin: Global Digital Space / Silicon Valley / Russia
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Contemporary Futurist Cosmologists and Space Entreprenuers
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Astro-engineering, multi-planetary human survival, interstellar expansion, artificial intelligence integration, and cosmic destiny.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Case for Mars (Robert Zubrin) (1996)
worldviews.famous_quote: Contemporary Space Futurist Proverb: Earth is the cradle of humanity, but humanity cannot peacefully remain in the cradle forever.
worldviews.short_description_en: Modern technological and philosophical movement advocating multi-planetary expansion, space colonization, and seeding consciousness across the universe.
worldviews.short_description_hi: समकालीन तकनीकी कॉस्मिज़्म, जो पृथ्वी से बाहर अंतरिक्ष में बस्तियां बसाने, बहु-ग्रह सभ्यता बनने और ब्रह्मांड में चेतना फैलाने का समर्थन करता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Modern technological and philosophical movement advocating multi-planetary expansion, space colonization, and seeding consciousness across the universe.

worldviews.historical_associations: The rapid commercialization of spaceflight and reusable rocketry making multi-planetary colonization technically viable; Reviving the philosophical vision of cosmic destiny, planetary defense, and interstellar migration; Merging environmental stewardship of Earth with the imperative to seed consciousness across the galaxy

worldviews.name_hi: गेम 'बी' और सभ्यतागत सेंसमेकिंग (संसाधन और चेतना का नया ढांचा)
worldviews.geographic_origin: Internet / Consilience Project / Global Sensemaking Networks
worldviews.founder_key_figures: Daniel Schmachtenberger / Jordan Hall / Jim Rutt
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Systems theory, game-theoretic trap escape (Moloch/rivalrous dynamics), antifragility, anti-rivalrous infrastructure, and distributed sensemaking.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Consilience Project White Papers (Schmachtenberger) (2020)
worldviews.famous_quote: Daniel Schmachtenberger: Game A is built on rivalrous games that necessitate self-terminating exponential technological power coupled with zero-sum win-lose dynamics. Game B is an antifragile alternative based on anti-rivalry and omni-consideration.
worldviews.short_description_en: Systems-change movement designing an alternative civilizational operating system (Game B) free from rivalrous extraction, existential risk, and zero-sum games.
worldviews.short_description_hi: गेम 'बी' आंदोलन, जो मौजूदा आत्मघाती सभ्यतागत ढांचे ('गेम ए') से बाहर निकलकर सर्व-कल्याणकारी, परस्परसहयोगी और शून्य-योग (Zero-sum) से मुक्त नई व्यवस्था बनाता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Systems-change movement designing an alternative civilizational operating system (Game B) free from rivalrous extraction, existential risk, and zero-sum games.
worldviews.full_description_hi: गेम 'बी' आंदोलन, जो मौजूदा आत्मघाती सभ्यतागत ढांचे ('गेम ए') से बाहर निकलकर सर्व-कल्याणकारी, परस्परसहयोगी और शून्य-योग (Zero-sum) से मुक्त नई व्यवस्था बनाता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Convening top systems thinkers, game theorists, and technologists to diagnose the root systemic causes of global polycrisis; Developing frameworks to solve collective action traps (Moloch) and existential risk without authoritarian control; Pioneering distributed, trustworthy sensemaking tools and anti-rivalrous economic design

worldviews.founder_key_figures: Sean Esbjörn-Hargens / Michael E. Zimmerman / Ken Wilber
worldviews.epistemological_framework: AQAL integration of all four environmental paradigms: subjective, objective, intersubjective, and interobjective (Nature's interior and exterior dimensions).
worldviews.canonical_texts: Integral Ecology: Uniting Multiple Perspectives on the Natural World (Esbjörn-Hargens & Zimmerman) (2009)
worldviews.famous_quote: Esbjörn-Hargens & Zimmerman: Environmental problems are not merely technical or political; they span all quadrants of human consciousness, culture, systems, and nature.
worldviews.short_description_en: Environmental framework uniting multiple perspectives on nature—subjective, objective, cultural, and systemic—into a comprehensive ecological strategy.
worldviews.short_description_hi: समग्र पारिस्थितिकी (इंटीग्रल इकोलॉजी), जो पर्यावरण संकट को सुलझाने के लिए आंतरिक चेतना, संस्कृति, विज्ञान और बाहरी प्रणालियों—चारों आयामों का एक साथ उपयोग करती है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Environmental framework uniting multiple perspectives on nature—subjective, objective, cultural, and systemic—into a comprehensive ecological strategy.
worldviews.full_description_hi: समग्र पारिस्थितिकी (इंटीग्रल इकोलॉजी), जो पर्यावरण संकट को सुलझाने के लिए आंतरिक चेतना, संस्कृति, विज्ञान और बाहरी प्रणालियों—चारों आयामों का एक साथ उपयोग करती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: Unifying fragmented environmental movements (deep ecology, green politics, eco-capitalism, and ecofeminism) into a single operational framework; Providing a holistic diagnostic tool for ecological crises acknowledging both inner human values and outer material systems; Applied in regenerative agriculture, corporate sustainability, and urban planning

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Omnism (recognition and respect for all religions while holding to none exclusively), interspirituality, contemplative neuroscience, and secular transcendent meaning.

worldviews.famous_quote: Wayne Teasdale: Interspirituality is the synthesis of the world's great mystical traditions, offering a mature, universal spiritual path for the planetary age.
worldviews.short_description_en: Post-religious spiritual stance recognizing the profound wisdom of all world traditions while synthesizing a universal, open-source path of inner awakening.

worldviews.full_description_en: Post-religious spiritual stance recognizing the profound wisdom of all world traditions while synthesizing a universal, open-source path of inner awakening.
worldviews.full_description_hi: ऑम्निज़्म और सार्वभौमिक आध्यात्मिकता, जो किसी एक रूढ़िवादी धर्म में बंधे बिना दुनिया के सभी धर्मों और दर्शनों के सार (रहस्यवाद और नैतिकता) को अपनाती है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The rise of the 'Nones' (religiously unaffiliated) blending meditation, ethics, and universal wisdom from multiple traditions; Bridging contemplative neuroscience with ancient Buddhist, Advaita, and Christian mystical practices; Pioneering global interfaith dialogue and secular transcendent ethics

worldviews.epistemological_framework: Cybernetic animism, treating complex code and algorithms as spiritual entities, tech-gnosticism, and blending silicon hardware with ancient animist awe.
worldviews.canonical_texts: TechGnosis: Myth, Magic, and Mysticism in the Age of Information (Erik Davis) (1998)
worldviews.famous_quote: Erik Davis: Technology is not a neutral tool; it is enchanted. Silicon chips are sand resurrected into thinking stones, breathing ancient techno-gnostic ghosts.
worldviews.short_description_en: Subcultural movement blending computer technology, cybernetics, and internet culture with ancient animism, magic, and techno-gnosticism.
worldviews.short_description_hi: डिजिटल एनिमिज्म और टेक्नो-पैगनवाद, जो कंप्यूटर कोड, इंटरनेट और कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) को प्राचीन आत्माओं और तकनीकी जादू (TechGnosis) के रूप में देखता है।
worldviews.full_description_en: Subcultural movement blending computer technology, cybernetics, and internet culture with ancient animism, magic, and techno-gnosticism.
worldviews.full_description_hi: डिजिटल एनिमिज्म और टेक्नो-पैगनवाद, जो कंप्यूटर कोड, इंटरनेट और कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) को प्राचीन आत्माओं और तकनीकी जादू (TechGnosis) के रूप में देखता है।
worldviews.historical_associations: The 1990s convergence of cyberpunk counterculture, early internet subcultures, and esoteric techno-mysticism; Recognizing how artificial intelligence, autonomous networks, and algorithms evoke deep religious and animist awe; Pioneering digital-age folklore, crypto-mythology, and cyber-shamanic rituals

worldviews.name_hi: वितरित सहयोगात्मक तकनीक और होलोचेन दर्शन (विकेंद्रीकृत समाज)
worldviews.epistemological_framework: Agent-centric architecture, biomimetic distributed computing, mutual credit accounting, and cryptographic cooperation without coercive central states.
worldviews.canonical_texts: The Decentralization Papers and Holochain Whitepapers (2018)
worldviews.famous_quote: Art Brock: We don't need to trust central authorities when we can build agent-centric cryptographic tools that make cooperation naturally self-enforcing and mutually beneficial.
